content:
Nhyira ne onipa a
    ɔntie amumuyɛfoɔ afotuo
  na ɔnni nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nhwɛsoɔ akyi
    na ɔntena fɛdifoɔ tenabea.

Na mmom, Awurade mmara sɔ nʼani,
    na ɔdwene ho awia ne anadwo.

Ɔte sɛ dua a wɔatɛ wɔ asutene ho,
    na ɛso nʼaba ne berɛ mu a
  nʼahahan no nnwan.
    Deɛ ɔyɛ biara yɛ yie.

Enti amumuyɛfoɔ rentumi nnyina atemmuo no ano,
    na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nso rentena teneneefoɔ asafo mu.

Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kyerɛ ɔteneneeni kwan
    nanso amumuyɛfoɔ kwan deɛ, ɛbɛyera.

Adɛn enti, Ao Awurade, na wogyina akyirikyiri saa?
    Adɛn enti na wode wo ho ahinta wɔ amanehunu mmerɛ mu yi?

Ɔmumuyɛfoɔ de ahantan taataa mmɔborɔfoɔ,
    wɔn a mfidie a wɔasunsum yi wɔn.

Ɔde deɛ nʼakoma hwehwɛ hoahoa ne ho;
    ɔhyira ɔdifodepɛfoɔ, na ɔyi Awurade ahi.

Ahantan enti, omumuyɛfoɔ nhwehwɛ Awurade;
    na Onyankopɔn nni ne nsusuiɛ nyinaa mu.

Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ: “Biribiara mma me nhinhim;
    mʼani bɛgye daa, na merenkɔ amanehunu mu da.”

Nnome, atorɔ ne ahunahuna ahyɛ nʼanom ma;
    Ɔhaw ne mmusuo hyɛ ne tɛkrɛma ase.

Ɔdwerɛ wɔn a ɔkyere wɔn no ma wɔtɔ baha;
    na ɔde nʼahoɔden ka wɔn hyɛ.

Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ, “Onyankopɔn werɛ afi;
    wayi nʼani afiri so na ɔnhunu.”

Sɔre, Awurade! Ma wo nsa so, Ao Onyankopɔn.
    Mma wo werɛ mfiri wɔn a wɔnni aboafoɔ.

Adɛn enti na omumuyɛfoɔ yi Onyankopɔn ahi?
    Adɛn enti na ɔka kyerɛ ne ho sɛ,
    “Ɔremfrɛ me akontabuo so?”

Awurade yɛ ɔhene daa nyinaa;
    amanaman no bɛyera nʼasase so.

Ao Awurade, wotie awiɛmfoɔ adesrɛ;
    wohyɛ wɔn nkuran, na wotie wɔn sufrɛ,

na wodi ma awisiaa ne deɛ wɔhyɛ ne soɔ
    sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdasani a ɔfiri asase so
    renhunahuna obiara bio.
Mommɔ ose mma Awurade, asase nyinaa

Momfa ahosɛpɛ nsom Awurade;
    momfa anigyeɛ nnwom mmra nʼanim.

Awurade yɛ; na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa;
    ne nokorɛdie kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.

Mɛto wo dɔ ne wo tenenee ho dwom;
    Ao Awurade, mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo.

Mɛhwɛ yie abu ɔbra a ɛho teɛ.
    Dabɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn?
    
  Mede akoma a afɔdie nni mu
    bɛnante me fie.

Meremfa mʼani nsi
    adeɛ a ɛyɛ tane biara so.
    
  Mekyiri nnipa a wɔnni gyidie;
    Me ne wɔn nni hwee yɛ.

Nnipa a wɔn akoma yɛ kontonkyi remmɛn me;
    me ne bɔne nni hwee yɛ.

Obiara a ɔdi ne yɔnko ho nsekuro wɔ kɔkoam no,
    ɔno na mɛsɛe;
  deɛ ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne ahomasoɔ akoma,
    ɔno na merennyegye ne so.

Mʼani bɛkɔ anokwafoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no soɔ no so
    na me ne wɔn atena;
  deɛ ne nanteɛ ho nni asɛm no,
    ɔno na ɔbɛsom me.

Deɛ ɔyɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ biara
    rentena me fie;
  deɛ ɔtwa nkontompo no
    rennyina mʼanim.

Adekyeeɛ biara,
    mɛsɛe amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa;
  na mapam ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ biara
    afiri Awurade kuropɔn mu.

Ao Awurade tie me mpaeɛbɔ;
    na ma me mmoa ho sufrɛ nnuru wʼanim.

Mfa wʼanim nhinta me
    ɛberɛ a mewɔ ahohiahia mu.
  Brɛ wʼaso ase ma me;
    na sɛ mesu mefrɛ wo a, gye me so ntɛm.

Me nkwa nna reyera te sɛ wisie;
    me nnompe hyehye te sɛ egya.

Mʼakoma aboto na akusa sɛ ɛserɛ;
    na me kɔn nnɔ aduane.

Mʼapinisie denden enti
    maka honam ne nnompe.

Mete sɛ ɛserɛ so patuo,
    te sɛ ɔpatuo a ɔte mmubuiɛ mu.

Meda hɔ a, mʼani gu so; mayɛ sɛ
    anomaa bi a ɔno nko ara si ɛdan atifi.

Ɛda mu nyinaa mʼatamfoɔ bɔ me akutia.
    Wɔn a wɔdi me ho fɛ no bɔ me din de dome.

Mede nsõ ayɛ mʼaduane
    na mede nisuo fra me nsuo mu

ɛsiane wʼabufuhyeɛ denden no enti,
    woama me so, ayi me asi nkyɛn.

Me nkwa nna te sɛ anwummerɛ sunsum;
    na mekusa sɛ ɛserɛ.

Nanso, wo Awurade, woyɛ ɔhene daa daa;
    na wo din a ahyeta no te hɔ daa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Nʼaboɔ som bo ma wʼasomfoɔ;
    ne mfuturo hyɛ wɔn awerɛhoɔ.

Amanaman no bɛsuro Awurade din;
    asase so ahemfo nyinaa bɛdi wʼanimuonyam ni.

Awurade bɛkyekyere Sion bio,
    na wapue wɔ nʼanimuonyam mu.

Ɔbɛtie mmɔborɔfoɔ mpaeɛbɔ;
    na ɔremmu nʼani ngu wɔn sufrɛ so.

Montwerɛ yei mma nkyirimma,
    sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔnnya nwoo wɔn bɛkamfo Awurade;

“Awurade hwɛɛ fam firi ne kronkronbea wɔ soro hɔ;
    ɔfiri soro hwɛɛ asase,

sɛdeɛ ɔbɛte nneduafoɔ apinisie
    na wagyaa wɔn a wɔabu wɔn kumfɔ no.”

Enti, wɔbɛpae mu abɔ Awurade din wɔ Sion
    na wɔakamfo no wɔ Yerusalem,

ɛberɛ a amanaman ne ahennie ahodoɔ
    bɛhyiam na wɔasom Awurade.

Ɔmaa me yɛɛ mmerɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a merenyini.
    Ɔtwaa me nkwa nna so.

Ahyɛaseɛ no, wotoo asase fapem,
    na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.

Ne nyinaa bɛtwam, na wo deɛ, wobɛtena hɔ daa;
    wɔbɛtete te sɛ atadeɛ.
  Wobɛsesa wɔn te sɛ ntoma
    na wɔbɛto wɔn agu.

Nanso, wote sɛdeɛ woteɛ,
    na wo mfeɛ to rentwa da.

Wʼasomfoɔ mma bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim;
    na wɔn asefoɔ ase bɛtim wɔ wʼanim.”

Ao me kra, kamfo Awurade;
    na me mu adeɛ nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no.

Ao me kra, kamfo Awurade,
    na mma wo werɛ mfiri ne nneyɛeɛ pa nyinaa,

ɔno na ɔde wo mfomsoɔ nyinaa kyɛ woɔ
    na ɔsa wo nyarewa nyinaa,

ɔgye wo nkwa firi damena mu
    na ɔde adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotire,

ɔde nnepa ma wo sɛ wʼapɛdeɛ
    na wo mmeranteberɛ yɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.

Awurade yɛ adetenenee
    na ɔbu wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so nyinaa atɛntenenee.

Ɔkyerɛɛ Mose nʼakwan,
    na ɔmaa Israelfoɔ hunuu ne nneyɛɛ.

Mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ ne Awurade,
    ne bo kyɛre fu na nʼadɔeɛ dɔɔso.

Ɔrenkɔ so mmɔ soboɔ,
    na ɔrennya yɛn ho menasepɔ nkɔsi daa;

Ɔrenhwɛ yɛn bɔne ne yɛn nni sɛdeɛ ɛfata
    na ɔrentua yɛn nnebɔne so ka sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ.

Na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro ne asase ntam ware no,
    saa ara na nʼadɔeɛ so wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so.

Sɛdeɛ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ ntam ware no,
    saa ara na wama yɛn ne yɛn mmarato ntam kwan aware.

Sɛdeɛ agya yam hyehye no ne mma ho no,
    saa ara na Awurade yam hyehye no ma wɔn a wɔsuro no,

na ɔnim sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ yɛn,
    ɔkae sɛ yɛyɛ mfuturo.

Ɔdasani deɛ, ne nna te sɛ ɛserɛ,
    ɔyɛ frɔmm sɛ wiram nhwiren;

sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na ɔnni hɔ,
    na ne sibea nnim no bio.

Nanso ɛfiri mmerɛsanten kɔsi nnasanten
    Awurade adɔeɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no so,
    na ne tenenee wɔ wɔn mma mma so,

wɔn a wɔdi nʼapam no so
    na wɔkae di ne mmara so.

Awurade asi nʼahennwa wɔ soro,
    na nʼahennie di adeɛ nyinaa so.

Monkamfo Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼabɔfoɔ,
    mo atumfoɔ a moyɛ nʼahyɛdeɛ,
    mo a motie nʼasɛm.

Monkamfo Awurade, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa,
    nʼasomfoɔ a moyɛ nʼapɛdeɛ.

Monkamfo Awurade, ne nnwuma nyinaa
    deɛ ɛwɔ nʼaheman mu nyinaa.
    
  Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade!

Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade!
    
  Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, woyɛ ɔkɛseɛ!
    Wɔafira tumi ne animuonyam.

Ɔde hann akata ne ho sɛ atadeɛ;
    ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu te sɛ ntomadan,

na ɔde ne mpia mpunan sisi nsuo so.
  Ɔde omununkum yɛ ne teaseɛnam
    na ɔde nante mframa ntaban so.

Ɔsoma nʼabɔfoɔ sɛ mframa,
    na ɔsoma nʼasomfoɔ sɛ ogyadɛreɛ.

Ɔde asase asi ne fapem so
    na ɛrenhinhim da.

Wode ebunu kataa so sɛ atadeɛ
    na nsuo gyinaa mmepɔ no so.

Nanso wʼanimka maa nsuo no dwaneeɛ,
    wʼaprannaa nnyegyeeɛ ma wɔdwaneeɛ;

Wɔtenetenee faa mmepɔ so,
    kɔɔ mmɔnhwa mu tɔnn,
    kɔguu baabi a wode ama wɔn no.

Wotoo ɔhyeɛ a wɔrentumi ntra;
    na wɔammɛkata asase so bio.

Ɔma nsuwa tene fa abɔn mu;
    ɛtene fa mmepɔ ntam.

Ɔma wiram mmoa nyinaa nsuo nom;
    ɔma afunumu nsuo de kum wɔn sukɔm.

Ewiem nnomaa nwene wɔn pirebuo wɔ nsuo no ho;
    na wɔto nnwom wɔ nnua no mman so.

Ɔfiri ne soro mpia mu tɔ nsuo gugu mmepɔ so;
    Awurade nnwuma so aba mee asase.

Ɔma ɛserɛ fifiri ma anantwie,
    na ɔbɔɔ nnua maa onipa sɛ ɔnnua
    na ɛmma aduane mfiri asase mu:

na onipa anya nsã ama nʼakoma atɔ ne yam,
    na onipa anya ngo ama nʼanim atɔ so,
    na aduane nso akura onipa akoma.

Wɔgugu Awurade nnua no so yie,
    Lebanon ntweneduro a ɔduaeɛ no.

Ɛso na nnomaa yɛ wɔn mpirebuo
    na asukɔnkɔn nso yɛ nʼatenaeɛ wɔ pepeaa nnua no mu.

Mmepɔ atentene no yɛ wiram mpɔnkye dea;
    na abotan yɛ dwanekɔbea ma amoakua.

Ɔsrane kyerɛ ɛberɛ nkyekyɛmu,
    na owia nim ɛberɛ a ɔkɔtɔ.

Wode esum ba ma ɛyɛ adesaeɛ
    na kwaeɛ mu mmoa nyinaa kɔ ahayɔ.

Gyata bobom pɛ wɔn ahaboa
    wɔhwehwɛ wɔn aduane firi Onyankopɔn hɔ.

Owia pue ma wɔsane wɔn akyi;
    wɔsane kɔdeda wɔn atuo mu.

Afei, onipa kɔ nʼadwuma so
    kɔyɛ adwuma ara kɔsi anwummerɛ.

Ɛpo na ɛda hɔ tɛtrɛɛ hahanaa yi,
    a abɔdeɛ bebree a ɛnni ano,
    akɛseɛ ne nketewa ahyɛ no ma.

Ɛso na ahyɛn di akɔneaba,
    na dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn a woyɛɛ no di agorɔ.

Wɔn nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan
    sɛ wobɛma wɔn wɔn aduane wɔ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu.

Wodema wɔn a, wɔtase;
    wobue wo nsam a, nnepa mee wɔn.

Wode wʼanim hinta wɔn a,
    wɔbɔ hu;
  sɛ wogye wɔn ahomeɛ a,
    wɔwuwu na wɔsane kɔ mfuturo mu.

Sɛ wode wo Honhom no ma wɔn a
    na wɔabɔ wɔn,
    na woyɛ asase ani foforɔ.

Ma Awurade animuonyam ntena hɔ daa;
    ma Awurade ani nnye ne nnwuma ho,

deɛ ɔhwɛ asase na ɛwosoɔ,
    na ɔde ne nsa ka mmepɔ a wisie firi mu ba.

Mɛto dwom ama Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa;
    sɛ mete ase yi, mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama me Onyankopɔn.

Ɔmma mʼakoma mu mpaeɛbɔ nsɔ nʼani
    ɛberɛ a meregye mʼani wɔ Awurade mu yi.

Ma nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nyera wɔ asase so;
    na amumuyɛfoɔ ase nhye.
    
  Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade.
    
  Kamfo Awurade.

Ɛda Awurade ase na da ne kɛseyɛ adi.
    Ma ewiase nyinaa nhunu deɛ wayɛ.

Monto dwom mma no, monto ayɛyie dwom mma no;
    monka nʼanwanwadeɛ no nyinaa.

Monhoahoa mo ho wɔ ne din kronkron mu;
    momma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no nnya akoma mu anigyeɛ.

Momma mo ani nna Awurade ne nʼahoɔden so;
    na monhwehwɛ nʼanim ɛberɛ biara.

Monkae anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ
    ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ne atemmuo a ɔbuiɛ,

Ao Abraham mma, Onyankopɔn ɔsomfoɔ,
    Ao Yakob mma a wapa wɔn.

Ɔyɛ Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn.
    Nʼahennie da adi wɔ asase so nyinaa.

Ɔkae nʼapam daa nyinaa,
    asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ apem no,

apam a ɔne Abraham yɛeɛ no
    ntam a ɔka kyerɛɛ Isak no.

Ɔhyɛɛ mu den maa Yakob sɛ mmara,
    de maa Israel sɛ apam a ɛbɛtena hɔ afebɔɔ.

Ɔkaa sɛ, “Mede Kanaan asase no bɛma wo
    sɛ kyɛfa a ɛbɛyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ.”

Ɔkaa yei ɛberɛ a na wɔnnɔɔso,
    ahɔhokuo ketewa bi a wɔwɔ Kanaan.

Wɔfirii aman so kɔɔ aman so;
    firii ahemman mu kɔɔ ahemman mu.

Wamma obi anhyɛ wɔn so;
    wɔn enti, ɔkaa ahene anim sɛ:

“Mommfa mo nsa nka wɔn a masra wɔn ngo;
    na monnyɛ mʼadiyifoɔ bɔne bi.”

Ɔmaa ɛkɔm baa asase no so
    na ɔsɛee akwan a wɔfa so nya wɔn aduane nyinaa;

na ɔsomaa ɔbarima bi dii wɔn anim,
    Yosef a wɔtɔn no sɛ akoa no.

Wɔde mpokyerɛ guu ne nan,
    na wɔde dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn hyɛɛ ne kɔn,

kɔsii sɛ deɛ ɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no baa mu,
    kɔsii sɛ Awurade asɛm no daa no adi sɛ ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ.

Afei, ɔhene no soma ma wɔkɔgyaa no;
    aman no sodifoɔ gyaa no.

Ɔyɛɛ no ne fiefoɔ so wura,
    deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa sodifoɔ,

sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne mmapɔmma deɛ ɔpɛ
    na ɔnkyerɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nyansa.

Afei, Israel kɔɔ Misraim;
    Yakob kɔtenaa Ham asase so sɛ ɔnanani.

Awurade maa ne nkurɔfoɔ ase dɔreeɛ;
    ɔyɛɛ wɔn bebree dodo maa wɔn atamfoɔ,

wɔn a ɔdanee wɔn akoma sɛ wɔntane ne nkurɔfoɔ
    na wɔmpam nʼasomfoɔ tiri so.

Ɔsomaa ne ɔsomfoɔ Mose,
    ne Aaron a na wayi noɔ no.

Wɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nwanwasoɔ wɔ wɔn mu,
    nʼanwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham asase so.

Ɔsomaa esum, na ɔmaa asase duruu sum
    ɛfiri sɛ na wɔate nʼasɛm no so atua.

Ɔmaa wɔn nsuo nyinaa danee mogya,
    nam so kumm emu mpataa.

Mpɔtorɔ bɛhyɛɛ asase no so ma,
    na wɔhyɛnee ɔman no sodifoɔ mpia mu.

Ɔkasaeɛ, na nwansena bebree
    ne ntontom baa ɔman no mu baabiara.

Ɔmaa wɔn osutɔ danee ampariboɔ
    a anyinam nenam mu wɔ ɔman no nyinaa mu;

Ɔsɛee wɔn bobe ne borɔdɔma nnua
    na ɔbubuu ɔman no so nnua pasaa.

Ɔkasaeɛ, na ntutummɛ baeɛ
    mmɛbɛ a wɔntumi nkan wɔn;

wɔwee nhahammono biara a ɛwɔ wɔn asase no so,
    na wɔdii wɔn mfuo so nnuane.

Afei ɔkunkumm wɔn asase so mmakan nyinaa,
    wɔn mmarimayɛ mu aba a ɛdi ɛkan nyinaa.

Ɔyii Israelfoɔ, a wɔso dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ,
    firii wɔn mmusuakuo mu a obiara ho antɔ kyima.

Misraim ani gyeeɛ ɛberɛ a wɔkɔeɛ,
    ɛfiri sɛ na Israelfoɔ ho hu atɔ wɔn so.

Ɔtrɛɛ omununkum mu kataa wɔn so,
    na ɔde ogya maa wɔn, sɛ ɛnyɛ hann anadwo.

Wɔbisaeɛ, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn mmoko.
    Ɔmaa ɔsoro aduane mee wɔn.

Ɔbuee ɔbotan mu maa nsuo firii mu baeɛ;
    na ɛtenee wɔ ɛserɛ no so sɛ asubɔnten.

Ɔkaee ne bɔhyɛ kronkron bi a
    ɔhyɛɛ ne ɔsomfoɔ Abraham no.

Ɔyii ne nkurɔfoɔ maa wɔn ani gyeeɛ.
    Wɔn a wapa wɔn no dii ahurisie;

ɔde amanaman no nsase maa wɔn,
    na deɛ ebinom abrɛ anya no bɛyɛɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ

na wɔahwɛ nʼahyɛdeɛ
    adi ne mmara so.
    
  Monyi Awurade ayɛ.

Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka nneɛma akɛseɛ a Awurade ayɛ?
    Anaasɛ ɔbɛtumi aka ne nkamfo awie?

Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkɔ so bu atɛntenenee,
    na daa wɔyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ.

Ao Awurade, sɛ wohunu wo nkurɔfoɔ mmɔbɔ a kae me.
    Sɛ wogye wɔn nkwa a, boa me,

na manya wɔn a wapa wɔn no yiedie mu kyɛfa,
    na manya wo manfoɔ anigyeɛ no mu kyɛfa
    na me ne wʼagyapadeɛ no abɔ mu de nkamfo ama wo.

Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛdeɛ yɛn nananom yɛeɛ no;
    yɛayɛ mfomsoɔ na yɛadi atirimuɔdensɛm.

Ɛberɛ a yɛn nananom wɔ Misraim no,
    wɔannwene wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ho;
  wɔankae wʼadɔeɛ bebrebe no,
    na wɔtee atua wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ho.

Nanso, ne din enti ɔgyee wɔn nkwa,
    sɛdeɛ ɔbɛda ne tumi kɛseɛ no adi.

Ɔteaa Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no ma ɛwee;
    ɔde wɔn faa abunu mu te sɛ ɛserɛ so.

Ɔgyee wɔn firii ɔtamfoɔ no nsam;
    deɛ ɔtane wɔn nsam na ɔyii wɔn firiiɛ.

Nsuo kataa wɔn atamfoɔ so;
    na ɔbaako mpo annya nkwa.

Afei wɔgyee ne bɔhyɛ no diiɛ
    na wɔtoo nʼayɛyie dwom.

Nanso, ntɛm so, wɔn werɛ firii deɛ wayɛ
    na wɔantwɛn nʼagyinatuo.

Akɔnnɔ bɛhyɛɛ wɔn mu wɔ ɛserɛ so hɔ,
    na wɔ asase paradada no so, wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ,

enti ɔmaa wɔn deɛ wɔbisaeɛ,
    nanso, ɔde ɔfɔn yadeɛ baa wɔn so.

Na nsraban mu hɔ wɔn ani beree Mose
    ne Aaron a Awurade ate ne ho no.

Asase mu buee na ɛmenee Datan
    na ɛsiee Abiram asafo no.

Egya tɔɔ wɔn akyidifoɔ no mu;
    ogyaframa hyee amumuyɛfoɔ no.

Wɔyɛɛ nantwie ba wɔ Horeb
    na wɔkotoo ohoni a wɔde fagudeɛ ayɛ.

Wɔsesaa wɔn Animuonyam.
    Wɔde nantwinini, a ɔwe ɛserɛ nsɛsodeɛ.

Wɔn werɛ firii Onyankopɔn a ɔgyee wɔn nkwa,
    deɛ ɔyɛɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ wɔ Misraim no,

nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɔyɛɛ wɔ Ham asase so
    ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ ho no.

Enti ɔkaa sɛ ɔbɛsɛe wɔn,
    nanso Mose a ɔyɛ deɛ wapa noɔ no
  sɔre gyinaa Onyankopɔn ne nnipa no ntam;
    ɔsrɛɛ no, dwodwoo nʼabufuo no ano sɛdeɛ ɔrensɛe wɔn.

Afei, wɔn ani ansɔ asase fɛfɛ no;
    na wɔannye ne bɔhyɛ anni.

Wɔnwiinwii wɔ wɔn ntomadan mu
    na wɔannyɛ ɔsetie amma Awurade.

Enti ɔmaa ne nsa so kaa ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ
    ɔbɛma wɔn atotɔ wɔ ɛserɛ no so,

ɔbɛma wɔn asefoɔ atotɔ wɔ amanaman mu
    na wabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase nyinaa so.

Wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ Baal-peor ho
    na wɔdii afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔde ama anyame a wɔnni nkwa;

wɔde wɔn atirimuɔdensɛm hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo
    na ɔyaredɔm sii wɔn mu.

Na Pinehas sɔre dii agyinamu,
    na Awurade sii ɔyaredɔm no ano.

Wɔde yei yɛɛ tenenee maa Pinehas
    wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛnni awieeɛ a ɛbɛba no mu.

Meriba nsuo ho nso, wɔhyɛɛ Awurade abufuo,
    na wɔn enti, ɔhaw baa Mose so,

ɛfiri sɛ wɔtee Onyankopɔn Honhom anim atua,
    na asɛm a wannwene ho firii Mose anomu.

Wɔansɛe nnipa no
    sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn no,

nanso wɔde wɔn ho frafraa amanaman no
    yɛɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no bi.

Wɔsomm wɔn ahoni
    na ɛbɛyɛɛ afidie maa wɔn.

Wɔde wɔn mmammarima
    ne wɔn mmammaa bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa abosom.

Wɔkaa mogya a ɛdi bem guiɛ;
    wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa mogya a
  wɔde bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Kanaan ahoni no
    maa asase no ho guu fi.

Wɔde deɛ wɔyɛeɛ no guu wɔn ankasa ho fi;
    wɔnam deɛ wɔyɛeɛ no so bɔɔ adwaman.

Enti, Awurade bo fuu ne nkurɔfoɔ;
    na ɔkyirii nʼagyapadeɛ.

Ɔdanee wɔn maa amanaman no,
    na wɔn atamfoɔ dii wɔn so.

Wɔn atamfoɔ hyɛɛ wɔn so
    na wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn tumi ase.

Mpɛn bebree, Awurade gyee wɔn,
    nanso wɔkɔɔ so tee atua
    na wɔsɛe wɔ wɔn bɔne mu.

Nanso ɔhunuu wɔn ahohiahia
    ɛberɛ a wɔsu frɛɛ noɔ no;

Wɔn enti, ɔkaee nʼapam no
    na ɔfirii nʼadɔeɛ kɛseɛ no mu hunuu wɔn mmɔbɔ.

Ɔmaa sodifoɔ a wɔafa wɔn nnommum no
    nyaa ahummɔborɔ maa wɔn.

Gye yɛn, Ao Awurade yɛn nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn,
    na boaboa yɛn ano firi amanaman so,
  na yɛada wo din kronkron no ase,
    na yɛde nkamfo ahyɛ wo animuonyam.

Ayɛyie nka Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn,
    ɛmfiri mmerɛsanten nkɔsi nnasanten.
    
  Momma nnipa no nyinaa nka sɛ, “Amen!”
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Monna Awurade ase na ɔyɛ;
    na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

Momma wɔn a Awurade agye wɔn nka saa,
    wɔn a wagye wɔn afiri ɔtamfoɔ nsam no,

wɔn a ɔboaboaa wɔn ano firii nsase soɔ no,
    ɛfiri apueeɛ kɔsi atɔeɛ, atifi kɔsi anafoɔ.

Ebinom kyinkyinii wɔ nsase paradada so,
    a wɔanhunu ɛkwan ankɔ kuropɔn no mu, baabi a wɔbɛtumi anya atenaeɛ.

Ɛkɔm ne sukɔm dee wɔn
    na wɔtotɔɔ baha.

Afei wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu,
    na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

Ɔde wɔn faa ɛkwan tee so
    baa kuropɔn a wɔtumi tena mu no mu.

Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho
    ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

Ɔma wɔn a sukɔm de wɔn nsuo
    na ɔde nnepa hyɛ wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn ma.

Ebinom tenaa esum ne awerɛhoɔ mu,
    nneduafoɔ a wɔde dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn agu wɔn,

ɛfiri sɛ, wɔtee Onyankopɔn nsɛm ho atua
    na wɔbuu Ɔsorosoroni no agyinatuo animtiaa.

Enti ɔgyaa wɔn maa adwuma den;
    wɔsuntisuntiiɛ na wɔannya ɔboafoɔ.

Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu,
    na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

Ɔyii wɔn firii esum ne awerɛhoɔ mu
    na ɔbubuu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.

Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho
    ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

Ɔbubu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ apono
    na ɔtwitwa nnadeban mu.

Ebinom bɛyɛɛ nkwaseafoɔ, wɔn atuateɛ enti
    na wɔhunuu amane, wɔn nnebɔne enti.

Wɔkyirii aduane nyinaa
    na wɔtwe bɛnee owuo ɛpono ano.

Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu
    na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

Ɔsomaa nʼasɛm na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ;
    na ɔgyee wɔn firii ɛda mu.

Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho
    ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

Momma wɔmmɔ aseda afɔdeɛ
    na wɔmfa ahurisie nnwom nka ne nnwuma ho asɛm.

Ebinom tenaa ahyɛn mu wɔ ɛpo so;
    wɔyɛ adwadifoɔ wɔ nsuo akɛseɛ so.

Wɔhunuu Awurade nnwuma,
    nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɛwɔ ebunu mu.

Ɔkasaeɛ maa ahum tui
    na ɛkukuruu asorɔkye.

Wɔpagya kɔɔ sorosoro na wɔsiane kɔɔ ebunu mu tɔnn;
    wɔn amanehunu mu no wɔn bo tui.

Wɔkyim totɔɔ ntintan sɛ asabofoɔ;
    na wɔnhunu deɛ wɔnnyɛ bio.

Afei, wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn amanehunu mu,
    na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahohiahia mu.

Ɔmaa ahum no yɛɛ dinn;
    ɛpo so asorɔkye ano brɛɛ ase.

Wɔn ani gyeeɛ ɛberɛ a ɛyɛɛ dinn no,
    na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn ɛkwan de wɔn kɔduruu gyinabea a wɔpɛ.

Momma wɔnna Awurade ase, nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da ho
    ne nʼanwanwadeɛ a ɔyɛ ma nnipa.

Wɔmma ne so wɔ asafo no mu
    na wɔnkamfo no wɔ mpanimfoɔ nhyiamu ase.

Ɔdanee nsubɔntene maa no yɛɛ ɛserɛ,
    asutene yɛɛ asase wesee,

na asasebereɛ danee nkyenenkyene,
    wɔn a wɔte asase no so amumuyɛ enti.

Ɔdanee ɛserɛ so maa no yɛɛ nsuwansuwa
    na nkyɛkyerɛ yɛɛ sɛ asutene ananmu;

Ɛhɔ na ɔde wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn kɔsoɛe,
    na wɔkyekyeree kuropɔn tenaa mu.

Wɔyɛɛ mfuo ne bobe nturo
    na ɛmaa wɔn nnɔbaeɛ bebree.

Ɔhyiraa wɔn na wɔn ase dɔreeɛ.
    Wamma wɔn ayɛmmoa dodoɔ so anhwan.

Afei wɔn dodoɔ so hwaneeɛ
    na nhyɛsoɔ, amanehunu ne awerɛhoɔ brɛɛ wɔn ase;

deɛ ɔbu aberempɔn animtiaa no
    ma wɔkyinkyinii asase bonini a ɛkwan nni hɔ so.

Nanso, ɔpagyaa ahiafoɔ firii wɔn ahohia mu
    na ɔmaa wɔn mmusua dɔree sɛ nnwankuo.

Ateneneefoɔ bɛhunu ama wɔn ani gye,
    nanso amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa bɛmua wɔn ano.

Momma deɛ ɔyɛ onyansafoɔ no mmu yeinom,
    na ɔnnwene Awurade adɔeɛ kɛseɛ no ho.

Ao Onyankopɔn, mʼakoma atɔ me yam;
    mede me kra nyinaa bɛto wʼayɛyie dwom.

Monyane, sankuo ne bɛnta!
    Mɛnyane anɔpahema.

Ao Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu;
    mɛto wo ho dwom wɔ nnipa no mu.

Wʼadɔeɛ so, ɛkorɔn sene ɔsoro;
    wo nokorɛdie duru ewiem.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro,
    na ama wʼanimuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.

Fa wo nsa nifa gye yɛn na boa yɛn,
    na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.

Onyankopɔn akasa afiri ne kronkronbea sɛ,
    “Nkonim mu na mɛkyɛ Sekem mu
    na masusu Sukot Bɔnhwa.

Hwan na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?
    Hwan na ɔbɛdi mʼanim akɔ Edom?

Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛnyɛ wo na woapo yɛn?
    Wo ne yɛn nsraadɔm renkɔ ɔsa bio anaa?

Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfoɔ no,
    na ɔdasani mmoa nka hwee.

Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yɛbɛdi nkonim,
    na ɔbɛtiatia yɛn atamfoɔ so.

Ao Onyankopɔn a mekamfo woɔ,
    mmua wʼano,

Wɔde nitansɛm atwa me ho ahyia
    na wɔto hyɛ me so a menkaa wɔn.

Wɔka nsɛm to me so de tua me nnamfoyɛ so ka,
    nanso meyɛ obi a ɔpɛ mpaeɛbɔ.

Wɔde bɔne tua me papayɛ so ka,
    na wɔde ɔtan tua me nnamfoyɛ so ka.

Ma onipa bɔne bi nsɔre ntia no;
    na Satan nnyina ne nsa nifa so.

Wɔdi nʼasɛm a, ma ɔnni fɔ,
    na ne mpaeɛbɔ mmu no kumfɔ.

Ma ne nkwa nna nyɛ kakraa bi;
    na ɔfoforɔ nsi nʼanan mu sɛ ɔkandifoɔ.

Ma ne mma nyɛ nwisiaa
    na ne yere nyɛ okunafoɔ.

Ma ne mma nkyinkyini nsrɛsrɛ adeɛ;
    ma wɔmpam wɔn mfiri wɔn afie a abubuo no mu.

Ma ɔdefirifoɔ bi mfa deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa;
    na amanfrafoɔ mfom nʼadwuma so aba.

Mma obiara nhunu no mmɔbɔ
    Mma obiara nhunu ne nwisiaa nso mmɔbɔ.

Ma nʼase nhye,
    na wɔn din nyera wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛreba no mu.

Ma wɔnkae nʼagyanom nnebɔne wɔ Awurade anim;
    na ne maame bɔne no ntena hɔ daa.

Wɔn bɔne nyinaa nka Awurade anim,
    na wɔankae wɔn bio wɔ asase so.

Ɛfiri sɛ wannwene da sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adɔeɛ,
    na mmom ɔtaa ahiafoɔ
    mmɔborɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahoɔ de kɔɔ owuo mu.

Nʼani gyee sɛ ɔbɛdome
    enti nnome mmra ne so;
  wampɛ sɛ ɔbɛhyira
    enti nhyira mmɔ no.

Ma ɛnyɛ sɛ atadeɛ a ɛkyekyere ne ho,
    ne abɔsoɔ a ɛbɔ no daa.

Ma yei nyɛ Awurade akatua a ɔde ma me kwaadubɔfoɔ,
    wɔn a wɔka nsɛmmɔne fa me ho no.

Ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ohiani ne deɛ onnibie,
    na mʼakoma atɔ baha wɔ me mu.

Metwam sɛ anwummerɛ sunsumma;
    wɔwoso me kyene sɛ ntutummɛ.

Abuadadie ama me kotodwe mu agogo;
    mafɔn na ama aka me nnompe.

Mayɛ aseredeɛ ama wɔn a wɔbɔ me soboɔ;
    sɛ wohunu me a, wɔwoso wɔn ti.

Boa me, Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn;
    gye me sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ.

Ma wɔnhunu sɛ ɛyɛ wo nsa,
    na wo na woayɛ, Ao Awurade.

Animguaseɛ bɛdura mʼatamfoɔ ho;
    na akyekyere wɔn ho sɛ atadeɛ.

Mede mʼano bɛma Awurade so ayɛ no kɛseɛ;
    mɛkamfo no wɔ nnipadɔm mu.

Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔgyina onnibie nsa nifa so
    sɛ ɔbɛgye no nkwa afiri wɔn a wɔbu no kumfɔ nsam.

Awurade mu na mede me werɛ ahyɛ.
    Adɛn na wotumi ka kyerɛ me sɛ,
    “Tu te sɛ anomaa kɔ wo bepɔ so.

Na hwɛ, amumuyɛfoɔ akuntunu wɔn tadua mu,
    na wɔde wɔn mmɛmma asisi nhoma so
  sɛ wɔbɛto wɔ esum mu
    de awɔ akoma mu ahotefoɔ.

Sɛ wɔresɛe fapem no a,
    ɛdeɛn na ɔteneneeni bɛtumi ayɛ?”

Awurade wɔ nʼasɔredan kronkron no mu;
    Awurade te ne soro ahennwa so.
  Ɔhwɛ nnipa mma,
    nʼani hwehwɛ wɔn mu.

Awurade hwehwɛ ɔteneneeni mu,
    na amumuyɛfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ basabasayɛ deɛ,
    ne kra kyiri wɔn.

Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me Wura sɛ,
    “Tena me nifa so
  kɔsi sɛ mede wʼatamfoɔ
    bɛyɛ wo nan ntiasoɔ.”

Awurade bɛtrɛ wʼahempoma denden mu afiri Sion;
    na wobɛdi ɔhene wɔ wʼatamfoɔ so.

Wʼakodɔm bɛyi wɔn akoma mu
    ɛda a wobɛkɔ sa.
  Tumi kronkron bɛyɛ wʼaduradeɛ
    na wo mmabunu bɛba wo nkyɛn
    sɛdeɛ bosuo gugu anɔpahema.

Awurade aka ntam
    na ɔrensesa nʼadwene:
  “Woyɛ daapem ɔsɔfoɔ
    te sɛ Melkisedek sɛso.”

Awurade wɔ wo nifa so;
    ɔbɛdwerɛ ahemfo wɔ nʼabufuhyeɛ da no.

Ɔbɛbu amanaman atɛn aboaboa afunu ano;
    na wadwerɛ sodifoɔ a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa.

Ɔbɛnom asuwa a ɛda ɛkwan nkyɛn mu nsuo
    enti ɔbɛdi nkonim.
  Ɔhene no bɛnom asuwa a ɛda kwankyɛn mu nsuo,
    na wanya ahoɔden, na wagyina nkonimdie mu.

Monkamfo Awurade!
    
  Mɛfiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu ama Awurade so
    wɔ ateneneefoɔ adwabɔ ne asafo no mu.

Awurade nnwuma yɛ kɛseɛ;
    wɔn a wɔn ani gye ho nyinaa susu ho.

Ne nnwuma yɛ tumi ne animuonyam,
    na ne tenenee wɔ hɔ daa.

Ɔma yɛkae nʼanwanwadeɛ;
    Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ.

Ɔma wɔn a wosuro no no aduane;
    ɔkae nʼapam no daa.

Wakyerɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ tumi a ɛwɔ ne nnwuma mu,
    sɛ ɔde aman afoforɔ nsase ama wɔn.

Ne nsa ano nnwuma yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene;
    nʼahyɛdeɛ nyinaa mu wɔ ahotosoɔ.

Ɛtim hɔ daa daa,
    nokorɛ ne tenenee mu na ɔyɛeɛ.

Monkamfo Awurade.
    
  Nhyira nka onipa a ɔsuro Awurade
    na ɔnya nʼahyɛdeɛ mu anigyeɛ pii.

Ne mma bɛyɛ atumfoɔ wɔ asase no so;
    teneneefoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bɛnya nhyira.

Ahonya ne sika wɔ ne fie,
    na ne tenenee tena hɔ daa.

Esum mu mpo hann pue ma nnipa a wɔtene,
    ma ɔdomfoɔ, mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔnokwafoɔ.

Yiedie bɛba deɛ ne tirim yɛ mmrɛ na ɔde fɛm kwa.
    Yiedie bɛba deɛ ɔde atɛntenenee yɛ ne nneɛma so.

Ampa ara, ɔrenhinhim da biara da;
    wɔbɛkae onipa tenenee daa.

Ɔte asɛmmɔne a, ɛmmɔ ne hu;
    nʼakoma atim wɔ Awurade mu ahotosoɔ mu.

Nʼakoma wɔ banbɔ, na ɔnsuro;
    awieeɛ no, ɔde nkonimdie bɛhyia nʼatamfoɔ.

Monkamfo Awurade.
    
  Ao, mo Awurade asomfoɔ, monkamfo no,
    monkamfo Awurade din.

Momma wɔnkamfo Awurade din,
    seesei ne daa nyinaa.

Ɛfiri baabi a owia pue kɔsi faako a ɔkɔtɔ,
    ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din.

Wɔama Awurade so aman nyinaa so,
    nʼanimuonyam tra ɔsorosoro.

Hwan na ɔte sɛ Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn,
    Ɔbaako no a ɔdi ɔhene wɔ ɔsorosoro,

ɔno na ɔbɔ ne mu ase
    hwɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase.

Ɔma ahiafoɔ so firi mfuturo mu
    na ɔpagya onnibie firi nso sie so;

ɔde wɔn tena mmapɔmma mu,
    wɔn nkurɔfoɔ mmapɔmma mu.

Ɔbɔ obonini atenaseɛ wɔ ne fie
    sɛ ɔbaatan a nʼani gyeɛ.
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ firii Misraim,
    na Yakob fiefoɔ firii ananafoɔ asase so no,

    mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.

Momfiri me so nkɔ, mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ,
    na menni me Onyankopɔn mmaransɛm so!

Wowa me sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ, na mɛtena nkwa mu;
    mma mʼanidasoɔ nyɛ kwa.

Sɔ me mu, na menya nkwagyeɛ;
    na ɛberɛ biara mɛhwɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no.

Wopo wɔn a wɔfom wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm nyinaa,
    na wɔn nnaadaa no yɛ ɔkwa.

Woyi amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa si nkyɛn sɛ dadeben;
    enti medɔ wʼahyɛdeɛ.

Wo ho suro ma me ho popo;
    wo mmara abɔ me hu.

Mayɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ pɛ.
    Nnyaa me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me soɔ!

Hwɛ ma wo ɔsomfoɔ nni yie;
    mma ahantanfoɔ nhyɛ me so.

Mahwɛ wo nkwagyeɛ anim ama mʼani abu,
    ɛrehwehwɛ wo bɔhyɛ a ɛtene no.

Wo ne wo ɔsomfoɔ nni no sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ
    na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

Meyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ; ma me nhunumu
    na mate wʼahyɛdeɛ ase.

Ao Awurade, ɛberɛ aso sɛ woyɛ biribi;
    wɔrebu wo mmara so.

Esiane sɛ medɔ wo mmaransɛm
    sene sikakɔkɔɔ, anaa sikakɔkɔɔ amapa,

na medwene sɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa yɛ enti
    mekyiri ɛkwan bɔne biara.

Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ nwanwa;
    enti medi so.

Wo nsɛm ase teɛ ma hann;
    na ɛma ntetekwaa nya nteaseɛ.

Mebue mʼanom na megu ahome,
    na mʼani gyina wo mmaransɛm.

Dane wʼani hwɛ me na hunu me mmɔbɔ
    sɛdeɛ woyɛ daa ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.

Tutu mʼanammɔn sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no teɛ.
    Mma bɔne biara nni me so.

Gye me firi nnipa nhyɛsoɔ mu,
    na madi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.

Ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wo ɔsomfoɔ so
    na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

Nisuo adware me sɛ asutene
    ɛfiri sɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so.

Ɔteneneeni ne wo, Ao Awurade,
    na wo mmara nso yɛ pɛ.

Ahyɛdeɛ a woayɛ no tene;
    ɛyɛ deɛ wɔnya mu ahotosoɔ pa ara.

Abufuo ahyɛ me ma,
    ɛfiri sɛ mʼatamfoɔ bu wɔn ani gu wo nsɛm no.

Wɔasɔ wo bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no ahwɛ pa ara,
    na wo ɔsomfoɔ dɔ wɔn.

Ɛwom sɛ mennka hwee na memfra deɛ,
    nanso me werɛ mfiri wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.

Wo tenenee wɔ hɔ daa
    na wo mmara no yɛ nokorɛ.

Ɔhaw ne ahohiahia aduru me,
    nanso wo mmaransɛm ma me ahosɛpɛ.

Wʼahyɛdeɛ yɛ nokorɛ daa;
    ma me nteaseɛ na manya nkwa.

Ao Awurade, mede mʼakoma nyinaa mefrɛ wo, gye me so,
    na mɛdi wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no so.

Mesu mefrɛ wo, gye me nkwa
    na medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so.

Mesɔre anɔpahema, na mesu pɛ mmoa;
    mede me werɛ ahyɛ wo nsɛm mu.

Mʼani gu so anadwo nyinaa,
    na mɛdwendwene wo bɔhyɛ ho.

Tie me nne sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ no teɛ;
    Ao Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo mmara teɛ.

Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ atirimuɔdensɛm no abɛn,
    nanso wɔne wo mmara ntam ware.

Ao Awurade, wo deɛ, wobɛn me,
    na wo mmaransɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ.

Mmerɛ bi a atwam no, mesuaa wʼahyɛdeɛ
    a wode timiiɛ hɔ sɛ ɛntena hɔ daa no.

Hwɛ mʼamanehunu na gye me nkwa
    ɛfiri sɛ me werɛ mfirii wo mmara no.

Di mʼasɛm ma me na gye me.
    Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

Nkwagyeɛ ne atirimuɔdenfoɔ ntam kwan ware,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm no.

Ao Awurade, wʼayamhyehyeɛ yɛ kɛseɛ;
    kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wo mmara no teɛ.

Atamfoɔ a wɔteetee me dɔɔso,
    nanso memmane memfirii wo nhyehyɛeɛ ho.

Mehwɛ wɔn a wɔnni gyidie no a, wɔn ho yɛ me nwunu,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni wʼasɛm so.

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼani gye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho;
    Ao Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ.

Wo nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ;
    na wo mmara a ɛtene no to rentwa da.

Sodifoɔ taataa me kwa,
    nanso ɛyɛ wʼasɛm nko ara na mesuro.

Mʼani gye wo bɔhyɛ ho
    te sɛ obi a wanya asadeɛ kɛseɛ.

Mekyiri nkontompo
    na medɔ wo mmara.

Mekamfo wo mprɛnson da biara
    wo mmara a ɛtene no enti.

Wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara no wɔ asomdwoeɛ mmoroso,
    na biribiara rentumi mma wɔnsunti.

Ao Awurade, metwɛn wo nkwagyeɛ,
    na medi wo mmaransɛm so.

Medi wʼahyɛdeɛ so
    na medɔ no yie.

Medi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wʼahyɛdeɛ so,
    na wonim mʼakwan nyinaa.

Ao Awurade, ma me sufrɛ nnuru wʼanim;
    ma me nteaseɛ sɛdeɛ wʼasɛm no teɛ.

Ma me nkotosrɛ nnuru wʼanim;
    na gye me sɛdeɛ wo bɔhyɛ no teɛ.

Ma nkamfo nhyɛ mʼanom ma;
    ɛfiri sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me wo ɔhyɛ nsɛm.

Ma me tɛkrɛma nto wʼasɛm ho dwom,
    ɛfiri sɛ wo mmaransɛm nyinaa tene.

Yɛ ahoboa bɛboa me,
    ɛfiri sɛ masɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.

Ao Awurade, mʼani agyina wo nkwagyeɛ,
    na wo mmara yɛ mʼanigyedeɛ.

Ma me ntena nkwa mu na matumi akamfo wo,
    na wo mmara nso awowa me.

Mafom ɛkwan sɛ odwan a wayera.
    Hwehwɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ,
    ɛfiri sɛ me werɛ mfirii wo mmaransɛm no.

Boa yɛn, Awurade, na nyamesurofoɔ asa;
    nokwafoɔ ayera wɔ nnipa mu.

Obiara di atorɔ kyerɛ ne yɔnko;
    wɔn ano a ɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ no ka nnaadaasɛm.

Ma Awurade ntwa nnaadaa ano
    ne tɛkrɛma biara a ɛhoahoa ne ho ntwene;

wɔn a wɔse, “Yɛde yɛn tɛkrɛma bɛdi nkonim;
    yɛn ano yɛ yɛn dea, na hwan ne yɛn wura?”

“Esiane nhyɛ a wɔde hyɛ mmɔborɔni no
    ne ohiani apenesie no enti,
  mɛsɔre afei,” Awurade na ɔseɛ.
    “Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afiri wɔn a wɔha wɔn ho.”

Awurade asɛm yɛ nokorɛ
    te sɛ dwetɛ a wɔasɔne so wɔ fononoo mu,
    na wɔahoa ho mprɛnson.

Ao Awurade, wobɛkora yɛn
    na woabɔ yɛn ho ban afebɔɔ afiri saa abɔnefoɔ yi ho,

abɔnefoɔ a wɔnenam sɛdeɛ wɔpɛ
    ɛberɛ a adasamma de anidie ma afideɛ.

Mesu frɛ Awurade wɔ mʼahohiahia mu,
    na ɔgye me so.

Ao Awurade, gye me firi atorɔ ano
    ne nnaadaa tɛkrɛma nsam.

Ɛdeɛn na ɔbɛyɛ wo,
    na ɛdeɛn na ɛka ho bio, Ao nnaadaa tɛkrɛma?

Ɔde asraafoɔ bɛmma a ano yɛ nnam
    ne gyasramma bɛtwe wʼaso.

Nnome nka me sɛ mabɛsoɛ Mesek,
    na mete Kedar ntomadan mu!

Matena ase akyɛre dodo
    wɔ wɔn a wɔkyiri asomdwoeɛ mu.

Meyɛ asomdwoeɛ onipa;
    nanso sɛ mekasa a, ɛyɛ ɔko ma wɔn.

Mema mʼani so kyerɛ mmepɔ no,
    ɛhe na me mmoa firi bɛba?

Me mmoa firi Awurade,
    ɔsoro ne asase yɛfoɔ no.

Ɔremma wo nan nwatiri,
    deɛ ɔhwɛ wo no, ɔrentɔ nko.

Ampa ara deɛ ɔhwɛ Israel no
    rentɔ nko na ɔrenna.

Awurade hwɛ wo so;
    Awurade ne wo nwunu wɔ wo nsa nifa so;

Owia renhye wo wɔ awiaberɛ mu,
    na ɔsrane nso renha wo anadwo.

Awurade bɛbɔ wo ho ban afiri ɔhaw nyinaa ho,
    ɔbɛhwɛ wo nkwa so;

Awurade bɛhwɛ wʼadifire ne wo efieba so,
    seesei ne daa.

Ɛberɛ a wɔsee me sɛ,
    “Ma yɛnkɔ Awurade fie” no, mʼani gyeeɛ.

Yɛgyinagyina wʼapono ano,
    Ao Yerusalem.

Wɔakyekyere Yerusalem yie sɛ kuropɔn.
    Wɔahyehyɛ mu nneɛma fɛfɛ.

Ɛhɔ na mmusuakuo no korɔ,
    Awurade mmusuakuo no.
  Wɔkɔkamfo Awurade din
    sɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ama Israel no teɛ.

Ɛhɔ na atemmuo nhennwa no sisi,
    Dawid fie nhennwa no.

Monsrɛ asomdwoeɛ mma Yerusalem sɛ,
    “Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo no nnya banbɔ.

Ma asomdwoeɛ mmra wʼafasuo mu
    na banbɔ mmra wʼabankɛsewa mu.”

Me nuanom ne me nnamfonom enti,
    meka sɛ, “Asomdwoeɛ ntena wo mu.”

Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn fie enti,
    mɛhwehwɛ wo nkɔsoɔ.

Mema mʼani so kyerɛ wo,
    wo a wʼahennwa si ɔsoro.

Sɛdeɛ nkoa ani hwɛ wɔn wura nsa no,
    sɛdeɛ afenaa ani hwɛ nʼawurakwaa nsa no,
  saa ara na yɛn ani hwɛ Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn
    kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu yɛn mmɔbɔ.

Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Ao Awurade, hunu yɛn mmɔbɔ,
    na wɔabu yɛn animtia bebree.

Ahomasofoɔ fɛdie ama yɛabrɛ dodo;
    ahantanfoɔ animtiabuo afono yɛn.

Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa a,
    ma Israel nka.

Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa
    ɛberɛ a nnipa to hyɛɛ yɛn so,

ɛberɛ a wɔn abufuo sɔree tiaa yɛn a,
    anka wɔmenee yɛn anikann;

anka nsuyire no bu faa yɛn so,
    anka ɔhweam no twee yɛn kɔeɛ,

anka nsuo a ano yɛ den no
    afa yɛn kɔ.

Nkamfoɔ nka Awurade a
    wɔamma ho kwan amma wɔamfa wɔn se antete yɛn mu.

Yɛadwane sɛ anomaa
    afiri afirisumfoɔ afidie mu;
  afidie no mu abubu,
    ama yɛanya ɛkwan adwane.

Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade din mu,
    ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfoɔ no.

Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no te sɛ Bepɔ Sion,
    a ɛnwosoɔ na ɛtim hɔ daa.

Sɛdeɛ mmepɔ atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no,
    saa ara na Awurade atwa ne nkurɔfoɔ ho ahyia
    seesei ne daa.

Amumuyɛfoɔ ahempoma renka asase a
    wɔde ama teneneefoɔ so.
  Sɛ ɛba saa a, teneneefoɔ
    nam wɔn so bɛyɛ bɔne.

Ao Awurade, wɔn a wɔyɛ papa no, yɛ wɔn papa,
    wɔn a wɔtene wɔ akoma mu no, yɛ wɔn papa.

Na wɔn a wɔmane fa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no deɛ,
    Awurade bɛpamo wɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ.
    
  Asomdwoeɛ nka Israel.

Ɛberɛ a Awurade de Sion firi nnommum sane baeɛ no,
    yɛyɛɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔasoso adaeɛ.

Sereɛ hyɛɛ yɛn anomu ma,
    anigyeɛ nnwom yɛɛ yɛn tɛkrɛma so ma.
  Na wɔkaa wɔ amanaman no mu sɛ,
    “Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ ama wɔn.”

Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ ama yɛn
    na anigyeɛ ahyɛ yɛn ma.

Ao Awurade, sane fa yɛn ahonya ma yɛn,
    te sɛ nsuwa nsuwa a ɛwɔ Negeb no.

Wɔn a wɔdua no nisuo mu no
    de anigyeɛ nnwom bɛtwa.

Deɛ ɔde osu firi adie
    na ɔsoa aba kɔdua no,
  ɔde anigyeɛ nnwom bɛsane aba
    a ɔso nnɔbaeɛ afiafi.

Sɛ Awurade ansi ɛdan no a,
    adansifoɔ no yɛ ho adwuma kwa.
  Sɛ Awurade ammɔ kuropɔn no ho ban a,
    awɛmfoɔ no wɛn kwa.

Ɔkwa ara na wosɔre anɔpahema
    na woyɛ adwumaden brɛ kɔsi anadwo,
  ansa na woanya wʼano aduane.
    Ɛyɛ kwa, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no, ɔma wɔda.

Mmammarima yɛ agyapadeɛ a ɛfiri Awurade hɔ,
    na mma yɛ akatua a ɛfiri noɔ.

Mmammarima a wɔwo wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu no
    te sɛ agyan a ɛhyɛ ɔsraani nsam.

Nhyira ne onipa a
    nʼagyan kotokuo ayɛ ma.
  Wɔn anim rengu ase
    ɛberɛ a wɔahyia wɔn atamfoɔ wɔ kuro ɛpono ano.

Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade,
    na wɔnante nʼakwan so.

Wobɛdi wʼadwuma so aba;
    nhyira ne yiedie bɛyɛ wo dea.

Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛso aba
    wɔ wo fie;
  na wo mmammarima ayɛ sɛ ngo dua a afifiri
    atwa wo ɛpono ho ahyia.

Yei ne onipa a wɔahyira noɔ,
    deɛ ɔsuro Awurade no.

na ɔmma wo ntena ase nhunu wo mma mma.
    Asomdwoeɛ nka Israel.

“Wɔahyɛ me so pii firi me mmɔfraase,
    ma Israel nka.

“Wɔahyɛ me so pii firi me mmɔfraase,
    nanso wɔntumi nnii me so nkonim.

Fentemfoɔ afentem mʼakyi
    ayɛ wɔn nkofie atentene.

Nanso Awurade yɛ ɔteneneeni;
    Watwitwa amumuyɛfoɔ nhoma afiri me ho.”

Ma wɔn a wɔtan Sion nyinaa
    mfa animguaseɛ nsane wɔn akyi.

Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɛserɛ a ɛwɔ ɔdan atifi,
  ɛnnyini na ahye;

Ɛremma otwafoɔ nya biribi wɔ ne nsam,
    na deɛ ɔboaboa ano nso renya hwee nʼabasa so.

Ao, Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Wo werɛ bɛfiri me afebɔɔ anaa?
    Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wode wʼanim bɛhinta me?

Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mene mʼadwendwene bɛdi apereapereɛ
    na awerɛhoɔ ahyɛ mʼakoma mu daa?
    Mʼatamfoɔ nni me so nkonim nkɔsi da bɛn?

Te wʼani hwɛ me na bua me, Ao, Awurade, me Onyankopɔn.
    Ma mʼani so nyɛ hann, na manna owuo nna.

Me ɔtamfoɔ bɛka sɛ, “Madi ne so nkonim.”
    Na mʼahohiahiafoɔ bɛdi ahurisie ɛberɛ a mahwe ase.

Nanso mede me ho to wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no so;
    mʼakoma di ahurisie wɔ wo nkwagyeɛ mu.

Mɛto dwom ama Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔne me adi no yie.
Ao Awurade, mefiri ebunu mu resu frɛ wo;

Ao Awurade tie me nne.
  Wɛn wʼaso
    ma me nkotosrɛ.

Ao Awurade, sɛ wobu yɛn bɔne ho nkonta a,
    anka hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ano?

Nanso, wowɔ bɔnefakyɛ;
    ɛno enti wɔsuro wo.

Metwɛn Awurade, me kra twɛn,
    na nʼasɛm mu na mede mʼanidasoɔ ahyɛ.

Me kra twɛne Awurade
    sene sɛdeɛ awɛmfoɔ twɛne adekyeɛ,
    sene sɛdeɛ awɛmfoɔ twene adekyeɛ.

Ao Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,
    ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wɔ adɔeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ daa
    na ɔgyeɛ amapa wɔ ne mu.

Ɔno ankasa bɛgye Israel
    afiri wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu.

Ao Awurade, ahomasoɔ nni mʼakoma mu,
    na mʼani ntraa ntɔn;
  memma nsɛm akɛseɛ nha me
    anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwanwa dodo ma me.

Na mmom, mama me kra anya abotɔyam
    te sɛ akɔkoaa a ɔda ne maame so renum no,
  te sɛ akɔkoaa a ɔtua nufoɔ ano no,
    saa ara na me kra ayɛ wɔ me mu.

Ao Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,
    seesei ne daa nyinaa.

Ao Awurade kae Dawid
    ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ a ɔgyinaa ano no.

Ɔkaa Awurade ntam
    na ɔhyɛɛ Yakob Otumfoɔ no bɔ sɛ,

“Merenhyɛne me fie
    na merenkɔda me mpa so,

meremma nna mfa me
    na meremma mʼani nkum,

kɔsi sɛ menya baabi ama Awurade,
    baabi a Yakob Otumfoɔ no bɛtena.”

Yɛtee wɔ Efrata,
    yɛbɛtoo so wɔ Yaar mfuo so.

“Momma yɛnkɔ nʼatenaeɛ;
    momma yɛnsom wɔ ne nan ntiasoɔ hɔ.

‘Ao Awurade, sɔre bra wʼahomegyebea,
    wo ne wo tumi Adaka no.

Ma tenenee nyɛ sɛ ntadeɛ mma wʼasɔfoɔ;
    ma wʼahotefoɔ nto ahurisie dwom.’ ”

Wo ɔsomfoɔ Dawid enti,
    nyi wʼani mfiri deɛ woasra no ngo no so.

Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid,
    nokorɛ ntam a ɔrentwe nsane sɛ,
  “Wʼasefoɔ no mu baako
    na mede no bɛtena wʼahennwa so.

Sɛ wo mmammarima di mʼapam so
    na wɔtie me nkyerɛkyerɛ a,
  ɛnneɛ wɔn mmammarima bɛtena
    wʼahennwa so afebɔɔ.”

Awurade ayi Sion,
  ɔde hɔ ayɛ nʼatenaeɛ:

“Ɛha ne mʼahomegyebea daa nyinaa;
    ɛha na mɛtena adi ɔhene, ɛfiri sɛ ɛha na mepɛ,

mede nneɛma pa bebree bɛhyira no
    na mama nʼahiafoɔ adidi amee.

Mede nkwagyeɛ bɛfira nʼasɔfoɔ
    na nʼahotefoɔ ato ahurisie dwom daa.

“Mɛma ɔberempɔn bi apue wɔ Dawid ahennie mu
    na mede kanea asi hɔ ama deɛ masra no ngo no.

Mede aniwuo bɛfira nʼatamfoɔ,
    nanso nʼahenkyɛ bɛhyerɛn wɔ ne tiri so.”

Hwɛ ɛyɛ a ɛyɛ ne fɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ
    sɛ anuanom bom tena faako!

Ɛte sɛ ngo a ɛsom bo a wɔahwie agu apampam,
    na ɛsiane kɔgu bɔgyesɛ mu,
  ɛsiane kɔgu Aaron bɔgyesɛ mu,
    ma ebi kɔgu nʼatadeɛ abakɔn so.

Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosuo a
    ɛtɔ gu Bepɔ Sion so.
  Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ ne nhyira,
    nkwa a ɛtoɔ ntwa da no.

Awurade asomfoɔ nyinaa, monkamfo Awurade,
    mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fie anadwo nyinaa.

Momma mo nsa so wɔ kronkronbea hɔ
    na monkamfo Awurade.

Awurade a ɔbɔɔ soro ne asase no,
    mfiri Sion nhyira mo.

mo a mosom wɔ Awurade fie,
    wɔ adihɔ a ɛwɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn fie.

Monkamfo Awurade ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ;
    monto ayɛyie dwom mma ne din, na ɛno na ɛyɛ anisɔ.

Awurade ayi Yakob sɛ ɔnyɛ ne deɛ,
    wayi Israel sɛ nʼadeɛ a ɛsom bo.

Menim sɛ Awurade so;
    Ɔso sene anyame nyinaa.

Awurade yɛ deɛ ɔpɛ biara,
    wɔ ɔsoro ne asase so,
    ɛpo ne emu abunu nyinaa.

Ɔkumm Misraim mmakan,
    nnipa ne mmoa mmakan.

Ɔsomaa ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne nʼanwanwadeɛ baa mo mfimfini, Ao Misraim,
    de tiaa Farao ne nʼasomfoɔ nyinaa.

Ɔsɛee amanaman pii
    na ɔkunkumm ahemfo akɛseɛ,

Amorifoɔ ɔhene, Sihon
    Basan ɔhene, Og
    ne Kanaan ahemfo nyinaa,

na ɔde wɔn nsase maa sɛ agyapadeɛ;

Ao Awurade, wo din wɔ hɔ daa.
    Ao Awurade wo din ahyeta awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Awurade bɛdi ama ne nkurɔfoɔ
  na ɔbɛhunu nʼasomfoɔ mmɔbɔ.

Amanaman no ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ
    a wɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.

Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔntumi nkasa,
    wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ;

wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm,
    na ahomeɛ nso nni wɔn anom.

Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,
    saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.

Monkamfo Awurade, Ao Israel fiefoɔ;
    monkamfo Awurade, Ao Aaron fiefoɔ;

monkamfo Awurade, Ao Lewi fiefoɔ;
    monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosuro no.

Momfiri Sion nkamfo Awurade,
    monkamfo deɛ ɔte Yerusalem no.

na ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii wɔn mu no.

na ɔde Israelfoɔ faa mfimfini no.

Babilonia nsubɔntene ho, ɛhɔ na yɛtena suiɛ
    ɛberɛ a yɛkaee Sion no.

Ɛhɔ nsukakye nnua so
    na yɛde yɛn asankuo sensɛneeɛ,

Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi ato Awurade nnwom
    ɛberɛ a yɛwɔ ananafoɔ asase so?

Ao Yerusalem, sɛ mewerɛ firi wo a
    ma me nsa nifa werɛ mfiri sankubɔ.

Sɛ mankae wo sɛ mʼanigyedeɛ kɛseɛ pa ara a,
    ma me tɛkrɛma nka mfam mʼanomu.

Ao Awurade, kae deɛ Edomfoɔ yɛeɛ
    wɔ ɛda a Yerusalem hwee ase no.
  Wɔteam sɛ, “Monnwiri,
    monnwiri ngu fam nkɔka nʼafapem!”

Ao Babilonia babaa a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wo,
    nhyira nka deɛ ɔtua wo ka
    wɔ deɛ wode ayɛ yɛn so.

Nhyira nka deɛ ɔkyekyee wo nkokoaa
    de wɔn bobɔɔ abotan so.

Ao Awurade, mɛfiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu ayi wo ayɛ;
    mɛto wʼayɛyie dwom wɔ anyame no anim.

Mede mʼani bɛkyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no, akoto wo
    na makamfo wo din
    wɔ wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛdie enti
  ɛfiri sɛ wɔapagya wo din ne wʼasɛm no
    asene nneɛma nyinaa.

Ɛberɛ a mesu mefrɛɛ wo no, wogyee me so;
    womaa me nyaa akokoɔduru ne nnamyɛ.

Ao Awurade, sɛ ahemfo a ɛwɔ ewiase nyinaa te wʼanomu asɛm a
    ma wɔn nkamfo wo.

Ma wɔnto Awurade akwan ho nnwom,
    na Awurade animuonyam yɛ kɛseɛ.

Ɛwom sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsorosoro deɛ, nanso ɔhwɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ,
    na ahantanfoɔ deɛ, ɔhunu wɔn akyirikyiri.

Ɛwom sɛ menam ɔhaw mu deɛ,
    nanso wobɔ me nkwa ho ban;
  wotene wo nsa wɔ mʼatamfoɔ abufuo so,
    na wode wo nsa nifa gye me nkwa.

Ao Awurade, woahwehwɛ me mu
    na woahunu me.

Wonim mʼasetena ne me sɔreɛ;
    wofiri akyirikyiri hunu mʼadwene mu.

Wonim mʼadifirie ne me nnaeɛ;
    wonim mʼakwan nyinaa.

Ansa na mɛbue mʼano akasa no
    Ao Awurade, na wonim ne nyinaa dada.

Woatwa me ho nyinaa ahyia
    na wobɔ me ho ban.

Saa nimdeɛ yi boro me nteaseɛ so,
    ɛyɛ me nwanwa dodo.

Ɛhe na mɛtumi afiri wo honhom anim akorɔ?
    Ɛhe na mɛtumi adwane afiri wʼanim akorɔ?

Sɛ meforo soro a, wowɔ hɔ.
    Na mekɔsɛ me kɛtɛ wɔ asaman a, wo nie.

Sɛ mede adekyeeɛ ntaban tu
    na mekɔtena ɛpo akyi nohoa a,

mpo ɛhɔ na wo nsa bɛgya me akɔ,
    na wo nsa nifa bɛsɔ me mu.

Na meka sɛ, “Ampa ara esum mmɛkata me so
    na hann nnane adesaeɛ ntwa me ho nhyia a,”

Na wo na wobɔɔ me honhom
    wonwonoo me wɔ me maame awotwaa mu.

Mekamfo wo, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛɛ me anwanwakwan so a ɛyɛ hu.
    Wo nnwuma yɛ nwanwa.
    Menim ɛno yie pa ara.

wʼani hunuu me ɛberɛ a meyɛ mogya toa no.
  Nna dodoɔ a woatwa ama me no,
    wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ wo nwoma mu
    ansa na emu baako reba mu.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wo nsusuiɛ som bo ma me!
    Woka ne nyinaa bɔ mu a, ɛso dodo!

Sɛ mese mɛkan a,
    ne dodoɔ bɛboro mpoano anwea,
  sɛ menyane a,
    me ne wo wɔ hɔ ara.

Ao Onyankopɔn, sɛ anka wobɛkumkum amumuyɛfoɔ a!
  Momfiri me so, mo mogyapɛfoɔ!

Wɔde adwemmɔne ka wo ho asɛm;
    wʼatamfoɔ mmɔ wo din pa.

Ao Awurade, metane wɔn a wɔtane wo,
    na mekyiri wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ.

Menni hwee sɛ ɔtan a mewɔ ma wɔn;
    mefa wɔn sɛ mʼatamfoɔ.

Hwehwɛ me mu, Ao Onyankopɔn, na hunu mʼakoma;
    sɔ me hwɛ na hunu mʼadwene.

Hwɛ sɛ bɔne bi wɔ me mu a,
    na fa me fa ɛkwan a ɛkɔ daa nkwa so.

Ɔkwasea ka wɔ nʼakoma mu sɛ,
    “Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.”
  Wɔaporɔ, na wɔn nneyɛɛ yɛ fi
    na wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.

Awurade firi ɔsoro hwɛ
    adasamma
  sɛ ɔbɛhunu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ nteaseɛ,
    anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.

Nanso nnipa nyinaa atwe wɔn ho afiri Onyankopɔn ho;
    wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne.
  Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.
    Ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.

Enti nnebɔneyɛfoɔ rensua nyansa anaa?
    
  Wɔwe me nkurɔfoɔ te sɛ deɛ nnipa di aduane.
    Wɔnnsu mfrɛ Awurade?

Wɔn nie, ehu akyekyere wɔn,
    ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn te wɔn a wɔtene mu.

Mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ sɛe ahiafoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ,
    nanso, Awurade ne wɔn dwanekɔbea.

Ao, ma Israel nkwagyeɛ mfiri Sion mmra!
    Awurade bɛsane de ne nkurɔfoɔ agyapadeɛ ama wɔn.
    Na Yakob adi ahurisie, na Israel ani agye!

Ao Awurade gye me firi nnipa bɔne nsam;
    bɔ me ho ban firi basabasayɛfoɔ nsam,

wɔn a wɔdwene bɔne wɔ wɔn akoma mu
    na wɔhwanyane ɔko mu da biara.

Wɔse wɔn tɛkrɛma ano te sɛ ɔtweaseɛ deɛ;
    ananka borɔ wɔ wɔn ano.

Ao Awurade, meka kyerɛ wo sɛ, “Wone me Onyankopɔn.”
    Ao Awurade, tie me mmɔborɔ su.

Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade, me gyefoɔ ɔhoɔdenfoɔ a
    wobɔ me tiri ban ɔko da,

nyɛ amumuyɛfoɔ abisadeɛ mma wɔn, Ao Awurade;
    mma wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ nyɛ yie.

Wɔatwa me ho ahyia,
    nanso, ma amumuyɛsɛm a ɛfiri wɔn anomu nsɛe wɔn.

Mma dinsɛefoɔ ntim asase no so;
    ma amanehunu ntaataa basabasayɛfoɔ.

Menim sɛ Awurade bu ahiafoɔ atɛntenenee
    na ɔka onnibie asɛm ma no.

Ampa ara, teneneefoɔ bɛkamfo wo din
    na wɔn a wɔnam tee no bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim.

Ao Awurade, mesu mefrɛ wo, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm so.
    Sɛ mesu mefrɛ wo a, gye me so.

Ma me mpaeɛbɔ mmra wʼanim sɛ aduhwam;
    ma me nsa a mapagya nyɛ sɛ anwummerɛ afɔrebɔ.

Ao Awurade, ma ɔwɛmfoɔ nwɛn mʼano;
    na wɛn mʼano ɛpono.

Mma wɔnntwe mʼakoma nkɔ deɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho,
    na ankɔyɛ deɛ amumuyɛfoɔ yɛ no bi;
  mma me ne abɔnefoɔ
    nni wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwadeɛ.

Ma ɔteneneeni mmɔ me, ɛyɛ ayamyɛ;
    ma ɔnka mʼanim, ɛyɛ me tiri so ngo.
  Me tiri rempo.
    Me mpaeɛbɔ da so tia abɔnefoɔ nneyɛɛ daa.

Wɔbɛto wɔn sodifoɔ afiri abotan so abɛhwe fam;
    na amumuyɛfoɔ bɛhunu sɛ me nsɛm no yɛ nokorɛ.

Wɔbɛka sɛ, “Sɛdeɛ obi funtum na ɔtutu asase no,
    saa ara na wɔabɔ yɛn nnompe ahwete ɛda ano.”

Nanso, Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade, wo so na mʼani da;
    wo mu na mehinta. Nnya me mma owuo.

Bɔ me ho ban firi mfidie a wɔasunsum me no mu,
    mfidie a abɔnefoɔ asunsum no.

Ma amumuyɛfoɔ no ankasa atena nyi wɔn,
    na menkɔ me baabi asomdwoeɛ mu.

Meteam mesu frɛ Awurade;
    me ma me nne so su frɛ Awurade sɛ ɔnhunu me mmɔbɔ.

Mehwie mʼahiasɛm megu nʼanim;
    meka me haw kyerɛ no.

Sɛ me ɔkra tɔ baha wɔ me mu a,
    ɛyɛ wo na wonim mʼakwan.
  Ɛkwan a menam so no
    nnipa asum me afidie wɔ so.

Tie me sufrɛ,
    na mewɔ ahohia kɛseɛ mu;
  gye me firi mʼataafoɔ nsam,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ho yɛ den sene me.

Yi me firi me nneduadan mu,
    na makamfo wo din.
    
  Afei teneneefoɔ bɛtwa me ho ahyia
    ɛsiane wo papa a woayɛ me enti.

Ao Awurade, tie me mpaeɛbɔ,
    tie me nkotosrɛ;
  wɔ wo nokorɛdie ne tenenee mu
    bra bɛboa me.

Mfa wʼakoa nkɔ atemmuo mu,
    na ɔteasefoɔ biara ntene wɔ wʼanim.

Ɔtamfoɔ no taa me,
    ɔbɔ me hwe fam;
  ɔma me tena esum mu
    te sɛ wɔn a wɔawuwu dadaada.

Ɛno enti me honhom atɔ piti wɔ me mu;
    na mʼakoma aba mu abu wɔ me mu.

Mepagya me nsa kyerɛ wo;
    wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase wesee.

Ao Awurade, gye me so ntɛm;
    me honhom tɔ piti.
  Mfa wʼanim nhinta me
    anyɛ saa a, mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ amena mu no.

Ma mente wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no ho asɛm daa anɔpa,
    na mede me ho ato wo so.
  Kyerɛ me ɛkwan a memfa so,
    na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ.

Ao Awurade gye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam,
    na wo mu na mede me ho hinta.

Kyerɛ me na menyɛ wʼapɛdeɛ,
    na wo ne me Onyankopɔn;
  ma wo honhom pa no
    nni me ɛkan wɔ asase tamaa so.

Ao Awurade, wo din enti, kyɛe me nkwa so;
    wo tenenee mu, yi me firi ɔhaw mu.

Nkamfoɔ nka Awurade, me Botan,
    deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsa akodie,
    na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsateaa akodie.

Ɔyɛ mʼadɔeɛ Onyankopɔn ne mʼaban,
    mʼabandenden ne me ɔgyefoɔ,
  me kyɛm a mewɔ dwanekɔbea wɔ ne mu;
    ɔno na ɔka nnipa hyɛ mʼase.

Ao Awurade, hwan ne onipa, a wʼani ku ne ho?
    Hwan ne onipa ba, a wodwene ne ho yi?

Onipa te sɛ ahomeɛ;
    ne nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam.

Ao Awurade, firi ɔsoro hɔ na siane bra fam;
    fa wo nsa ka mmepɔ, na ɛmfiri wisie.

Soma anyinam na bɔ atamfoɔ no hwete;
    to wo mmemma no ma wɔn nnwane.

Tene wo nsa firi soro bra fam;
    gye me na yi me
  firi nsuo akɛseɛ ho,
    firi ananafoɔ nsam,

wɔn a atorɔ ayɛ wɔn anomu ma,
    na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

Ao Onyankopɔn, mɛto dwom foforɔ ama wo;
    mɛto dwom wɔ sankuo a nhoma edu gu soɔ so ama wo,

ama Ɔbaako a ɔde nkonimdie ma ahemfo,
    na ɔgye ne ɔsomfoɔ Dawid firi akofena kɔdiawuo ano.

Gye me na yi me firi
    ananafoɔ nsam,
  wɔn a atorɔ ayɛ wɔn anomu ma
    na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nnaadaa.

Afei yɛn mmammarima mmeranteberɛ
    bɛyɛ sɛ afifideɛ a wɔahwɛ so yie,
  na yɛn mmammaa bɛyɛ sɛ adum
    a wɔasene de asiesie ahemfie.

Yɛn asan bɛyɛ ma.
    Aduane ahodoɔ biara bɛba mu bi.
  Yɛn nnwan bɛdɔɔso ayɛ mpem mpem,
    ayɛ mpemdu du wɔ yɛn mfuo so;

yɛn anantwie bɛtwe nnuane a ɛdɔɔso na emu yɛ duru.
  Obiara rentumi nnwiri yɛn afasuo ngu;
    yɛrenkɔ nkoasom mu,
    na agyaadwotwa remma yɛn mmɔntene so.

Nhyira nka nnipa a ɛbɛba mu saa ama wɔn.
    Nhyira nka nnipa a wɔn Onyankopɔn ne Awurade.

Mɛma wo so, me Onyankopɔn, me Ɔhene;
    mɛkamfo wo din daa daa.

Ɛda biara, mɛkamfo wo;
    na mama wo din so daa daa.

Awurade so, na ɔsɛ nkamfo kɛseɛ;
    obiara rentumi nsusu ne kɛseyɛ.

Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako bɛkamfo wo nnwuma akyerɛ ɔfoforɔ;
    wɔbɛka wo nnwuma akɛseɛ ho asɛm.

Wɔbɛka wʼanimuonyam ne wo tumi a ɛhran no ho asɛm,
    na mɛdwene wʼanwanwadwuma ho.

Wɔbɛka wo nnwuma a ɛyɛ hu no mu tumi ho asɛm;
    na mapae mu aka wo nneyɛɛ akɛseɛ no akyerɛ.

Wɔbɛhyɛ wo papayɛ mmorosoɔ no ho fa,
    na wɔde anigyeɛ ato wo tenenee ho dwom.

Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ;
    ne bo kyɛre fu na nʼadɔeɛ dɔɔso.

Awurade yɛ ma obiara;
    na ɔwɔ ahummɔborɔ ma nʼabɔdeɛ nyinaa.

Ao Awurade, wʼabɔdeɛ nyinaa bɛkamfo wo;
    na wʼahotefoɔ bɛma wo so.

Wɔbɛka wʼahennie no animuonyam ho asɛm
    na wɔaka wo mmaninyɛ ho asɛm,

sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa bɛhunu wo nnwuma akɛseɛ
    ne wʼahennie animuonyam a ɛhran no.

Wʼahennie yɛ daa ahennie,
    na wo tumidie wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa.
    
  Awurade di ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa so,
    na ɔwɔ ɔdɔ ma biribiara a wayɛ.

Awurade wowa wɔn a wɔhwe ase
    na ɔpagya wɔn a wɔn nnesoa ama wɔakom.

Ani nyinaa hwɛ wo ɛkwan,
    na woma wɔn wɔn aduane wɔ ne berɛ mu.

Wobue wo nsam
    na woma biribiara a ɛwɔ nkwa no nʼapɛdeɛ.

Awurade tene wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa mu;
    na ɔyɛ adɔeɛ ma deɛ wayɛ nyinaa.

Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa,
    wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokorɛ mu nyinaa.

Ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no no apɛdeɛ ma wɔn;
    ɔtie wɔn sufrɛ na ɔgye wɔn.

Awurade hwɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ no nyinaa so,
    nanso amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.

Mʼano bɛkamfo Awurade.
    Ma abɔdeɛ nyinaa nkamfo ne din kronkron no
    daa daa.

Monkamfo Awurade.
    
    Ao me ɔkra, kamfo Awurade!

Mɛkamfo Awurade me nkwa nna nyinaa;
    mɛto ayɛyi dwom ama me Onyankopɔn, sɛ mete ase yi.

Mommfa mo ho nto mmapɔmma so,
    adasamma a wɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

Sɛ wɔn honhom tu kɔ a, wɔsane kɔ dɔteɛ mu,
    saa da no ara wɔn nsusuiɛ nyinaa yɛ kwa.

Nhyira ne deɛ ne ɔboafoɔ ne Yakob Onyankopɔn,
    deɛ nʼanidasoɔ wɔ Awurade, ne Onyankopɔn mu.

Ɔno ne ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfoɔ,
    ɛpo ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa
    Awurade a ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ daa no.

Ɔdi ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so,
    na ɔma wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn aduane.
    Awurade gyaa nneduafoɔ,

Awurade ma anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ.
    Awurade pagya wɔn a wɔakom.
    Awurade dɔ teneneefoɔ.

Awurade hwɛ ahɔhoɔ so
    na ɔwowa nwisiaa ne akunafoɔ,
    na amumuyɛfoɔ akwan deɛ, ɔdane ani.

Sion, Awurade wo Onyankopɔn di ɔhene daa daa,
    wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Monkamfo Awurade.
    
  Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔto ayɛyie dwom ma yɛn Onyankopɔn,
  ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛfata sɛ wɔkamfo no!

Awurade kyekyere Yerusalem;
    Ɔboaboa Israel nnommumfoɔ ano.

Ɔsa wɔn a wɔn akoma abotoɔ yadeɛ
    na ɔkyekyere wɔn akuro.

Ɔnim nsoromma no dodoɔ
    na ɔde obiara din frɛ no.

Yɛn Awurade so, na ne tumi yɛ kɛseɛ;
    yɛrente nʼase nwie.

Awurade wowa ahobrɛasefoɔ
    na ɔtoto amumuyɛfoɔ hwe fam.

Monto aseda nnwom mma Awurade.
    Momfa sankuo nto dwom mma yɛn Onyankopɔn.

Ɔma anantwie aduane
    na sɛ anene mma su a, ɔma wɔn aduane.

Ɛnyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ahoɔden na nʼani sɔ
    na ɛnyɛ onipa ahoɔden nso.

Na mmom, Awurade ani sɔ nnipa a wɔsuro no,
    wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no so no.

Momma Awurade so, Ao Yerusalem;
    kamfo wo Onyankopɔn, Ao Sion,

ɔma wʼapono akyi adaban yɛ den
    na ɔhyira wo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔte wo mu.

Ɔma wʼahyeɛ so dwo
  na ɔde ayuo amapa ma wo.

Ɔsoma nʼahyɛdeɛ kɔ asase so;
    nʼasɛm tu mmirika ntɛm so.

Ɔtrɛ sukyerɛmma mu sɛ odwan ho nwi,
    na ɔpete obosuo nsukyeneeɛ sɛ nsõ.

Ɔtoto asukɔtweaa gu fam sɛ mmosea.
    Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina nʼawɔ denden no ano?

Ɔsoma nʼasɛm no ma ɛnane no;
    ɔhwanyane ne mframa, na nsuo tene.

Wada nʼasɛm adi akyerɛ Yakob,
    ne mmara ne ɔhyɛ nsɛm akyerɛ Israel.

Monkamfo Awurade!
    
  Monkamfo Awurade mfiri ɔsorosoro,
    monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro sorɔnsorɔmmea.

Nʼabɔfoɔ nyinaa, monkamfo no,
    ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, monkamfo no.

Owia ne ɔsrane, monkamfo no,
    nsoromma a ɛhran nyinaa, monkamfo no.

Monkamfo no, ɔsoro mu ɔsoro
    ne mo nsuo a mowɔ ɔsoro atifi.

Momma wɔn nyinaa nkamfo Awurade din,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔhyɛeɛ na wɔbɔɔ wɔn.

Ɔde wɔn sisii hɔ afebɔɔ;
    na wahyɛ nʼasɛm a ɛrentwam da.

Monkamfo Awurade mfiri asase so,
    mo, ɛpo kɛseɛ mu abɔdeɛ ne ɛpo bunu nyinaa,

anyinam ne asukɔtweaa, sukyerɛmma ne omununkum,
    ahum a moyɛ nʼapɛdeɛ,

mo, mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ nyinaa,
    nnua a ɛso aba ne ntweneduro nyinaa,

wira mu mmoa ne anantwie,
    abɔdeɛ nketewa ne nnomaa a wɔtuo,

asase ne amanaman nyinaa so ahemfo,
    mo, mmapɔmma ne asase sodifoɔ nyinaa,

mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa
    mmasiriwa ne mmɔfra nso.

Wapagya abɛn bi ama ne nkurɔfoɔ,
    ama nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa animuonyam,
    Israelfoɔ, nnipa a wɔda nʼakoma so no.
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Monkamfo Awurade.
    
  Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade,
    monkamfo no wɔ ahotefoɔ asafo mu.

Ma Israel ani nnye ne Yɛfoɔ mu.
    Ma Sion mma ani nnye wɔn Ɔhene mu.

Ma wɔmfa asa nkamfo ne din
    na wɔmfa sankuo ne akasaeɛ nto dwom mma no.

Na Awurade ani sɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ;
    ɔde nkwagyeɛ kyɛ hyɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ.

Momma ahotefoɔ nni ahurisie wɔ animuonyam yi mu;
    na wɔnto ahosɛpɛ dwom wɔ wɔn mpa so.

Onyankopɔn nkamfo nhyɛ wɔn anomu
    na ɛnyɛ akofena anofanu wɔ wɔn nsam,

sɛ wɔmfa ntɔ werɛ wɔ amanaman no so
    ne asotwe wɔ nnipa no so,

sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo,
    ne dadeɛ mpɔkyerɛ ngu wɔn atitire,

sɛ wɔmfa mmu atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ atia wɔn no.
    Yei ne nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa animuonyam.
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Awurade, hwan na ɔbɛsoeɛ wo kronkronbea hɔ?
    Hwan na ɔbɛtena wo bepɔ kronkron no so?

Deɛ ne ho nni asɛm
    na ɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene,
  deɛ ɔka nokorɛ a ɛfiri nʼakomam

na ɔmfa ne tɛkrɛma nsɛe nnipa
  deɛ ɔnnyɛ ne yɔnko bɔne
    na ɔmmu ne yɔnko onipa abomfiaa,

deɛ ɔbu afideyɛni animtiaa
    na ɔde anidie ma wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade,
  deɛ ɔdi ne ntam so
    ɛberɛ a ɛtia no mpo,

deɛ ɔde ne sika bɔ bosea a ɔnnye nsiho
    na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ ntia deɛ ɔdi bem.
    
  Deɛ ɔyɛ yeinom no
    renhinhim da.

Monkamfo no wɔ ne tumi mu nneyɛɛ ho;
    monkamfo no wɔ ne kɛseyɛ a ɛboro biribiara soɔ ho.

Momfa totorobɛnto nnyegyeeɛ nkamfo no,
    momfa asankuo ne bɛnta nkamfo no,

momfa akasaeɛ ne asa nkamfo no,
    momfa sankuten ne atɛntɛbɛn nkamfo no,

momfa kyankyan mmobɔmu so nkamfo no,
    momfa kyankyan nnyegyeeɛ nkamfo no.

Momma deɛ ɛhome nyinaa nkamfo Awurade.
    
  Monkamfo Awurade.

Bɔ me ho ban, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    na wo mu na menya hintabea.

Ahotefoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no so deɛ,
    wɔne animuonyamfoɔ a
    mʼanigyeɛ wɔ wɔn mu.

Wɔn a wɔdi anyame afoforɔ akyire no
    wɔn awerɛhoɔ bɛdɔɔso.
  Merenyi wɔn mogya apaeɛ no bi
    na meremfa mʼano memmɔ wɔn din.

Awurade, wode me kyɛfa ne me kuruwa ama me;
    woama me kyɛfa anya banbɔ.

Mʼahyeɛ akɔdeda mmea a ɛhɔ yɛ ahomeka;
    ampa ara mewɔ agyapadeɛ a ɛho yɛ anigye.

Mɛkamfo Awurade a ɔtu me fo;
    na anadwo mpo mʼakoma kyerɛkyerɛ me.

Mehunu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa.
    Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa enti, merenhinhim da.

Ɛno enti, me kra ani gye, na mede me tɛkrɛma di ahurisie;
    me onipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoeɛ mu,

ɛfiri sɛ, worennya me awufoɔ mu.
    Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔ.

Woakyerɛ me nkwagyeɛ kwan,
    na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim,
    na anika a ɛrensa da wɔ wo nifa so.

Ao, Awurade tie me tenenee abisadeɛ;
    tie me sufrɛ.
  Yɛ aso ma me mpaeɛbɔ
    deɛ ɛmfiri nnaadaa anofafa mu.

Ma me bembuo a ɛfiri wo hɔ.
    Ma wʼani nhunu deɛ ɛyɛ pɛ.

Wopɛɛpɛɛ mʼakoma mu,
    wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo,
  na wosɔ me hwɛ deɛ, nanso worenhunu hwee;
    masi madwene pi sɛ mʼano renka bɔne.

Nnipa nneyɛɛ fam no,
    wʼanomu asɛm enti
  matwe me ho afiri
    basabasayɛfoɔ akwan ho.

Menam wʼakwan so daa;
    me nan nnwatiriiɛ.

Da wo dɔ nwanwasoɔ no adi
    wo a wode wo nsa nifa
  gye wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no nkwa
    firi wɔn atamfoɔ nsam.

Hwɛ me so sɛ obi a wodɔ no;
    fa me sie wo ntaban nwunu no ase

firi amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔretaataa me nsam,
    mʼatamfoɔ a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

Wɔpirim wɔn akoma,
    na wɔkasa ahantan so.

Wɔadi me ntɛtɛ, afei wɔatwa me ho ahyia;
    wɔn ani abere sɛ wɔbɛbɔ me ahwe fam.

Wɔte sɛ gyata a ahaboa ho kɔm de no,
    te sɛ gyata kɛseɛ bi a wabutu wɔ atɛeɛ.

Ao Awurade fa wo nsa
    gye me firi nnipa a wɔte sei nsam
    asase so nnipa a wɔn akatua wɔ nkwa yi mu.
  Womma ɛkɔm nne wɔn a wʼani ku wɔn ho;
    wɔn mmammarima wɔ bebree,
    na wɔkora agyapadeɛ ma wɔn mma.

Na me deɛ, me tenenee mu, mɛhunu wʼanim;
    sɛ menyane na mehunu wo a, mʼakoma bɛtɔ ne yam.
Medɔ wo, Ao Awurade, mʼahoɔden.

Mesu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayɛyie sɛ no,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam.

Owuo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kyekyeree me;
    na ɔsɛeɛ asorɔkye bu faa me so.

Damena nhoma kyekyeree me;
    owuo ankasa too me anihaa.

Mʼahohia mu, mesu mefrɛɛ Awurade.
    Mesu mefrɛɛ me Onyankopɔn pɛɛ mmoa.
  Ɔfiri nʼasɔrefie hɔ tee me nne;
    me sufrɛ baa nʼanim, na ɛkɔɔ nʼasom.

Asase wosoeɛ na ɛhinhimeɛ,
    na mmepɔ fapem wosoeɛ
    wɔsuroeɛ ɛfiri sɛ na ne bo afu.

Ɔfirii ɔsoro baa fam;
    na omununkum kabii duruu ne nan ase.

Ɔte Kerubim so tu kɔɔ soro;
    gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.

Ɔde sum kataa ne ho,
    osu a amuna tumm atwa ne ho ahyia.

Hann kɛseɛ hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim,
    na omununkum a asukɔtweaa ne anyinam wɔ mu firii ne ho hyerɛn mu baeɛ.

Awurade bobɔɔ mu firii soro;
    Ɔsorosoroni no nne gyegyeeɛ bio.

Ɔtoo ne bɛmma no de bɔɔ atamfoɔ no hweteeɛ,
    ɔde anyinam a ano yɛn den pamoo wɔn.

Ɛpo mu mmɔnka ho yiyiiɛ
    na asase nnyinasoɔ ho daa hɔ,
  ɛsiane wʼanimka ne ahomeguo a ɛfiri wo hwene mu no enti,
    Ao Awurade.

Ɔfiri ɔsoro baa ɛfam bɛsɔɔ me mu;
    ɔtwee me firii nsuo a emu dɔ mu.

Ɔgyee me firii me ɔtamfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ nsam,
    wɔn a wɔn ani sa me, na wɔn ho yɛ den dodo ma me no.

Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu,
    nanso Awurade pagyaa me.

Ɔde me baa baabi a ɛhɔ trɛ;
    ɔgyee me, ɛfiri sɛ nʼani sɔɔ me.

Awurade ne me adi no sɛdeɛ me tenenee teɛ;
    wahwɛ me nsa a ɛho teɛ so atua me ka.

Manante Awurade akwan so.
    Mentwee me ho mfirii me Onyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne.

Madi ne mmara nyinaa so:
    memmuu nʼahyɛdeɛ so.

Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim,
    na matwe me ho afiri bɔne ho.

Awurade agyina me teneneeyɛ
    ne me nsa a ɛho teɛ wɔ nʼanim so atua me ka.

Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafoɔ kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ,
  wɔn a wɔdi mu nso wo kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.

Woyɛ kronn ma wɔn a wɔyɛ kronn,
    na amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, wokyiri wɔn.

Wogye ahobrɛasefoɔ nkwa,
    na wobrɛ ahantanfoɔ ase.

Ao Awurade, woyɛ me kanea.
    Aane, woma me sum dane hann.

Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me enti, metumi ka akodɔm gu;
    me Onyankopɔn enti, metumi foro ɔfasuo.

Onyankopɔn deɛ, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ;
    Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu.
  Ɔyɛ akokyɛm ma wɔn a
    wɔhwehwɛ banbɔ wɔ ne mu.

Na hwan na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ka Awurade ho?
  Na hwan na ɔyɛ Ɔbotan no, gye sɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn no.

Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma me ahoɔden,
    na ɔma me kwan yɛ pɛ.

Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforoteɛ deɛ.
    Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.

Ɔsiesie me ma ɔko,
    na mʼabasa tumi kuntunu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ tadua.

Wode wo nkonimdie akokyɛm ma me,
    na wo nsa nifa kura me.
    Wobrɛ wo ho ase ma meyɛ kɛseɛ.

Woabɔ ɛkwan tɛtrɛɛ ama me nan
    sɛdeɛ ɛrenwatiri.

Metaa mʼatamfoɔ kɔtoo wɔn;
    mansane mʼakyi kɔsii sɛ mesɛee wɔn.

Mɛdwerɛ wɔn, na wɔantumi ansɔre,
    wɔhwehwee ase wɔ me nan ase.

Wode akodie ahoɔden maa me;
    womaa mʼatamfoɔ bɔɔ wɔn mu ase wɔ me nan ase.

Womaa mʼatamfoɔ danee wɔn ho dwaneeɛ,
    na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me.

Wɔsu pɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammɛgye wɔn,
    wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, nanso wammua.

Meyamoo wɔn sɛ mfuturo a mframa bɔ guo;
    me hwiee wɔn guiɛ sɛ mmɔntene so atɛkyɛ.

Wɔte me nka pɛ a, wɔyɛ ɔsetie ma me;
    ananafoɔ koto mʼanim.

Wɔn nyinaa botoboto;
    wɔfiri wɔn abandenden mu ba ahopopoɔ so.

Awurade te ase! Ayɛyi nka me Botan!
    Wɔmma Onyankopɔn me Gyefoɔ no din so!

Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ awere ma me,
    ɔno na ɔka amanaman hyɛ mʼase,

ɔno na ɔgye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam.
    Wopagyaa me sii mʼatamfoɔ so,
    wogyee me firii basabasayɛfoɔ nsam.

Ɛno enti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu, Ao Awurade.
    Mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo din.

Ɔsoro ka Onyankopɔn animuonyam ho asɛm!
    Ewiem pae mu ka ne nsa ano adwuma,

Ɛda biara, wɔkasa;
    anadwo biara, wɔkyerɛ nimdeɛ.

Ɔkasa anaa nsɛm nnim
    na wɔnnte wɔn nne.

Nanso wɔn asɛm akɔduru asase so mmaa nyinaa,
    wɔn nsɛm nso akɔduru asase ano.
    
  Wɔ ɔsoro hɔ, wasi ntomadan ama owia,

a ɔte sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔfiri ne pia mu,
    te sɛ ɔbrane a ne ho pere no sɛ ɔbɛtu ne mmirika.

Awurade mmara yɛ pɛ,
    ɛkanyane ɔkra no.
  Ahotosoɔ wɔ Awurade nhyehyɛeɛ mu,
    ɛma deɛ ɔnnim nyansa hunu nyansa.

Awurade suro yɛ kronn,
    ɛte hɔ daa.
  Awurade mmaransɛm yɛ nokorɛ
    na ne nyinaa tene.

Ɛsom bo sene sikakɔkɔɔ
    sene sikakɔkɔɔ amapa mpo;
  ɛyɛ dɛ sene ɛwoɔ,
    sene ɛwoɔ a ɛfiri ɛwokyɛm mu.

Wɔnam so bɔ wo ɔsomfoɔ kɔkɔ sɛ,
    ɛsodie so akatua yɛ bebree.

Hwan na ɔhunu nʼankasa mfomsoɔ?
    Fa me mfomsoɔ a ahinta kyɛ me.

Bɔ wʼakoa ho ban firi ɔboayɛ bɔne ho,
    na anhyɛ me so.
  Ɛno na ɛbɛma madi bem,
    a merenni fɔ wɔ bɔne akɛseɛ ho.

Ma mʼanom nsɛm ne mʼakoma mu mpaeɛbɔ
    nyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ wʼani, Ao Awurade
    me Botan ne me Gyefoɔ.

Adɛn enti na amanamanmufoɔ no bo afu?
    Adɛn enti na wɔsɛe mmerɛ yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ hunu yi?

Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyina
    na atumfoɔ bom tu agyina
    tia Awurade ne Deɛ Wɔasra no no.

Wɔka sɛ,
    “Momma yɛmmubu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn
    na yɛnto wɔn mpokyerɛ ngu.”

Deɛ ɔte adwa so wɔ soro no sere;
    Awurade di wɔn ho fɛw.

Afei ɔka wɔn anim wɔ nʼabufuo mu
    hunahuna wɔn wɔ nʼabufuhyeɛ mu, ka sɛ,

“Masi me Ɔhene
    wɔ Sion, me bepɔ kronkron no so.”

Bisa me,
    na mede amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ,
    asase ano nyinaa bɛyɛ wo dea.

Wode dadeɛ ahempoma bɛdi wɔn so;
    na woabobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ ahina.”

Enti mo ahemfo, monsua nyansa;
    monkae kɔkɔbɔ yi, mo asase sodifoɔ.

Momfa suro nsom Awurade
    na monsɛpɛ mo ho ahopopoɔ mu.

Momfe Ɔba no ano, na ne bo amfu
    ansɛe mo wɔ mo akwan so,
  ɛfiri sɛ nʼabufuhyeɛ tumi sɔre ntɛm so.
    Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔdwane toa no nyinaa.

Awurade ntie wo wɔ wʼahohia mu;
    Yakob Onyankopɔn din mmɔ wo ho ban.

Ɔmfa mmoa mfiri kronkronbea hɔ mmrɛ wo
    na ɔmfiri Sion mmɛhyɛ wo den.

Ɔnkae wʼafɔrebɔ nyinaa
    na ɔmma wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ nsɔ nʼani.

Ɔmma wo deɛ wʼakoma pɛ,
    na wo nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa nyɛ yie.

Yɛbɛbɔ ose ɛberɛ a woadi nkonim
    na yɛama yɛn frankaa so wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn din mu.
    
  Awurade nyɛ wʼabisadeɛ nyinaa mma wo.

Ebinom de wɔn ho to wɔn nteaseɛnam so
    na afoforɔ nso, wɔn apɔnkɔ so,
    nanso yɛn deɛ, yɛde yɛn ho to Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn din so.

Saa nkurɔfoɔ no, wɔbrɛ wɔn ase ma wɔhwehwe ase,
    na yɛn deɛ, yɛsɔre gyina pintinn.

Ao Awurade gye ɔhene nkwa!
    Na sɛ yɛfrɛ nso a, gye yɛn so.

Ao Awurade, ɔhene no anigye wɔ wʼahoɔden mu.
    Nʼani gye mmorosoɔ wɔ nkonimdie a wo ma no nti!

Woama no deɛ nʼakoma pɛ;
    woamfa nʼabisadeɛ ankame no.

Wode nhyira a ɛdi mu hyiaa no
    na wode sikakɔkɔɔ amapa ahenkyɛ hyɛɛ no.

Ɔbisaa wo hɔ nkwa, na wode maa no,
    nna tentene a ɛnni awieeɛ.

Nkonimdie a woma no enti, nʼanimuonyam so;
    wode kɛseyɛ ne anidie adom no.

Ampa ara, woama no nhyira a ɛnsa da
    na wo nsrahwɛ ama me ho ahosɛpɛ me.

Wo nsa bɛka wʼatamfoɔ nyinaa;
    wo nsa nifa bɛsɔ wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ mu.

Ɛberɛ a wobɛyi wo ho adi no
    wobɛyɛ wɔn sɛ fononoo a emu adɔ.
  Awurade firi nʼabufuhyeɛ mu bɛmene wɔn,
    na ne ogya no ahye wɔn.

Wobɛtɔre wɔn ase wɔ asase so,
    na wɔn asefoɔ afiri adasamma mu.

Ɛwom sɛ wɔbɔ pɔ tia wo
    na wɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɔne, nanso wɔrenni nkonim;

ɛfiri sɛ wobɛma wɔasane wɔn akyi
    ɛberɛ a woatwe bɛmma akyerɛ wɔn so.

Yɛma wo so, Ao Awurade, wɔ wʼahoɔden mu;
    yɛbɛto nnwom na yɛakamfo wo kɛseyɛ.

Me Onyankopɔn, me Onyankopɔn, adɛn enti na woagya me?
    Adɛn enti na me nkwagyeɛ ne wo ntam aware,
    adɛn na mʼapinisie nsɛm ne wo ntam aware?

Ao me Onyankopɔn, mesu frɛ wo awia, nanso wonnye me so,
    mefrɛ wo anadwo, nanso mennya ɔhome.

Nanso, wɔasi wo ɔhene sɛ Ɔkronkronni;
    wo na Israel kamfo woɔ.

Wo mu na yɛn agyanom de wɔn werɛ hyɛeɛ;
    wɔgyee wo diiɛ, na wogyee wɔn.

Wɔsu frɛɛ wo na wogyee wɔn,
    wɔde wɔn ho too wo so na woanni wɔn hwammɔ.

Nanso meyɛ ɔsonsono, na menyɛ onipa
    nnipa bɔ me ahohora na wɔbu me animtiaa.

Obiara a ɔhunu me di me ho fɛw;
    wɔtwa me adapaa, woso wɔn ti ka sɛ:

“Ɔde ne ho to Awurade so;
    ma Awurade mmɛgye no.
  Ma ɔmmɛboa no,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔwɔ ne mu anigyeɛ.”

Wo na woyii me firii awotwaa mu baeɛ
    na womaa mede me ho too wo so
    ɛberɛ a metua me maame nufoɔ ano mpo.

Ɛfiri mʼawoɔ mu na wɔde me too wo soɔ;
    ɛfiri me maame yafunu mu, woayɛ me Onyankopɔn.

Ntwe wo ho mfiri me ho!
    Ɛfiri sɛ amaneɛ abɛn
    na ɔboafoɔ nni baabi.

Anantwinini bebree atwa me ho ahyia;
    Basan anantwinini a wɔn ho yɛ den atwa me ho ahyia.

Gyata a wɔbobom na wɔtete wɔn ahaboa mu
    abuebue wɔn anom tɛtrɛɛ de kyerɛ me.

Wɔahwie me agu sɛ nsuo,
    na me nnompe nyinaa ahodwo.
  Mʼakoma adane ayɛ sɛ nku;
    anane afiri me mu.

Mʼahoɔden awe te sɛ kyɛmferɛ mu.
    Na me tɛkrɛma atare mʼanom.
    Wode me ato owuo mfuturo mu.

Nkraman atwa me ho ahyia
    nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kuo atwa me ho ahyia,
    wɔahwire me nsa ne me nan mu.

Mɛtumi akan me nnompe nyinaa;
    Mʼatamfoɔ di me nhwɛhaa na wɔsere me.

Wɔkyɛ me atadeɛ mu fa,
    na wɔbɔ me ntoma so ntonto.

Na wo, Ao Awurade, ntwe wo ho.
    Ao mʼAhoɔden bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

Gye me kra firi akofena ano;
    gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no firi nkraman tumi ase.

Gye me nkwa firi gyata anom;
    gye me firi ɛkoɔ mmɛn so.

Mɛbɔ wo din akyerɛ me nuanom;
    mɛkamfo wo wɔ wɔn a wɔahyia hɔ no nyinaa anim.

Monkamfo Awurade, mo a mosuro no no!
    Mo a moyɛ Yakob asefoɔ, monhyɛ no animuonyam!
    Mo Israel asefoɔ nyinaa, monni no ni!

Ɔmmuu nʼani nguu
    ɔmanehunufoɔ ateetee so,
  ɔmfaa nʼanim nhintaa no;
    na mmom watie ne sufrɛ a ɔde repɛ mmoa.

Me botaeɛ a mede yi wo ayɛ wɔ badwa mu no firi wo;
    mɛdi me bɔhyɛ so wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro wo no anim.

Asase ano nyinaa
    bɛkae akɔ Awurade nkyɛn,
  na amanaman no mmusua nyinaa
    bɛkoto nʼanim,

ɛfiri sɛ ahennie wɔ Awurade
    na ɔdi amanaman so ɔhene.

Nkyirimma nyinaa bɛsom no;
    wɔbɛka Awurade ho asɛm akyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ.

Wɔbɛka ne tenenee akyerɛ
    nnipa a wɔnnya nwoo wɔn
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na wayɛ.
Awurade ne me hwɛfo, hwee renhia me.

Ɔma meda wira frɔmfrɔm adidibea mu;
  ɔgya me kɔ nsuo a ɛho dwoɔ ho,

ɔdwodwo me kra.
  Ɔde me fa akwantenenee so,
    ne din enti.

Sɛ menam
    owuo sum kabii mu mpo a,
  mensuro bɔne bi,
    ɛfiri sɛ, wo ne me na ɛwɔ hɔ;
  wʼabaa ne wo poma
    na ɛkyekyere me werɛ.

Woto me ɛpono wɔ
    mʼatamfoɔ anim.
  Wode ngo afɔ me tirim;
    me kuruwa ayɛ ma abu so.

Yie ne adɔeɛ nko na ɛbɛdi mʼakyi
    me nkwa nna nyinaa;
  na mɛtena Awurade fie
    daa.

Asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade dea;
    ewiase ne wɔn a wɔte soɔ nyinaa wɔ no;

ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem wɔ ɛpo so
    na ɔde sii nsuo ani.

Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aforo Awurade bepɔ no?
    Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ne tenabea kronkron hɔ?

Deɛ ɔyɛ ade tenenee na nʼakoma mu teɛ,
    deɛ ne kra nni ahoni akyi
    na ɔnnka ntanhunu.

Ɔbɛnya Awurade nsam nhyira
    ne bembuo a ɛfiri ne Nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn.

Saa na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no teɛ,
    wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wʼanim no, Ao Yakob Onyankopɔn.

Mo apono, mommuebue
    mommuebue, mo tete apono,
    na Animuonyam Ɔhene nhyɛne mu.

Mommuebue, Ao mo apono
    mommuebue, mo tete apono,
    na animuonyam Ɔhene no nkɔ mu.

Hwan ne saa animuonyam Ɔhene yi?
    Asafo Awurade no,
    ɔno ne animuonyam Ɔhene no.
Ao Awurade, mema me kra so kyerɛ wo;

wo so, Ao me Onyankopɔn, na mede me ho to.
  Mma mʼanim ngu ase
    na mma mʼatamfoɔ nso nni me so nkonim.

Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no mu biara
    ani renwu da,
  mmom, wɔn a wɔyɛ kɔntɔnkye no
    anim bɛgu ase.

Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Ao Awurade,
    na me nhunu wʼatempɔn.

Fa wo nokorɛ no so kyerɛkyerɛ me,
    ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn, me Gyefoɔ,
    na mʼani da wo so daa nyinaa.

Kae, Ao Awurade, wo mmɔborɔhunu ne wo dɔ kɛseɛ
    a ɛwɔ hɔ firi tete no.

Nkae me mmabunu berɛ mu bɔne
    ne mʼatuateɛ akwan;
  kae me sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ teɛ,
    Ao Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ wo yɛ.

Awurade yɛ, na ɔtene;
    enti ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nʼakwan.

Ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ fa ɛkwan pa so
    na ɔkyerɛ wɔn nʼapɛdeɛ.

Awurade akwan nyinaa yɛ ɔdɔ ne nokorɛdie
    ma wɔn a wɔdi nʼapam mu ahyɛdeɛ soɔ.

Ao Awurade, me bɔne so deɛ,
    nanso wo din enti, fa kyɛ me.

Enti hwan ne onipa a ɔsuro Awurade?
    Ɔbɛkyerɛ no kwan a wabɔ ama no.

Ɔbɛdi yie wɔ ne nkwa nna mu,
    na nʼasefoɔ afa asase no sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ.

Awurade da nʼatirimsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no;
    na ɔma wɔhunu nʼapam.

Mʼani da Awurade so daa,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔno nko ara na ɔbɛyi me nan afiri afidie mu.

Dane wʼani hwɛ me, na dom me,
    ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ankonam na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.

Mʼakoma mu dadwene adɔɔso;
    yi me dadwene firi me so.

Hwɛ me haw ne mʼahohiahia
    na yi me bɔne nyinaa firi me so.

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ adɔɔso
    ne ɔtan kɛseɛ a wɔde tan me!

Bɔ me nkwa ho ban na gye me.
    Mma mʼanim ngu ase,
    ɛfiri sɛ me dwanekɔbea ne wo.

Ma tenenee ne nokorɛ mmɔ me ho ban,
    ɛfiri sɛ mʼani da wo so.

Gye Israel, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    firi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

Bu me bem, Ao Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ, mabɔ bra a asɛm nni ho:
  mede me ho too Awurade so
    na manhinhim.

Sɔ me hwɛ, Ao Awurade,
    hwehwɛ mʼakoma ne mʼadwene mu.

Wʼadɔeɛ wɔ mʼanim daa
    na mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu.

Me ne nnaadaafoɔ ntena
    na me ne nyaatwomfoɔ nso nni hwee yɛ.

Mekyiri nnebɔneyɛfoɔ dwabɔ
    na mempɛ sɛ me ne amumuyɛfoɔ tena.

Mehohoro me nsa wɔ bembuo mu,
    na makɔ wʼafɔrebukyia ho ahyia, Ao Awurade,

na mepae mu ka wʼayɛyie
    na meka wʼanwanwadeɛ nyinaa.

Mʼani gye efie a wote mu ho, Ao Awurade,
    baabi a wʼanimuonyam wɔ no.

Mfa me kra nka nnebɔneyɛfoɔ deɛ ho nkɔ.
    Mfa me nkwa nka mogyapɛfoɔ deɛ ho,

wɔn a amumuyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ wɔn nsam
    na adanmudeɛ ayɛ wɔn nsa nifa ma.

Nanso mebɔ ɔbra a ɛho teɛ.
    Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me nkwa.

Me nan sisi asase tamaa so;
    na dwabɔ akɛseɛ ase na mɛkamfo Awurade.

Awurade ne me hann ne me nkwagyeɛ;
    hwan na mensuro no?
  Awurade ne me nkwa ahoɔden,
    na hwan anim na me ho mpopoɔ?

Sɛ nnipa bɔne toa me
    pɛ sɛ wɔkum me a,
  sɛ mʼatamfoɔ to hyɛ me so a
    wɔbɛsuntisunti ahwehwe ase.

Sɛ dɔm mpo twa me ho hyia a,
    mʼakoma rentu;
  mpo sɛ wɔtu me so sa a,
    ɛno mu koraa na menya awerɛhyɛmu.

Wɔ hia ɛda mu no
    ɔde me sie nʼatenaeɛ;
  ɔkora me wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan mu.
    Ɔde me si ɔbotan so wɔ ɔsorosoro.

Ao, Awurade, sɛ mesu frɛ wo a, tie me!
    Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me so!

Mʼakoma ka wɔ wo ho sɛ, “Hwehwɛ nʼanim!”
    Wʼanim, Ao Awurade na mɛhwehwɛ.

Mfa wʼanim nhinta me,
    mfa abufuo mpamo wo ɔsomfoɔ
    me ɔboafoɔ ne wo.
  Mpo me na nnya me,
    Ao me Nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn.

Mʼagya ne me maame bɛgya me hɔ deɛ,
    nanso Awurade bɛgye me.

Nnyaa me mma sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ pɛ,
    adansekurumfoɔ sɔre tia me
    na wɔpu awurukasɛm.

Meda so wɔ saa anidasoɔ yi sɛ:
    mɛhunu Awurade ayamyɛ
    wɔ ateasefoɔ asase so.

Twɛn Awurade.
    Hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duru
    na twɛn Awurade.

Wo na mesu mefrɛ wo,
    Ao Awurade me Botan;
    nsi wʼaso wɔ me enti.
  Sɛ woyɛ komm a,
    mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔasiane kɔ amena mu no.

Tie me mmɔborɔ su
    ɛberɛ a mefrɛ wo pɛ mmoa
  ɛberɛ a mema me nsa so
    kyerɛ wo Tenabea Kronkron hɔ.

Mfa me mfra amumuyɛfoɔ mu ntwe me nkɔ
    wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no.
  Wɔne wɔn yɔnkonom kasa fɛfɛ
    nanso wɔde ɔtan sie wɔn akoma mu.

Sɛ wɔmmu deɛ Awurade ayɛ
    ne deɛ ɔde ne nsa ayɛ no enti,
  ɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ase
    na ɔremma wɔnnsɔre bio.

Ayɛyie nka Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ watie me mmɔborɔ su.

Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne mʼakokyɛm;
    mʼakoma wɔ ne mu ahotosoɔ, na ɔboa me.
  Mʼakoma di ahurisie
    na mede dwomtoɔ bɛda no ase.

Awurade yɛ ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfoɔ;
    ne nkwagyeɛ nsraban ma deɛ wɔasra no ngo.

Gye wo nkurɔfoɔ na hyira wʼagyapadeɛ;
    yɛ wɔn hwefoɔ, na wo ne wɔn nnante afebɔɔ.

Momfa mma Awurade no, Ao ɔsoro abɔdeɛ,
    momfa animuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

Momfa animuonyam a ɛfata Awurade din mma no;
    monsɔre Awurade wɔ nʼanimuonyam kronkron mu.

Awurade nne mu wɔ tumi;
    Awurade nne mu wɔ animuonyam.

Awurade nne bubu ntweneduro;
    Awurade nne bubu Lebanon ntweneduro mu nketenkete.

Ɔma Lebanon hurihuri te sɛ nantwie ba,
    na Sirion nso sɛ ɛkoɔ ba.
Awurade nne pa ma anyinam ogya dɛre

Awurade nne woso ɛserɛ so;
    Awurade woso Kades serɛ.

Awurade nne kyinkyim adum
    na ɛma kwaeɛ yɛ kwaterekwa.
  Nʼasɔredan mufoɔ nyinaa team ka sɛ,
    “Animuonyam nka Onyankopɔn!”

Awurade di ɔhene wɔ nsuyire so;
    wɔasi Awurade ɔhene afebɔɔ.

Awurade ma ne nkurɔfoɔ ahoɔden,
    na ɔde asomdwoeɛ hyira wɔn.

Ao Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ dɔɔso fa!
    Dodoɔ no ara na wɔsɔre tia me!

Bebree no ara ka fa me ho sɛ,
    “Onyankopɔn rennye no”.

Nanso, Ao Awurade, woyɛ akokyɛm a atwa me ho ahyia
    wohyɛ me animuonyam na wopagya me ti.

Meteam su frɛ Awurade,
    na ɔgye me so firi ne bepɔ kronkron no so.

Metɔ hɔ na meda a,
    menyane bio, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kora me so.

Merensuro atamfoɔ mpem mpem a
    wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.

Sɔre, Ao Awurade!
    Gye me, Ao me Onyankopɔn!
  Bobɔ mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa apantan;
    na tutu amumuyɛfoɔ se.

Awurade hɔ na ɔgyeɛ firi ba.
    Ma wo nhyira mmra wo nkurɔfoɔ so.

Mema wo so, Ao Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ, woayi me afiri ebunu mu
    na woamma mʼatamfoɔ ansere me.

Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, mesu frɛɛ wo sɛ boa me
    na wosaa me yadeɛ.

Ao Awurade, woyii me firii damena mu;
    wode me ho kyɛɛ me na woamma mankɔ amena mu.

Nʼabufuo nkyɛre,
    na nʼadɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa;
  agyaadwotwa bɛwɔ hɔ anadwo,
    nanso ahosɛpɛ bɛba anɔpa.

Metee nka sɛ mewɔ banbɔ no, mekaa sɛ,
    “Merenhinhim da.”

Ao Awurade, woyɛɛ me adom no
    womaa me bepɔ gyinaa pintinn
  na wode wʼanim hintaa me no,
    me bo tuiɛ.

Wo, Awurade na mefrɛɛ woɔ;
    wo hɔ na mesu mesrɛɛ mmɔborɔhunu sɛ:

“Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ me sɛeɛ ho,
    sɛ mɛkɔ amena mu?
  Mfuturo bɛyi wo ayɛ anaa?
    Ɛbɛpae mu aka wo nokorɛdie anaa?

Tie me, Ao Awurade, na hunu me mmɔbɔ!
    Ao Awurade, yɛ me ɔboafoɔ.”

sɛ mʼakoma bɛto nnwom ama wo na ɛrenyɛ komm.
    Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, mɛda wo ase daa.

Yɛ aso ma me,
    bra ntɛm bɛgye me;
  yɛ me banbɔ botan,
    aban a mʼatamfoɔ nsa renka me.

Sɛ woyɛ me botan ne mʼaban enti,
    wo din enti, di mʼanim na kyerɛ me ɛkwan.

Gye me firi afidie a wɔasum me no mu,
    ɛfiri sɛ wo ne me dwanekɔbea.

Wo nsam na mede me kra hyɛ;
    gye me bio, Ao Awurade, Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ.

Mekyiri wɔn a wɔsom abosom huhuo;
    mede me ho to Awurade so.

Mʼani bɛgye na madi ahurisie wɔ wo dɔ mu,
    ɛfiri sɛ wohunu mʼamanehunu
    na wonim me kra mu haw.

Woamfa me amma ɔtamfoɔ no
    mmom wode me nan asisi petee mu.

Ateeteeɛ rete me nkwa so
    na abooboo te me mfeɛ so;
  ɔhaw enti mʼahoɔden kɔ fam
    na me nnompe nso ahodwo.

Mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa enti,
    mayɛ ahohora wɔ me nnamfonom mu;
  nnipa a wɔnim me suro me,
    na wɔn a wɔhunu me mmɔntene so dwane.

Obiara werɛ afiri me te sɛ deɛ mawuo;
    mayɛ sɛ kukuo a abɔ.

Mete dodoɔ no nsekuro.
    Ahunahuna atwa me ho ahyia.
  Wɔrepam me tiri so
    na wɔbɔ pɔ sɛ wɔbɛkum me.

Nanso, mede me ho ato wo so, Ao Awurade;
    meka sɛ, “Woyɛ me Onyankopɔn.”

Me mmerɛ wɔ wo nsam
    gye me firi mʼatamfoɔ
    ne wɔn a wɔtaa me no nsam.

Te wʼanim kyerɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ;
    gye me wɔ wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu.

Mma mʼanim ngu ase, Ao Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ masu mafrɛ wo;
  mmom, ma amumuyɛfoɔ anim ngu ase
    na wɔnna wɔn damena mu komm.

Mua atorofoɔ ano,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ahantan ne anintiabuo
    kasa tia teneneefoɔ.

Wo papayɛ dɔɔso,
    ɛno na woakora ama wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ no;
  ɛno na wode ma wɔn a wɔdwane toa woɔ no
    wɔ nnipa anim.

Wode wɔn sie wʼanim banbɔ mu
    firi nnipa nsusuiɛ bɔne ho;
  wo tenabea hɔ na wode wɔn sie dwoodwoo
    firi tɛkrɛma a ɛbɔ soboɔ ho.

Ayɛyi nka Awurade!
    Sɛ wayi ne dɔ nwanwasoɔ akyerɛ me
    ɛberɛ a na mewɔ kuropɔn a atamfoɔ atwa ho ahyia no mu.

Mebɔɔ huboa no, mekaa sɛ:
    “Woayi wʼani me so!”
  Nanso wotee me mmɔborɔ su
    ɛberɛ a mekoto srɛɛ woɔ no.

Monnɔ Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefoɔ nyinaa!
    Awurade kora wɔn a wodi nokorɛ so,
    na ahomasofoɔ deɛ ɔtua wɔn ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Monhyɛ den na momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam,
    mo a mowɔ anidasoɔ wɔ Awurade mu nyinaa.

Nhyira ne wɔn a
    wɔde wɔn amumuyɛ akyɛ wɔn,
    na wɔakata wɔn bɔne so.

Nhyira nka onipa a
    Awurade mmu ne bɔne ngu ne so,
    na nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.

Ɛberɛ a meyɛɛ komm no,
    me nnompe yɛɛ mmrɛ
    apinie a mesii no da mu nyinaa enti.

Awia ne anadwo
    wo nsa yɛɛ den wɔ me so;
  mʼahoɔden saeɛ
    sɛdeɛ awiaberɛ mu hyeɛ ma biribi yɛ mmerɛ.

Afei, megyee me bɔne too mu.
    Mankata mʼamumuyɛ so.
  Mekaa sɛ, “Mɛka
    me bɔne akyerɛ Awurade,”
    na wode me bɔne ho afɔdie kyɛɛ me.

Enti, ma obiara a ɔwɔ nyamesu mmɔ wo mpaeɛ
    ɛberɛ a wɔhunu woɔ;
  ampa ara sɛ nsuo akɛseɛ yiri a,
    ɛrenka no.

Mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ɛkwan a wobɛfa soɔ
    mɛtu wo fo na mahwɛ wo so.

Nyɛ sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ anaa afunumpɔnkɔ a
    ɔnni nteaseɛ enti
  wɔde nnareka ne ahoma na ɛdanedane no
    sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn.

Ɔmumuyɛfoɔ amanehunu dɔɔso,
    nanso Awurade adɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no,
    ɛtwa onipa a ɔde ne ho to no so no ho hyia.

Monni ahurisie na mo ani nnye wɔ Awurade mu, mo teneneefoɔ;
    monto dwom, mo a mo akoma mu teɛ.

Momfa ahurisie nto dwom mma Awurade, mo teneneefoɔ,
    ɛfata sɛ wɔn a wɔtene no yi no ayɛ.

Momfa sankuo nkamfo Awurade;
    monto dwom mma no wɔ sankuten so.

Monto dwom foforɔ mma no.
    Momfa nimdeɛ mmɔ sankuo no na monteam ahurisie so!

Awurade asɛm tene, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ
    ɔdi nokorɛ wɔ deɛ ɔyɛ nyinaa mu.

Awurade dɔ teneneeyɛ ne atɛntenenee.
    Nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no ahyɛ asase so ma.

Awurade asɛm so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsorosoro,
    nʼanom homeɛ so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsoro asafo.

Ɔka ɛpo nsuo boa ano kuo;
    na ɔde ebunu siee deɛ ɛhɔ dɔ.

Momma asase sofoɔ nyinaa nsuro Awurade;
    na ewiasefoɔ nyinaa mfa anidie mma no.

Ɔno na ɔkasaeɛ na ɛbaa mu
    na ɔhyɛeɛ na ɛgyinaa pintinn.

Awurade sɛe amanaman no nhyehyɛeɛ;
    ɔma adasamma nsusuiɛ yɛ kwa.

Nanso, Awurade nhyehyɛeɛ tim hɔ daa,
    nʼakoma mu botaeɛ wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.

Nhyira ne ɔman a ne Onyankopɔn ne Awurade,
    nnipa a ɔyii wɔn sɛ nʼagyapadeɛ no.
Awurade hwɛ adasamma nyinaa firi soro.
Ɔfiri nʼatenaeɛ hwɛ wɔn a wɔte asase so nyinaa.

Ɔno ne deɛ ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa akoma,
    enti ɔnim deɛ wɔyɛ nyinaa.

Ɛnyɛ ɔhene akodɔm kɛseɛ na ɛbɛgye no;
  ɛnyɛ ɔkofoɔ ahoɔden na ɛbɛma no afiri mu afi.

Ɔpɔnkɔ mu ahotosoɔ yɛ kwa wɔ nkwagyeɛ mu;
    nʼahoɔden nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentumi nnye nkwa.

Nanso Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wɔsuro no no so,
    wɔn a wɔwɔ anidasoɔ wɔ ne dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu,

sɛ ɔbɛgye wɔn afiri owuo mu
    na wama wɔatena nkwa mu wɔ ɛkɔm berɛ mu.

Yɛde anidasoɔ twɛn Awurade;
    ɔyɛ yɛn ɔboafoɔ ne yɛn akokyɛm.

Ne mu na yɛn akoma di ahurisie,
    ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ho to ne din kronkron no so.

Ma wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no ntena yɛn so, Ao Awurade,
    sɛdeɛ anidasoɔ a yɛwɔ wɔ mu no teɛ.

Mede aseda bɛma Awurade berɛ nyinaa;
    nʼayɛyie wɔ mʼanom daa.

Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu;
    ma amanehunufoɔ nte na wɔn nni ahurisie.

Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade;
    momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!

Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ɔgyee me so;
    na ɔyii me firii mʼakomatuo nyinaa mu.

Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nʼanim no hyerɛn
    na wɔn anim rengu ase da.

Ohiani yi frɛeɛ, na Awurade tiee no;
    na ɔgyee no firii nʼahohia nyinaa mu.

Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ wɛn wɔn a wɔsuro no,
    na ɔgye wɔn.
