Monka nhwɛ na monhunu sɛ Awurade yɛ.
    Nhyira ne onipa a ɔhinta wɔ ne mu.

Monsuro Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefoɔ,
    na wɔn a wɔsuro noɔ no nhia hwee.

Agyata yɛ mmrɛ na ɛkɔm de wɔn,
    nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, adepa biara remmɔ wɔn.

Mommra, me mma, monyɛ aso mma me;
    mɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo Awurade ho suro.

Mo mu hwan na ɔpɛ nkwa
    na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhunu nna papa bebree?
Ɛnneɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka kasa bɔne, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔgyae atorɔtwa.

Twe wo ho firi bɔne ho, na yɛ papa;
    hwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ na ti no.

Awurade ani wɔ ateneneefoɔ so
    na ɔtie wɔn mpaeɛbɔ;

Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne,
    sɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn nkaeɛ afiri asase yi so.

Ateneneefoɔ team su, na Awurade tie wɔn;
    ɔyi wɔn firi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔapa aba
    na ɔgye wɔn a wɔadwerɛ wɔn wɔ honhom mu no nkwa.

Onipa tenenee bɛhunu amaneɛ bebree
    nanso Awurade gye no firi ne nyinaa mu;

ɔbɔ ne nnompe nyinaa ho ban,
    sɛdeɛ emu baako mpo mmu.

Bɔne bɛkum ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ;
    ɔteneneeni atamfoɔ bɛnya afɔbuo.

Awurade gye nʼasomfoɔ nkwa;
    wɔn a wɔdwane toa noɔ no mu biara renkɔ afɔbuo mu.

Ao Awurade wo ne wɔn a wɔne me di asie no nni asie;
    ko tia wɔn a wɔko tia me.

Fa wʼakokyɛm ne wo nkatanimu;
    na sɔre bra bɛboa me.

Twe pea ne abonnua
    wɔ wɔn a wɔtaa me so
  ka kyerɛ me kra sɛ,
    “Mene wʼagyenkwa.”

Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkum me no
    ma wɔn anim ngu ase;
  wɔn a wɔbɔ me sɛeɛ ho pɔ no
    ma wɔmfa aniwuo nsane wɔn akyi.

Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ guo
    wɔn a Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ repam wɔn.

Ma wɔn akwan so nnuru sum na ɛso nyɛ toro,
    na Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ ntaa wɔn so.

Esiane sɛ wɔde atena sum me afidie kwa
    na wɔtuu amena maa me a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee no enti

ma ɔsɛeɛ mmɛfu wɔn mu
    na atena no a wɔde hintaaeɛ nyi wɔn,
    na ma wɔnhwe amena no mu nsɛe.

Afei me kra ani bɛgye wɔ Awurade mu
    na wasɛpɛ ne ho wɔ ne nkwagyeɛ mu.

Me onipadua nyinaa bɛteam aka sɛ,
    “Hwan na ɔte sɛ wo, Ao Awurade?
  Wogye ohiani firi ahoɔdenfoɔ nsam
    ne deɛ ɔnnibie firi apoobɔfoɔ nsam.”

Adansekurumfoɔ sɔre;
    wɔbisa me nneɛma a mennim ho hwee ho asɛm.

Wɔde bɔne tua papa a meyɛ so ka
    na wɔma me kra yɛ basaa.

Nanso, ɛberɛ a wɔyareeɛ no, mefiraa ayitoma
    na mede akɔnkyene brɛɛ me ho ase.
  Ɛberɛ a me mpaeɛbɔ ho mmuaeɛ nnya mmaeɛ no,

mekɔɔ so twaa adwo
    sɛdeɛ meyɛ ma mʼadamfo anaa onuabarima.
  Mede awerɛhoɔ sii me ti ase
    te sɛ deɛ meregyam me maame.

Wɔde adwemmɔne dii me ho fɛ te sɛ nnipa a wɔnni nyamesu;
    wɔtwɛree wɔn se guu me so.

Ao Awurade, wobɛhwɛ wɔn akɔsi da bɛn?
    Gye me nkwa firi wɔn sɛeɛ mu,
    gye me nkwa a ɛsom bo no firi saa agyata yi nsam.

Na mɛda wo ase wɔ dwabɔ kɛseɛ ase;
    wɔ nnipa dodoɔ mu na mɛkamfo woɔ.

Mma mʼatamfoɔ a wɔtane me kwa no
    nhwɛ me haa nsere.
  Mma wɔn a menyɛɛ wɔn hwee nso wɔtane me no
    mmfa adwene bɔne mmu me anikyeɛ.

Wɔnnkasa asomdwoeɛ so,
    na mmom, wɔde ntwatosoɔ
    tia nnipa a wɔmpɛ wɔn ho asɛm wɔ asase yi so.

Wɔhwɛ me haa ka sɛ, “Aane! Aane,
    yɛde yɛn ankasa ani ahunu.”

Ao Awurade, wahunu na mmua wʼano.
    Nte wo ho nkɔ akyiri, Ao Awurade.

Nyane, sɔre na bɛbɔ me ho ban!
    Ka bi ma me, me Onyankopɔn ne mʼAwurade.

Di mʼasɛm ma me wɔ wo tenenee no mu, Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn;
    mma wɔn nhwɛ me haa nsere.

Mma wɔnnwene nka sɛ, “Aane, deɛ yɛpɛ ni!”
    anaa wɔnnka sɛ, “Yɛanya no.”

Ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ me haa sere me wɔ mʼahohiahia mu no
    nyinaa anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;
  ma wɔn a wɔdi me so akokurokosɛm no
    nhyɛ aniwuo ne animguaseɛ atadeɛ.

Ma wɔn a wɔdi ahurisie wɔ me bembuo ho no
    mfa anigyeɛ ne ahosɛpɛ nteam
  ɛberɛ nyinaa mu ma wɔnka sɛ, “Momma Awurade so,
    ɔno na nʼani gye ne ɔsomfoɔ yiedie ho.”

Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo tenenee
    ne wʼayɛyie da mu nyinaa.

Nkɔmhyɛ bi da mʼakoma so
    a ɛfa omumuyɛfoɔ mmarato ho.
  Wɔnnsuro Onyankopɔn.

Na ɔno ankasa ani so no, ɔdaadaa ne ho dodo
    enti mma ɔnhunu ne bɔne nnyae yɛ.

Nʼanom nsɛm yɛ atirimuɔden ne nnaadaa;
    ɔnnim nyansa bio, na wayɛ papa.

Awurade, wʼadɔeɛ duru sorosoro
    wo nokorɛdie duru ewiem tɔnn.

Wo tenenee te sɛ mmepɔ akɛseɛ.
    Wʼatɛntenenee mu dɔ sɛ ɛpo bunu.
  Ao Awurade, wokora nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa so.

Wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no som bo!
  Nnipa mu akɛseɛ ne nketewa
    nya hintabea wɔ wo ntaban nwunu ase.

Wɔdi deɛ abu soɔ wɔ wo fie
    woma wɔnom firi wʼanika asutene no mu.

Wo nkyɛn na nkwa asutire wɔ;
    wo hann mu na yɛhunu hann.

Kɔ so dɔ wɔn a wɔnim wo,
    ma wo tenenee ntena wɔn a wɔtene akoma mu.

Mma ɔhantanni nan ntia me
    anaa omumuyɛfoɔ nsa nnsunsum me.

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ahwehwe ase,
    wɔdeda hɔ a wɔrentumi nsɔre bio.

Nha wo ho nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nti;
    mma wʼani mmere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne;

Wɔte sɛ ɛserɛ, ɛnkyɛre na ahye,
    wɔte sɛ dua mono, ɛnkyɛre na awu.

Fa wo ho to Awurade so na yɛ papa.
    Tena asase no so na ma wʼani nka asomdwoeɛ adidibea hɔ.

Ma wʼani nka Awurade ho
    na woama wo deɛ wʼakoma pɛ.

Fa wʼakwan hyɛ Awurade nsam;
    na fa wo ho to ne so, na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ:

ɔbɛma wo teneneeyɛ ahyerɛn sɛ adekyeeɛ,
    na wʼatɛntenenee ayɛ sɛ owigyinaeɛ.

Yɛ komm wɔ Awurade anim na to wo bo ase twɛn no,
    nha wo ho wɔ wɔn a asi wɔn yie ho
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔnam bɔne akwan so.

Mma wo bo mfu, na gyae abufuhyeɛ;
    nha wo ho, ɛkɔwie bɔne nko ara.

Wɔbɛtwa nnebɔneyɛfoɔ agu,
    nanso wɔn a wɔn ani da Awurade soɔ no,
    wɔbɛnya asase no adi so.

Ɛrenkyɛre, nnebɔneyɛfoɔ bɛyera.
    Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso wɔrenhunu wɔn.

Nanso ahobrɛasefoɔ bɛnya asase no adi so
    na wɔanya asomdwoeɛ mmorosoɔ.

Amumuyɛfoɔ bɔ pɔ bɔne tia ateneneefoɔ
    na wɔtwɛre wɔn se gu wɔn so;

nanso, Awurade sere amumuyɛfoɔ,
    na ɔnim sɛ wɔn nna abɛn.

Amumuyɛfoɔ twe akofena
    na wɔkuntunu wɔn tadua mu
  sɛ wɔbɛkum ahiafoɔ ne mmɔborɔfoɔ,
    sɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn a wɔn akwan tene.

Nanso, wɔn akofena bɛwowɔ wɔn ankasa akoma mu,
    na wɔn tadua mu abubu.

Kakra a ateneneefoɔ wɔ no som bo
    sene amumuyɛfoɔ bebree ahonya;

ɛfiri sɛ, amumuyɛfoɔ ahoɔden bɛsa
    nanso Awurade bɛwowa ateneneefoɔ.

Awurade nim wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no nna,
    na wɔn agyapadeɛ bɛtena hɔ daa.

Ahohiahia berɛ mu wɔremmrɛ.
    Ɛkɔm berɛ mu wɔbɛnya ma abu so.

Amumuyɛfoɔ pɛ bosea, na wɔntua,
    nanso ɔteneneeni de ahummɔborɔ ma;

Wɔn a Awurade ahyira wɔn no bɛnya asase no adi so,
    na wɔn a ɔdome wɔn no wɔbɛtwa wɔn agu.

Sɛ Awurade ani sɔ onipa akwan a,
    ɔma nʼanammɔntuo si pi.

Sɛ ɔsunti a ɔrenhwe ase,
    ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kura no wɔ ne nsam.

Na meyɛ aberanteɛ, na seesei mabɔ akɔkoraa,
    na menhunuu ɔteneneeni a Awurade apa nʼakyi
    anaasɛ ne mma resrɛ aduane.

Ɛberɛ biara ɔyɛ adɔeɛ, na ɔde fɛm kwa;
    na ne mma bɛnya nhyira.

Twe wo ho firi bɔne ho na yɛ papa
    na wobɛtena asase no so afebɔɔ.

Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade pɛ deɛ ɛtene,
    na ɔrennya ne nkurɔfoɔ nokwafoɔ no.
    
  Wɔbɛnya banbɔ daa nyinaa
    Nanso, amumuyɛfoɔ asefoɔ deɛ, wɔbɛtwa wɔn agu.

Ateneneefoɔ bɛnya asase no adi so
    na wɔatena so afebɔɔ.

Ɔteneneeni ano ka nyansasɛm,
    na ne tɛkrɛma ka deɛ ɛtene.

Ne Onyankopɔn mmara wɔ nʼakoma mu;
  ne nan nnwatiri.

Amumuyɛfoɔ tetɛ ateneneefoɔ
    hwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn,

nanso, Awurade nnyaa wɔn mma wɔn
    na ɔremma wɔmmu wɔn kumfɔ wɔ asɛnniiɛ.

Montwɛn Awurade
    na monhwɛ nʼakwan.
  Ɔbɛma mo so na moanya asase no adi so;
    sɛ wɔtwitwa amumuyɛfoɔ no gu a, mobɛhunu.

Mahunu omumuyɛfoɔ a ɔyɛ basabasa
    sɛ ɔredi yie sɛ dua mono a ɛsi asase pa soɔ,

nanso ankyɛre na ɛwuiɛ a wɔnhunu no bio;
    mehwehwɛɛ no, nanso manhunu no.

Susu deɛ ɔyɛ pɛ ho, na hwɛ deɛ ɔtene;
    na asomdwoeɛ onipa bɛnya asetena pa daakye.

Nanso wɔbɛsɛe nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nyinaa;
    na wɔbɛtɔre wɔn asefoɔ ase.

Ateneneefoɔ nkwagyeɛ firi Awurade
    ɔne wɔn aban wɔ amanehunu berɛ mu.

Ao Awurade, nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabofuo mu
    na ntwe mʼaso wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu.

Wo bɛmma ahwire me mu,
    na wo nsa adwerɛ me.

Wʼabofuhyeɛ no enti, ahoɔden biara nni me mu;
    me bɔne enti, me nnompe ahodwo.

Mʼafɔdie amene me
    te sɛ adesoa a emu yɛ duru dodo.

Mʼakuro bɔn na aporɔ
    ɛsiane me bɔne mu agyimisɛm enti.

Makoto na wɔabrɛ me ase;
    da mu nyinaa menantenante twa agyaadwoɔ.

Mʼakyi dompe mu yea boro so:
    ahoɔden biara nni me onipadua mu.

Mabrɛ na mapɛkyɛ koraa.
    Mʼakoma mu yea ma me si apinie.

Ao Awurade, deɛ merehwɛ anim nyinaa da wʼanim;
    mʼapinisie nhintaa wo.

Mʼakoma bɔ paripari, na mʼahoɔden asa
    mpo mʼaniwa aduru sum.

Mʼapirakuro enti me nnamfonom ne mʼayɔnkofoɔ mmɛn me;
    mʼafipamfoɔ twe wɔn ho firi me ho.

Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkum me no sum me mfidie,
    wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔha me no di me sɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔ.
    Ɛda mu nyinaa wɔdwene nnaadaasɛm ho.

Mete sɛ ɔsotifoɔ a ɔnte asɛm,
    mete sɛ mumu a ɔntumi nkasa.

Mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnte asɛm,
    deɛ nʼano ntumi mma mmuaeɛ.

Ao Awurade, meretwɛn wo;
    Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, wobɛgye me so.

Mekaa sɛ, “Mma wɔn ani nnye;
    anaa mma wɔnhoahoa wɔn ho wɔ me nan a awatiri no enti.”

Mereyɛ mahwe ase,
    na me yea da so wɔ me mu.

Meka me mfomsoɔ kyerɛ;
    me bɔne hyɛ me so.

Bebree na wɔyɛ mʼatamfoɔ;
    wɔn a wɔtane me kwa no dɔɔso.

Wɔn a wɔde bɔne tua me papa so ka no
    bɔ me ahohora ɛberɛ a mereyɛ papa.

Ao, Awurade nnya me.
    Ao me Onyankopɔn, nkɔ akyiri!

Bra ntɛm bɛboa me,
    Awurade, mʼAgyenkwa.

Mekaa sɛ, “Mɛhwɛ mʼakwan yie
    na mamfa me tɛkrɛma anyɛ bɔne;
  mɛto mʼano nnareka
    ɛberɛ a amumuyɛfoɔ bɛne me yi.

Nanso brɛ a meyɛɛ komm
    a manka asɛm papa biara mpo no
    mʼapinisie mu yɛɛ den.

Mʼakoma ho dwanee no wɔ me mu
    na metee nka sɛ ogya redɛre wɔ me mu
    na afei mede me tɛkrɛma kasaeɛ sɛ:

“Afei Awurade ɛdeɛn na merehwehwɛ?
    Mʼanidasoɔ wɔ wo mu.

Gye me firi me bɔne nyinaa mu;
    mma mennyɛ nkwaseafoɔ aseredeɛ.

Meyɛɛ komm, na mammue mʼano
    ɛfiri sɛ, wo na woayɛ yei.

Yi wʼasotwe firi me so;
    wo nsa ano amanehunu amene me.

“Ao Awurade, tie me mpaeɛbɔ,
    tie me sufrɛ;
    nsi wʼaso wɔ me su ho
  Me ne wo te hɔ sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ,
    sɛdeɛ na mʼagyanom nyinaa teɛ no.

Yi wʼani firi me so na manya anigyeɛ bio
    ansa na mafiri ha a mente ase bio.”

Sɛ mesu frɛ wo a, gye me so,
    Ao, me tenenee Onyankopɔn.
  Ma me ahomegyeɛ wɔ mʼahohia mu;
    hunu me mmɔbɔ na tie me mpaeɛbɔ.

Ao mmarima, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mo bɛdane mʼanimuonyam ahohora?
    Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mobɛdɔ nneɛma hunu na moadi ahoni huhuo akyi?

Hunu sɛ Awurade ayi deɛ ɔwɔ nyamesu ama ne ho;
    Awurade bɛtie, sɛ mesu mefrɛ no a.

Mommɔ afɔdeɛ a ɛfata
    na momfa mo werɛ nhyɛ Awurade mu.

Nnipa bebree bisa sɛ:
    “Hwan na ɔbɛtumi ayɛ yɛn adɔeɛ?”
    Ao Awurade, ma wʼanim hann no nhyerɛn yɛn so.

Wode anigyeɛ mmorosoɔ ahyɛ mʼakoma ma
    asene ɛberɛ a wɔn aburoo ne nsã foforɔ abu so no.

Mɛtɔ hɔ, na mada asomdwoeɛ mu,
    ɛfiri sɛ, wo nko ara, Ao Awurade,
    na woma metena asomdwoeɛ mu.

Mede boasetɔ twɛnee Awurade;
    na ɔhwɛɛ me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.

Ɔyii me firii amena a emu yɛ toro mu,
    firii dɔteɛ ne atɛkyɛ mu;
  ɔde me nan sii ɔbotan so
    na ɔmaa me baabi pa gyinaeɛ.

Ɔde dwom foforɔ hyɛɛ mʼanom,
    ayɛyi dwom a yɛde ma yɛn Onyankopɔn.
  Bebree bɛhunu na wɔasuro
    na wɔde wɔn werɛ ahyɛ Awurade mu.

Nhyira ne onipa a
    ɔde Awurade yɛ nʼahotɔsoɔ,
  deɛ ɔmfa nʼani nto ahomasoɔ so,
    ne wɔn a wɔmane di anyame huhuo akyi.

Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn
    woayɛ anwanwadeɛ bebree.
  Nneɛma a wohyehyɛ maa yɛn no
    obiara ntumi nka ne nyinaa nkyerɛ wo;
  sɛ meka sɛ mereka ne nyinaa ho asɛm a
    ɛbɛdɔɔso dodo.

Na mekaa sɛ “Mewɔ ha,
    merebɛyɛ deɛ wopɛ sɛ meyɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ afa me ho wɔ Mmara nwoma no mu no.

Ao me Onyankopɔn, mepɛ sɛ meyɛ wʼapɛdeɛ;
    mede wo mmara ahyɛ mʼakoma mu.”

Meremfa wo tenenee ho asɛm nsie mʼakoma mu;
    meka wo nokorɛ ne wo nkwagyeɛ ho asɛm.
  Mankata wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ so
    wɔ dwabɔ kɛseɛ no ase.

Ao Awurade, nyi wʼahummɔborɔ mfiri me so;
    ma wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ mmɔ me ho ban daa.

Ɔhaw bebree atwa me ho ahyia;
    mʼamumuyɛ abu afa me so enti menhunu adeɛ bio.
  Ɛdɔɔso sene me tiri so nwi,
    na mʼakoma aboto wɔ me mu.

Ao Awurade, ma ɛnsɔ wʼani sɛ wobɛboa me;
    Ao Awurade, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkum me no nyinaa,
    ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;
  ma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ mesɛeɛ no,
    wɔmfa aniwuo nsane wɔn akyi.

Wɔn a wɔka “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me no,
    ma wɔn ho nnwiri wɔn wɔ wɔn ankasa animguaseɛ ho.

Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaa
    ani nnye na wɔnni ahurisie wɔ wo mu;
  ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagyeɛ no nka daa sɛ,
    “Momma Awurade so!”

Nhyira ne onipa a mmɔborɔni asɛm ho hia no.
    Awurade gye no wɔ amanehunu berɛ mu.

Awurade bɛhwɛ no wɔ ne yadeɛ mpa so
    na wagye no asi hɔ.

Mekaa sɛ, “Ao Awurade hunu me mmɔbɔ;
    sa me yadeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia wo.”

Mʼatamfoɔ de adwene bɔne ka wɔ me ho sɛ:
    “Da bɛn na ɔbɛwu ama ne din ayera?”

Mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa keka asomusɛm fa me ho;
    wɔsusu bɔne ma me na wɔka sɛ:

“Yare bɔne bi abɔ no;
    ɔrensɔre mfiri deɛ ɔda hɔ bio.”

Mpo me yɔnko pa ara a mede me ho too ne soɔ,
    deɛ me ne no too nsa didiiɛ no,
    asɔre atia me.

Nanso wo, Awurade, hunu me mmɔbɔ;
    pagya me, na mentua wɔn so ka.

Menim sɛ wʼani sɔ me,
    na me ɔtamfoɔ renni me so nkonim.

Me nokorɛdie mu, wokura me mu
    na wode me gyina wʼanim afebɔɔ.

Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn,
    ɛnnɛ ne daa nyinaa.
    Amen ne Amen!

Sɛdeɛ ɔforoteɛ pere hwehwɛ nsuwansuwa no,
    saa ara na me kra pere hwehwɛ wo, Ao Onyankopɔn.

Onyankopɔn ho sukɔm de me kra, Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no.
    Da bɛn na mɛtumi akɔhyia Onyankopɔn?

Me nisuo ayɛ mʼaduane
    awia ne anadwo,
  na da mu nyinaa nnipa bisa me sɛ:
    “Wo Onyankopɔn wɔ he?”

Saa nneɛma yi na mekae
    ɛberɛ a mereka mʼakoma mu nsɛm;
  sɛdeɛ na medi asafokuo anim,
    na yɛde anigyeɛ nteateam ne aseda nnwom
  nante yuu bom kɔ Onyankopɔn fie
    wɔ afahyɛ da.

Adɛn enti na woaboto, Ao me kra?
    Adɛn enti na woteetee wɔ me mu saa?
  Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,
    na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,
    mʼAgyenkwa ne me Onyankopɔn.

Me kra aboto wɔ me mu
    enti mɛkae wo
  firi Yordan asase so,
    Hermon mmepɔ so, firi Bepɔ Misar so.

Ebunu kɔ ebunu mu
    wɔ wo nsuo a ɛworo guo no nnyegyeeɛ mu;
  wʼasorɔkye nyinaa
    abu afa me so.

Mebisa Onyankopɔn me Botan sɛ,
    “Adɛn enti na wo werɛ afiri me?
  Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenante twa adwo,
    mʼatamfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ nti?”

Me nnompe te yea sɛ ɔdasani.
    Mʼahohiahiafoɔ ateeteeɛ enti,
  daa nyinaa wɔbisa me sɛ,
    “Wo Onyankopɔn wɔ he?”

Adɛn enti na woaboto, Ao me kra?
    Adɛn enti na woteetee wɔ me mu saa?
  Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,
    na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,
    mʼAgyenkwa ne me Onyankopɔn.

Woyɛ Onyankopɔn, mʼabandenden.
    Adɛn enti na woapo me?
  Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenante twa adwo
    mʼatamfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ nti?

Soma wo hann ne wo nokorɛ
    ma wɔn nkyerɛ me ɛkwan;
  ma wɔmmfa me mmra wo Bepɔ Kronkron no so,
    faako a woteɛ hɔ.

Afei, mɛkɔ Onyankopɔn afɔrebukyia anim
    mʼanigyeɛ ne mʼahosɛpɛ Onyankopɔn nkyɛn.
  Mede sankuo bɛyi wo ayɛ,
    Ao Onyankopɔn, me Onyankopɔn.

Adɛn enti na woaboto, Ao me kra?
    Adɛn enti na woteetee wɔ me mu saa?
  Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,
    na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,
    mʼAgyenkwa ne me Onyankopɔn.

Wode wo nsa pamoo amanaman no
    na wobɔɔ yɛn agyanom atenaseɛ;
  wodwerɛɛ nnipa no
    na womaa yɛn agyanom dii yie.

Ɛnyɛ wɔn akofena na wɔde nyaa asase no,
    na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsa na ɛmaa wɔn nkonimdie;
  ɛyɛ wo nsa nifa, wo basa,
    ne wʼanim hann, ɛfiri sɛ na wodɔ wɔn.

Woyɛ me Ɔhene ne me Onyankopɔn,
    deɛ ɔhyɛ nkonimdie ma Yakob.

Ɛnam wo so na yɛpamoo yɛn Atamfoɔ;
    wo din mu na yɛtiatia wɔn a wɔkyiri yɛn soɔ.

Meremfa me ho nto mʼagyan so
    mʼakofena remfa nkonimdie mmrɛ me;

na wo na woma yɛdi yɛn atamfoɔ so.
    Wogu wɔn a wɔtane yɛn anim ase.

Onyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa
    na yɛbɛkamfo wo din no daa daa.

Nanso seesei woapo yɛn abrɛ yɛn ase;
    wone yɛn asraafoɔ nnkɔ ɔsa bio.

Woma yɛdwane firii ɛdɔm anim
    ma yɛn atamfoɔ fom yɛn agyapadeɛ.

Woyii yɛn maa sɛ wɔnkum yɛn sɛ nnwan
    na woahwete yɛn wɔ amanaman no mu.

Wotɔn wo nkurɔfoɔ fofoofo,
    na woannya mfasoɔ biara amfiri mu.

Woayɛ yɛn ahohoradeɛ ama yɛn afipamfoɔ,
    animtiabudeɛ ne aseredeɛ ama wɔn a atwa yɛn ho ahyia.

Woayɛ yɛn akasabɛbuo wɔ aman no mu
    na nnipa no woso wɔn ti de gu yɛn so.

Mʼanimguaseɛ di mʼanim daa,
    na aniwuo akata mʼanim

ɛsiane wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora na wɔkasa tia me de yi me ahi,
    ɛsiane ɔtamfoɔ a nʼani abre sɛ ɔbɛtɔ were no enti.

Yeinom nyinaa too yɛn deɛ,
    nanso yɛn werɛ mfirii wo,
    na yɛmmuu wʼapam no nso so.

Yɛn akoma ntwe mfirii wo ho;
    na yɛn nan nso mmane mfirii wo kwan so.

Nanso wodwerɛɛ yɛn yɛɛ yɛn sakraman tuo
    na wode esum kabii kataa yɛn so.

Sɛ na yɛn werɛ afiri yɛn Onyankopɔn din
    anaa sɛ yɛatrɛ yɛn nsam akyerɛ ananafoɔ nyame a

anka Onyankopɔn bɛhunu,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim akoma mu ahintasɛm.

Nanso, wo enti, wɔkum yɛn daa nyinaa;
    wɔbu yɛn sɛ nnwan a wɔrekɔkum wɔn.

Nyane, Ao Awurade! Adɛn enti na wada?
    Keka wo ho! Nnya yɛn hɔ afebɔɔ.

Adɛn enti na wode wʼanim ahinta
    na wo werɛ firi yɛn ahohia ne nhyɛsoɔ?

Wɔabrɛ yɛn ase kɔ dɔteɛ mu
    na yɛn onipadua aka afam dɔteɛ.

Sɔre bɛboa yɛn;
    wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no enti, gye yɛn.

Wodi mu wɔ mmarima mu
    na wɔde adom bi asra wʼano,
    ɛsiane sɛ Onyankopɔn ahyira wo afebɔɔ no enti.

Fa wʼakofena bɔ wo nkyɛn mu, Ao Otumfoɔ;
    fa animuonyam ne kɛseyɛ fira.

Ma wo bɛmma namnam no nhwere ɔhene atamfoɔ akoma mu;
    na ma amanaman nhwe wo nan ase.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wʼahennwa no bɛtena hɔ daa daa;
    tenenee ahempoma bɛyɛ wʼahennie no ahempoma.

Wodɔ tenenee na wokyiri bɔne.
    Ɛno enti Onyankopɔn, wo Onyankopɔn de wo asi wo mfɛfoɔ so,
    na ɔde anigyeɛ ngo asra wo.

Ahemfo mmammaa ka wo mmaa atitire ho;
    wo nsa nifa so na ayeforɔ dehyeɛ a ɔhyɛ Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ gyina.

Ao ɔbabaa tie, dwene ho na yɛ ɔsetie;
    ma wo werɛ mfiri wo nkurɔfoɔ ne wo agya fie.

Wʼahoɔfɛ asɔ ɔhene no ani;
    di no nni, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ne wo wura.

Tiro Babaa de ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛba;
    mmarima adefoɔ bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ wo.

Ɔhene babaa a ɔwɔ ne piam no yɛ onimuonyamfoɔ
    wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ abobɔ nʼatadeɛ yuu mu.

Wɔde ahosɛpɛ ne anigyeɛ kɔ mu;
  wɔhyɛne ɔhempɔn no ahemfie.

Wo mmammarima bɛsi wʼagyanom ananmu
    wobɛyɛ wɔn mmapɔmma wɔ asase no so nyinaa.

Mɛma wɔakae wo wɔ awontoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu;
    ɛno enti amanaman bɛkamfo wo daa nyinaa.

Onyankopɔn ne yɛn dwanekɔbea ne yɛn ahoɔden,
    amanehunu mu ɔboafoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔ ɛberɛ biara.

Enti sɛ asase ani dane butu
    na mmepɔ tutu kɔgu ɛpo ase a, yɛrensuro,

sɛ ɛpo bɔ asorɔkye na ɛhuru
    na ɛma nkokoɔ woso mpo a, yɛrensuro.

Asutene bi wɔ hɔ a
    ne nsuwansuwa de anigyeɛ ba Onyankopɔn kuropɔn mu,
    beaeɛ kronkron a Ɔsorosoroni no teɛ.

Onyankopɔn te kuropɔn no mu, na ɔrenhwe ase;
    Onyankopɔn bɛboa no anɔpahema.

Amanaman yɛ hoo, na ahennie hwehwe ase;
    ɔma ne nne so ma asase nane.

Otumfoɔ Awurade ka yɛn ho.
    Yakob Onyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban.

Bra bɛhwɛ Awurade nnwuma,
    ɔsɛeɛ a ɔde aba asase no so.

Otumfoɔ Awurade ka yɛn ho;
    Yakob Onyankopɔn yɛ yɛn aban.

Amanaman nyinaa, mommɔ mo nsam;
    momfa anigyeɛ nteam mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.

Awurade Ɔsorosoroni no ho yɛ nwanwa,
    Ɔyɛ Ɔhene kɛseɛ wɔ asase nyinaa so!

Ɔde amanaman hyɛɛ yɛn ase,
    na ɔde nnipa hyɛɛ yɛn nan ase.

Ɔyii yɛn agyapadeɛ maa yɛn,
    deɛ ɛyɛ Yakob a ɔdɔ noɔ no ahohoahoadeɛ.

Onyankopɔn aforo kɔ soro wɔ anigyeɛ nteateam mu.
    Awurade wɔ totorobɛnto nnyegyeeɛ mu.

To ayɛyie nnwom ma Onyankopɔn, to ayɛyie nnwom;
    to ayɛyie nnwom ma yɛn Ɔhene, to ayɛyie nnwom.

Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ asase nyinaa so Ɔhene.
    Monto ahurisie nnwom mma no.

Onyankopɔn di ɔhene wɔ amanaman no so
    Onyankopɔn te nʼahennwa kronkron so.

Amanaman no mu akunini boaboa wɔn ho ano
    sɛ Abraham Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ,
  ɛfiri sɛ asase so ahemfo yɛ Onyankopɔn dea;
    na wɔma no so yɛ no kɛseɛ.

Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ na ɔsɛ nkamfo
    wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn kuropɔn mu, ne bepɔ kronkron so.

Kuropɔn no ɔsorokɔ yɛ fɛ,
    ɛyɛ ewiase nyinaa anigyedeɛ.
  Bepɔ Sion te sɛ Safon sorɔnsorɔmmea,
    Ɔhene Kɛseɛ no kuropɔn.

Onyankopɔn te nʼabankɛsewa mu.
    Wada ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ nʼaban.

Ɛberɛ a ahemfo yi boaa wɔn ho ano,
    na wɔtuu ɔsa bɔɔ mu no,

wɔhunuu no ma ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwirie,
    na wɔde ehu dwaneeɛ.

Nketenkete kyeree wɔn wɔ hɔ,
    ɔyea a ɛte sɛ ɔbaa a awoɔ aka no.

Wosɛee wɔn sɛ Tarsis ahyɛn a
    apueeɛ mframa abɔ adwira wɔn.

Sɛdeɛ yɛate no,
    saa ara na yɛahunu
  wɔ Otumfoɔ Awurade kuropɔn no mu,
    yɛn Onyankopɔn kuropɔn mu;
    Onyankopɔn ma ɛtim hɔ afebɔɔ.

Wʼasɔredan no mu, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    na yɛdwene wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no ho,

Sion bepɔ di ahurisie,
    Yuda nkuraase no ani gye
  ɛsiane wʼatemmuo no enti.

Nante Sion na twa ho hyia,
    kan nʼabantenten dodoɔ,

dwene nʼafasuo ho yie,
    hwɛ nʼabankɛsewa no,
    na woaka ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma.

Saa Onyankopɔn yi yɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn daa daa;
    mpo ɔbɛyɛ yɛn kwankyerɛfoɔ akɔsi awieeɛ.

Nnipa nyinaa, montie;
    monyɛ aso, mo a mowɔ ewiase yi mu nyinaa,

deɛ ɔyɛ abomfiaa ne deɛ ɔdi mu,
    adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ nyinaa.

Mʼano bɛka anyansasɛm;
    nsɛm a ɛfiri mʼakomam bɛma nhunumu.

Mɛbrɛ mʼaso ase atie abɛbusɛm;
    na menam sankubɔ so bɛte aseɛ ama makyerɛ abɛbusɛm no ase.

Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ mesuro nna bɔne,
    ɛberɛ a amumuyɛfoɔ adaadaafoɔ atwa me ho ahyia,

wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ahonya soɔ
    na wɔde wɔn adedodoɔ hoahoa wɔn ho?

Onipa biara rentumi nnye nʼankasa nkwa
    na ɔrentumi mfa mpata biara mma Onyankopɔn.

Nkwa ho mpata boɔ yɛ den,
    sika biara rentumi ntɔ,

sɛ ɛbɛma no atena ase afebɔɔ
    a ɔrenhunu porɔeɛ.

Wɔn adamena bɛyɛ wɔn afie afebɔɔ.
    Ɛhɔ na wɔbɛtena awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kɔsi ɛberɛ a ɛnni awieeɛ mu,
    wɔn din a wɔde totoo nsase so nyinaa akyi.

Na onipa ahonya nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentena hɔ daa;
    ɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔwuo no ara.

Yei ne deɛ ɛda hɔ ma wɔn a wɔgye wɔn ho die,
    ne wɔn akyidifoɔ a wɔfoa wɔn nsɛm soɔ.

Wɔte sɛ nnwan na wɔbɛkɔ damena mu,
    na owuo de wɔn bɛyɛ nʼaduane.
  Teneneefoɔ bɛdi wɔn so anɔpa;
    wɔn onipadua bɛporɔ wɔ damena mu,
    na wɔne wɔn adan akɛseɛ no ntam kwan bɛware.

Nanso, Onyankopɔn de ne tumi bɛgye me afiri damena mu;
    ampa ara, ɔde me bɛkɔ ne nkyɛn.

Sɛ onipa nya ne ho a, mma ɛnha wo;
    na sɛ ne fie anigyeɛ yɛ bebree a, mma no nha wo;

ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ ɔwu a, ɔremfa hwee nkɔ,
    nʼanimuonyam ne no renkɔ amena mu.

Mpo ɔte ase no, ɔfaa no sɛ wɔahyira no,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔkamfo nnipa ɛberɛ a wɔdi yie,

nanso ɔbɛkɔ akɔka nʼagyanom ho,
    wɔn a wɔrenhunu nkwa hann ara da no.

Onipa a ɔwɔ ahonya na ɔnni nhunumu no,
    ɔte sɛ aboa a ɔwuo.

Ao Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nsɛm
    na dwene mʼapinisie ho.

Tie me mmoa ho sufrɛ,
    me Ɔhene ne me Onyankopɔn,
    ɛfiri sɛ wo na mebɔ wo mpaeɛ.

Wonyɛ Onyankopɔn a wʼani gye bɔne ho;
    na amumuyɛfoɔ rentumi ne wo ntena.

Ahantanfoɔ rentumi nnyina wʼanim;
    wokyiri wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa.

Nanso me, wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe enti,
    mɛba wo fie;
  na anidie mu na mɛkoto
    akyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no.

Ao Awurade kyerɛ me ɛkwan
    wɔ wo tenenee mu
    mʼatamfoɔ enti,
    bɔ wo kwan tee wɔ mʼanim.

Wɔn anom asɛm baako mpo nyɛ nokorɛ;
    ɔsɛeɛ ahyɛ wɔn akoma ma.
  Wɔn menewa yɛ damena a ɛso abue
    wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma ka nnaadaasɛm.

Ao, Onyankopɔn, bu wɔn fɔ!
    Ma wɔn pɔ bɔne nyɛ wɔn ahweaseɛ.
  Pam wɔn ɛsiane wɔn bɔne dodoɔ no enti,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔasɔre atia wo.

Nanso, ma wɔn a wɔdwane ba wo nkyɛn no ani nnye;
    ma wɔmfa anigyeɛ nto dwom daa.
  Trɛ wo banbɔ mu wɔ wɔn so,
    na wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no
    ma wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu.

Ao Awurade, ampa ara, wohyira teneneefoɔ;
    na wode wʼayamyɛ twa wɔn ho hyia te sɛ akokyɛm.

Tweaduampɔn, Onyankopɔn, Awurade no kasa,
    na ɔfrɛ asase nyinaa
    ɛfiri apueeɛ kɔsi atɔeɛ.

Onyankopɔn hran firi Sion
    kuro a ne fɛ wie pɛ yɛ.

Ɔfrɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase,
    sɛ ɔrebu ne nkurɔfoɔ atɛn;

Ɔka sɛ, “Boaboa nnipa a wɔate wɔn ho no ano ma me,
    wɔn a wɔnam afɔrebɔdeɛ so ne me yɛɛ apam no.”

Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne tenenee,
    na Onyankopɔn ankasa ne ɔtemmufoɔ.

Merenka mo anim wɔ mo afɔrebɔdeɛ
    anaa mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ mʼanim daa no ho.

Anantwinini a wɔfiri mo mfuo so
    anaa mpapo a wɔfiri mo buo mu ho nhia me,

ɛfiri sɛ kwaeɛ mu aboa biara yɛ me dea,
    anantwie a wɔwɔ nkokoɔ mpempem so nso saa ara.

Menim anomaa biara a ɔwɔ mmepɔ no so,
    na wiram abɔdeɛ nyinaa yɛ me dea.

Sɛ ɛkɔm dee me a, anka merenka nkyerɛ mo;
    ɛfiri sɛ, ewiase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ me dea.

Mewe anantwinini nam,
    na menom mpapo mogya anaa?

Momfa aseda afɔdeɛ mma Onyankopɔn,
    na monni bɔhyɛ a mohyɛɛ Ɔsorosoroni no so,

na momfrɛ me da hiada;
    na mɛgye mo na moahyɛ me animuonyam.”

Nanso, amumuyɛfoɔ deɛ, Onyankopɔn bisa wɔn sɛ,
  “Adɛn enti na moka me mmara ho asɛm
    na mʼapam da mo ano?

Mokyiri me nkyerɛkyerɛ
    na moto me nsɛm gu mo akyi.

Sɛ mohunu ɔkorɔmfoɔ a, mode mo ho bɔ no;
    na mo ne awaresɛefoɔ nso bɔ.

Mode mo ano yɛ bɔne
    na mode mo tɛkrɛma boaboa nnaadaa ano.

Mokasa tia mo nuabarima ɛberɛ biara
    na mosopa mo ankasa maame ba.

Moayɛ yeinom nyinaa; nanso manka hwee,
    enti mosusu sɛ mete sɛ mo.
  Nanso mɛka mo anim
    na mede mo soboɔ asi mo anim.

“Monnwene yei ho, mo a mo werɛ firi Onyankopɔn,
    anyɛ saa a, mɛtete mo mu nketenkete a obiara mmɛgye mo;

Deɛ ɔbɔ aseda afɔdeɛ no hyɛ me animuonyam,
    na ɔsiesie ɛkwan
    sɛdeɛ mɛda Onyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ adi akyerɛ no.”

Ao Onyankopɔn hunu me mmɔbɔ,
    sɛdeɛ wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no teɛ;
  wʼahummɔborɔ kɛseɛ no enti,
    pepa me mmarato.

Hohoro mʼamumuyɛ nyinaa
    na te me ho firi me bɔne mu!

Na mahunu me mmarato,
    na mekae me bɔne daa.

Mayɛ mfomsoɔ atia wo; atia wo nko ara
    na mayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ bɔne wɔ wʼani so,
  enti, wodi bem wɔ wo kasa mu
    na wotene wɔ wʼatemmuo mu.

Ampa ara wɔwoo me wɔ bɔne mu,
    na bɔne mu na me maame nyinsɛnee me.

Ampa ara nokorɛ na wohwehwɛ wɔ me mu.
    Wokyerɛ me nyansa a emu dɔ.

Fa hisope hohoro me ho, na me ho bɛte;
    dware me, na mɛhoa asene sukyerɛmma.

Ma mente ahosɛpɛ ne anigyeɛ nka;
    na ma nnompe a woabubuo no nni ahurisie.

Kata wʼani wɔ me bɔne ho
    na pepa mʼamumuyɛ nyinaa.

Ao Onyankopɔn, bɔ akoma a emu teɛ wɔ me mu,
    na ma me honhom foforɔ a ɛdi wo nokorɛ.

Mpamo me mfiri wʼanim
    na ɛnyi wo Honhom Kronkron mfiri me mu.

Fa wo nkwagyeɛ mu anigyeɛ no ma me bio
    na ma me ɔsetie honhom a ɛbɛkura me.

Afei mɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ wʼakwan,
    na amumuyɛfoɔ bɛsane aba wo nkyɛn.

Ao Onyankopɔn, gye me firi mogya ho afɔdie mu.
    Onyame a wogye me nkwa,
    na me tɛkrɛma bɛto wo tenenee ho dwom.

Ao Awurade, bue mʼano fafa,
    na mede mʼano bɛpae mu aka wʼayɛyie.

Wompɛ afɔrebɔ, anka mɛbɔ;
    wʼani nnye ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho.

Onyankopɔn afɔdeɛ a ɔpɛ yɛ honhom a abotoɔ.
    Ao Onyankopɔn,
    worempo ahonu ne ahobrɛaseɛ akoma.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ma Sion nya nkɔsoɔ wɔ wʼanigyeɛ mu;
    na to Yerusalem afasuo.

Ɔkɛseɛ, adɛn enti na wohoahoa wo ho wɔ wo bɔne ho?
    Adɛn enti na wohoahoa wo ho da mu nyinaa,
    wo a woyɛ animguasedeɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn ani so?

Wʼani gye bɔne ho sene papa,
    wopɛ atorɔ sene sɛ wobɛka nokorɛ.

Wodɔ asɛm biara a ɛde ɔhaw ba,
    Ao wo tɛkrɛma daadaafoɔ!

Ateneneefoɔ bɛhunu yei na wɔasuro;
    wɔbɛsere no na wɔaka sɛ,

“Hwɛ, onipa no nie
    deɛ wamfa Onyankopɔn anyɛ nʼabandenden
  na mmom ɔde ne ho too nʼahonya dodoɔ so
    na ɔnyaa ahoɔden de sɛee afoforɔ no!”

Nanso, mete sɛ ngo dua a
    ɛrenyini wɔ Onyankopɔn fie:
  mede me ho to Onyankopɔn dɔ a ɛnsa da no so
    daa nyinaa.

Ɔkwasea ka nʼakoma mu sɛ,
    “Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.”
  Wɔaporɔ, na wɔn akwan yɛ animguaseɛ.
    Baako koraa nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.

Onyankopɔn firi soro hwɛ adasamma wɔ fam
    sɛ ɔbɛhunu wɔn mu bi a
  wɔwɔ nteaseɛ,
    anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.

Enti abɔnefoɔ rensua nyansa anaa?
    Wɔwe me nkurɔfoɔ sɛdeɛ nnipa di aduane.
    Wɔnnsu mfrɛ Onyankopɔn.

Wɔn na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ huboa!
    Wɔn ho popo wɔ beaeɛ a ehu nni hɔ.
  Onyankopɔn bɛhwete wʼatamfoɔ no nnompe agu;
    wobɛgu wɔn anim ase, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn abu wɔn animtiaa.

Ao, ma Israel nkwagyeɛ mfiri Sion mmra!
    Onyankopɔn bɛsane de ne nkurɔfoɔ agyapadeɛ ama wɔn.
    Na Yakob adi ahurisie, na Israel ani agye!

Ao Onyankopɔn, gye me wɔ wo din mu;
    fa wo tumi di mʼasɛm ma me.

Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaeɛbɔ;
    tie mʼanom nsɛm.

Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ne me ɔboafoɔ;
    Awurade ne me hwɛfoɔ.

Ma mmusuo nkyim mmra wɔn a wɔdi me ho nsekuro so;
    wo nokorɛdie mu, sɛe wɔn.

Woagye me afiri me haw nyinaa mu,
    na mʼani ahunu nkonimdie wɔ mʼatamfoɔ so.

Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaeɛbɔ,
    mmu wʼani ngu me nkotosrɛ so,

tie me na gye me so.
    Me dadwene ha me na ama mayɛ basaa,

Mʼakoma wɔ ahoyera mu;
    na owuo huboa aba me so.

Ehu ne ahopopoɔ akyekyere me.
    Ahodwirie abu afa me so.

Mekaa sɛ, “Ao, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburo a,
    anka mɛtu akɔ ama me ho atɔ me,

anka mɛtu akɔ akyirikyiri
    akɔtena ɛserɛ so;

anka mɛyɛ ntɛm akɔ mʼahintaeɛ,
    baabi a mframaden ne ahum mmɛn koraa.”

Ao Awurade, ma amumuyɛfoɔ nyɛ basaa, na ma wɔn kasa ntoto,
    ɛfiri sɛ mɛhunu basabasayɛ ne apereapereɛ wɔ kuropɔn no mu.

Awia ne anadwo wɔtetɛ nʼafasuo ho;
    adwemmɔne ne nsisie wɔ mu.

Adesɛefoɔ dɔm reyɛ adwuma kuropɔn no mu.
    Ahunahuna ne nnaadaa wɔ ne mmɔntene so daa.

Sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfoɔ na ɔresopa me a,
    anka mɛtumi agyina ano;
    sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfoɔ na ɔrema ne ho so atia me a,
    anka mɛtumi de me ho ahinta no.

Nanso, ɛyɛ wo, ɔdasani te sɛ me,
  me yɔnko pa ne me mʼadamfo brɛboɔ,

a kane no na me ne no wɔ ayɔnkofa a emu yɛ den
    ɛberɛ a yɛn nyinaa abɔ mu yuu rekɔ Onyankopɔn fie no.

Nanso, mesu frɛ Onyankopɔn,
    na Awurade gye me nkwa.

Anwummerɛ, anɔpa ne awia,
    mede mmɔborɔnne su frɛ no,
    na ɔte me nne.

Ɔde ne ho bɔ afɔdeɛ ma me nya me tiri didim
    wɔ ɔko a wɔko tiaa me no mu,
    mpo bebree na wɔko tia me.

Onyankopɔn a wɔasi no ɔhene afebɔɔ no,
    ɔbɛte wɔn nka na waha wɔn,
  ɔbɛha nnipa a wɔnsesa wɔn akwan da
    na wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn nso.

Me yɔnko to hyɛ ne nnamfonom so;
    na ɔbu nʼapam so.

Ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmawoɔ,
    nanso ɔtan wɔ nʼakomam.
  Nʼano asɛm dwodwo sene ngo,
    nanso ɛyɛ akofena a wɔatwe.

Nanso, wo, Ao Onyankopɔn, wobɛbrɛ amumuyɛfoɔ ase
    ama wɔakɔ porɔeɛ amena mu;
  mogyapɛfoɔ ne adaadaafoɔ
    renni wɔn nkwanna mu fa.
    
  Me deɛ, mede me ho to wo so.

Ao Onyankopɔn, hunu me mmɔbɔ na nnipa taa me anibereɛ so;
    da mu nyinaa, wɔmia mmirika a wɔtu wɔtaa me no mu.

Wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora taa me da mu nyinaa;
    wɔn a wɔma wɔn ho so tia me dɔɔso.

Sɛ mebɔ hu a,
    mede me ho bɛto wo so.

Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,
    mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so, na merensuro.
    Ɛdeɛn na onipa dasani bɛtumi ayɛ me?

Ɛda mu nyinaa wɔgye mʼano si bɔne;
    ɛberɛ biara wɔbɔ pɔ sɛ wɔbɛteetee me.

Wɔbɔ pɔ, na wɔtetɛ,
    wɔhwɛ mʼanammɔntuo,
    na wɔpere sɛ wɔbɛkum me.

Ɛkwan biara so, mma wɔmfa wɔn ho nni;
    Ao Onyankopɔn, brɛ amanaman no ase wɔ wʼabufuo mu.

Sɛ mepɛ mmoa firi wo hɔ a,
    mʼatamfoɔ bɛsane wɔn akyi.
    Yei bɛma mahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ mʼafa.

Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,
    Awurade a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,

mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so; na merensuro.
    Ɛdeɛn na ɔdasani bɛtumi ayɛ me?

Ao Onyankopɔn, mehyɛ ɛbɔ a mahyɛ wo no ase,
    mede mʼaseda afɔdeɛ bɛbrɛ wo.

Ɛfiri sɛ, woagye me afiri owuo mu,
    woamma me nan ansunti,
  sɛdeɛ mɛtumi anante Onyankopɔn anim
    wɔ nkwa hann mu.

Hu me mmɔbɔ, Ao Onyankopɔn, hunu me mmɔbɔ,
    na wo mu na me kra nya dwanekɔbea.
  Wo ntaban nwunu ase na mɛpɛ dwanekɔbea
    kɔsi sɛ amanehunu no bɛtwam.

Mesu frɛ Onyankopɔn, Ɔsorosoroni no;
    Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne pɛ ba mu wɔ me ho.

Agyata atwa me ho ahyia;
    meda mmoa a wɔwe ɛnam mono mu,
    nnipa a wɔn se te sɛ mpea ne mmɛmma
    na wɔn tɛkrɛma te sɛ akofena a ɛyɛ nnam.

Ao Onyankopɔn, woyɛ kɛseɛ wɔ ɔsorosoro hɔ;
    ma wʼanimuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so.

Wɔtrɛɛ asau mu de sum me nan afidie,
    ahohiahia brɛɛ me ase.
  Wɔtuu amena wɔ me kwan mu,
    nanso wɔn ankasa akɔtotɔ mu.

Me kra nyane!
    Sankuo ne bɛnta, monnyane!
    Me nso mɛnyane anɔpahema.

Ao Awurade, mɛyi wo ayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu;
    mɛto wo ho dwom wɔ nnipa mu.

Wo dɔ yɛ kɛseɛ na ɛduru ɔsorosoro;
    wo nokorɛ kɔka ewiem.

Ao Onyankopɔn, woyɛ kɛseɛ wɔ ɔsorosoro hɔ;
    ma wʼanimuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so.

Mo sodifoɔ, ampa ara, moka asɛm a ɛtene anaa?
    Mobu atɛntenenee wɔ nnipa mu anaa?

Dabi! Modwene ntɛnkyea wɔ mʼakomam
    na mo nsa de akakabensɛm ba asase so.

Amumuyɛfoɔ fom kwan firi awoɔ mu;
    wɔyɛ mmaratofoɔ firi awotwaa mu na wɔdi atorɔ.

Wɔn ano ɛborɔ te sɛ ɔwɔ deɛ.
    Ɛte sɛ ɔprammire a watɛn nʼaso,

a ɔnte ntafowayifoɔ dwom,
    na ne dwom dɛɛdɛ no mpo mfa ne ho.

Ao Onyankopɔn, bubu ɛse a ɛgu wɔn anom,
    Ao Awurade, tutu agyata no sebɔmmɔfoɔ no gu!

Ma wɔntwa mu nkɔ sɛ nsunsuan;
    sɛ wɔtwe wɔn agyan a, ma wɔn bɛmma no ano nwu.

Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ nwa pɛkyɛpɛkyɛ bi a ɔretene kɔ.
    Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɔba a ɔwu wɔ awoeɛ na ɔnhunu owia.

Ansa na mo nkukuo bɛte nkasɛɛ ano yea,
    sɛ ɛyɛ mono anaa deɛ awo no, wɔbɛpra amumuyɛfoɔ akɔ.

Sɛ wɔtua amumuyɛfoɔ ka a, ateneneefoɔ ani bɛgye,
    na wɔbɛhohoro wɔn nan ho wɔ amumuyɛfoɔ mogya mu.

Afei nnipa bɛka sɛ, “Ampa ara, ateneneefoɔ kɔ so nya wɔn akatua;
    na ampa ara Onyankopɔn bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbu ewiase atɛn.”

Ao Onyankopɔn, gye me firi mʼatamfoɔ nsam;
    bɔ me ho ban firi wɔn a wɔtaa me so no ho.

Gye me firi amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.
    Gye me nkwa firi mogyapɛfoɔ nsam.

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatɛ repɛ me akum me
    akokobirefoɔ bɔ pɔ bɔne tia me
    a ɛnyɛ mfomsoɔ anaa bɔne bi a mayɛ enti, Ao Awurade.

Menyɛɛ mfomsoɔ bi, nanso wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛto ahyɛ me so.
    Sɔre bɛgye me; hwɛ mʼamanehunu!

Wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,
    wɔpɔ so sɛ nkraman,
    na wɔkyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.

Hwɛ deɛ wɔfe firi wɔn anomu,
    wɔfe akofena firi wɔn anomu
    na wɔka sɛ: “Hwan na ɔteɛ”?

Nanso, wo Awurade, wosere wɔn;
    wodi saa aman no nyinaa ho fɛw.

Ao mʼAhoɔden, mehwɛ wo;
    wo, Ao Onyankopɔn ne mʼabankɛseɛ,

me Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔdɔ.
    
  Onyankopɔn bɛdi mʼanim
    na ɔbɛma mahwɛ wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora no haa.

Nanso nkum wɔn, Ao Awurade yɛn akokyɛm,
    na me nkurɔfoɔ werɛ amfiri wɔn.
  Wo tumi mu no ma wɔnnantenante,
    na brɛ wɔn ase.

Bɔne a ɛfiri wɔn anomu,
    ne wɔn ano nsɛm enti
  ma wɔn ahomasoɔ nkyekyere wɔn.
    Abususɛm a wɔka ne atorɔ a wɔtwa enti,

sɛe wɔn wɔ abufuhyeɛ mu,
    kɔsi sɛ wɔn ase bɛtɔre.
  Afei ɛbɛma asase so afanan nyinaa ahunu
    sɛ Onyankopɔn di Yakob so.

Wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,
    wɔpɔ so sɛ nkraman
    na wɔkyinkyin kuropɔn no mu.

Wɔkyinkyini pɛ aduane
    na sɛ wɔammee a, wɔsu bobom.

Nanso mɛto wʼahoɔden ho dwom,
    mɛto wʼadɔeɛ ho dwom anɔpa;
  ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ mʼabankɛseɛ,
    mʼahintaeɛ wɔ ahohia mmerɛ mu.

Ao mʼAhoɔden, mɛto ayɛyi dwom ama wo;
    wo, Ao Onyankopɔn, ne mʼabankɛseɛ, me Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔdɔ.

Ao, Awurade nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabofuo mu,
    na ntwe mʼaso nso wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu.

Me kra wɔ ahohia mu.
    Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn, Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn?

Sane bra, Ao Awurade, na bɛgye me nkwa;
    gye me, wo dɔ a ɛnni hwammɔ no enti.

Obi a wawuo no renkae wo da,
    hwan na ɔfiri damena mu kamfo woɔ?

Apinisie ama mayɛ mmerɛ.
    Anadwo mu nyinaa mede agyaadwotwa fɔ me mpa
    na me nisuo fɔ me sumiiɛ.

Awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani so ayɛ me kusuu.
    Ɛredum mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa enti.

Mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, montwe mo ho mfiri me ho,
    ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ate me sufrɛ.

Awurade ate me mmɔborɔ su;
    Awurade tie me sufrɛ.

Ao Onyankopɔn, woapo yɛn, woabɔ yɛagu;
    wo bo afu yɛn, nanso gye yɛn bio!

Woawoso asase no na woapae mu;
    toatoa deɛ abubuo no, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛrehinhim.

Woama wo nkurɔfoɔ ahunu mmerɛ bɔne;
    woama yɛn nsã a ɛma yɛtɔ ntentan.

Nanso wɔn a wɔsuro wo deɛ, woama wɔn frankaa so
    sɛ wɔntu ntia kuntun no.

Gye yɛn nkwa na fa wo nsa nifa boa yɛn,
    na ama wɔn a wodɔ wɔn no anya nkwa.

Onyankopɔn akasa firi kronkronbea sɛ,
    “Nkonim mu, mɛkyɛ Sekem mu,
    na masusu Sukot bɔnhwa no.

Hwan na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu?
    Hwan na ɔbɛdi mʼanim akɔ Edom?

Ɛnyɛ wo, Ao Onyankopɔn, wo a woapo yɛn
    na wone yɛn akodɔm ankɔ sa bio no?

Boa yɛn tia ɔtamfoɔ no,
    na ɔdasani mmoa nka hwee.

Onyankopɔn wɔ yɛn afa yi, yɛbɛdi nkonim,
    na ɔbɛtiatia yɛn atamfoɔ so.

Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me sufrɛ;
    tie me mpaeɛbɔ.

Woayɛ me dwanekɔbea,
    aban a ɛyɛ den ma ɔtamfoɔ no.

Me kɔn dɔ sɛ metena wo ntomadan no mu afebɔɔ
    na manya hintabea wɔ wo ntaban nwunu ase.

Woate me bɔhyɛ, Ao Onyankopɔn;
    na wode wɔn a wɔsuro wo din no agyapadeɛ ama me.

To ɔhene nkwa nna mu bebree;
    na ne mfeɛ mfiri awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nkɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.

Ma ɔnni ɔhene wɔ Onyankopɔn anim daa.
    Fa wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ bɔ ne ho ban.

Afei mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo din daa
    na madi me bɔhyɛ so daa nyinaa.

Me ɔkra wɔ ahomegyeɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu;
    me nkwagyeɛ firi ne nkyɛn.

Ɔno nko ara ne me botan ne me nkwagyeɛ;
    ɔyɛ mʼaban, na merenhinhim da.

Mobɛkɔ so ahyɛ onipa baako so akɔsi da bɛn?
    Mo nyinaa mobɛsum no ahwe fam anaa?
    Mayɛ ɔfasuo a akyea, ɛban a ɛrebuo wɔ wɔn ani so.

Wɔayɛ adwene sɛ wɔbɛtu me
    afiri me diberɛ a ɛkorɔn no so;
  wɔn ani gye atorɔ die ho.
    Wɔde wɔn ano hyira
  na wɔn akoma mu deɛ, wɔdome.

Ao me kra, gye wʼahome wɔ Onyankopɔn nko ara mu;
    na ne mu na mʼanidasoɔ wɔ.

Ɔno nko ara ne me botan ne me nkwagyeɛ;
    ɔyɛ mʼaban, na merenhinhim.

Me nkwagyeɛ ne mʼanimuonyam gyina Onyankopɔn so;
    ɔyɛ me botan a ɛkorɔn, ne me dwanekɔbea.

Mommfa mo ho nto nsisie so
    na monnhoahoa mo ho korɔnodeɛ ho;
  ɛwom sɛ mo ahonya dɔɔso deɛ,
    nanso mommfa mo akoma nto so.

Asɛm baako na Onyankopɔn aka,
    nsɛm mmienu na mateɛ sɛ,
  wo, Onyankopɔn, wo na wowɔ ahoɔden,

na wo, Awurade, wo na woyɛ adɔeɛ.
    Ampa ara, wobɛtua obiara ka
    sɛdeɛ nʼadwuma teɛ.

Ao, Onyankopɔn, wone me Onyankopɔn
    Mehwehwɛ wo anibereɛ so;
  wo ho sukɔm de me kra,
    me onipadua ani agyina wo,
  wɔ asase a awo na ɛserɛ nni so,
    baabi a nsuo nnie.

Mahunu wo wɔ Kronkronbea hɔ
    mahunu wo tumi ne wʼanimuonyam.

Esiane sɛ, wʼadɔeɛ di mu sene nkwa enti
    mʼano fafa bɛhyɛ wo animuonyam.

Sɛ mete ase yi, mɛkamfo wo,
    na wo din mu na mɛpagya me nsa.

Me ɔkra bɛmee sɛdeɛ wadi aduane papa bi;
    mede anofafa a ɛto dwom bɛyi wo ayɛ.

Meda me mpa so a, mekae wo.
    Anadwo dasuo mu nyinaa, medwene wo ho.

Ɛfiri sɛ, wone ne ɔboafoɔ,
    wo ntaban ase nwunu mu na mɛto dwom.

Me kra bata wo ho;
    na wo nsa nifa kura me mu.

Wɔn a wɔpɛ me akum me no bɛsɛe;
    wɔbɛkɔ asase ase tɔnn.

Wɔbɛdane wɔn ama akofena
    na wɔbɛyɛ aduane ama sakraman.

Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me ɛberɛ a mereka me haw;
    bɔ me ɔkra ho ban firi ɔtamfoɔ ahunahuna ho.

Fa me sie firi amumuyɛfoɔ agyinatuo ho,
    ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ dodoɔ no gyegyeegyeyɛ ho.

Wɔse wɔn tɛkrɛma sɛ akofena
    na wɔse wɔn ano sɛ mmɛmma kɔdiawuo.

Wɔfiri atɛeɛ mu, to bɔ onipa a ne ho nni asɛm;
    wɔto bɔ no mpofirim a wɔnsuro.

Wɔbɔ atɛnkyea ho pɔ na wɔka sɛ,
    “Yɛayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ pɛ!”
  Ampa ara onipa akoma ne nʼadwene yɛ anifire.

Nanso, Onyankopɔn bɛto bɛmma awɔ wɔn;
    na wɔbɛhwe fam prɛko pɛ.

Ao, Onyankopɔn, ayɛyie retwɛn wo wɔ Sion,
    na yɛbɛdi yɛn bɔ a yɛahyɛ wo no so.

Ao, wo a woyɛ mpaeɛbɔ tiefoɔ,
    wo nkyɛn na nnipa nyinaa bɛba.

Ɛberɛ a yɛn bɔne menee yɛn no,
    wo na wɔde yɛn mmaratoɔ kyɛɛ yɛn.

Nhyira nka wɔn a woyi wɔn
    ma wɔbɛn wo sɛ wɔntena wʼadihɔ hɔ!
  Nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ wo fie ahyɛ yɛn ma,
    deɛ ɛwɔ wʼasɔredan kronkron mu no.

Wode tenenee nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwanwa ma yɛn mmuaeɛ,
    Ao Onyankopɔn yɛn agyenkwa.
  Woyɛ asase so afanan nyinaa anidasoɔ
    ne ɛpo so akyirikyiri nso.

Wonam wo tumi so yɛɛ mmepɔ
    de daa wʼahoɔden adi.

Wodwodwoo ɛpo nworosoɔ,
    asorɔkye no a ɛbobɔ
    ne amanaman no hooyɛ.

Wɔn a wɔte akyirikyiri no suro wʼanwanwadeɛ.
    Ɛfiri faako a adeɛ kye kɔsi deɛ onwunu dwoɔ,
    wofrɛ ahurisie nnwom wɔ hɔ.

Wohwɛ asase no gugu so nsuo;
    woma no yɛ asase pa ma ɛboro so.
  Wode nsuo hyɛ Onyankopɔn nsuwansuwa ma
    sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma nnipa no aduane.
    Sɛdeɛ woayɛ no nie.

Wofɔɔ deɛ woafuntum hɔ fɔkyee
    na wokaa nkofie no sram so;
  wode nsuo petee so maa no yɛɛ bɛtɛɛ
    na wohyiraa ɛso afifideɛ.

Wode nnɔbaeɛ bebree wiee afe no,
    na wo nteaseɛnam yɛɛ ma buu so.

Ɛserɛ so wira dɔɔso
    na anigyeɛ baa nkokoɔ so.
Asase nyinaa momfa ahosɛpɛ nteam mma Onyankopɔn!

Monto ne din animuonyamhyɛ ho dwom;
    momma nʼayɛyie nyɛ animuonyamhyɛ!

Monse Onyankopɔn sɛ, “Wo nneyɛɛ yɛ nwanwa
    wo tumi so
    na wʼatamfoɔ nyinaa de suro koto wʼanim.

Mommra mmɛhwɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn ayɛ;
    anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.

Ɔde ne tumi di ɔhene daa daa,
    na ɔde nʼani nso hwɛ aman so.
    Mma atuatefoɔ nsɔre ntia no.

Ao aman nyinaa, monhyira yɛn Onyankopɔn,
    momma wɔnte mo nkamfo no nnyegyeɛ.

Wahwɛ yɛn nkwa so
    na wamma yɛn nan anwatiri.

Na wo, Ao Onyankopɔn, wosɔɔ yɛn hwɛeɛ;
    na wohoaa yɛn ho sɛ dwetɛ.

Wode yɛn kɔguu nneduadan mu
    na wode nneɛma a ɛyɛ duru too yɛn akyi.

Mede ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛba wʼasɔredan mu
    na madi ɛbɔ a mahyɛ wo no so,

ɛbɔ a mʼano fafa hyɛeɛ na mʼano kaaeɛ
    ɛberɛ a na mewɔ ɔhaw mu no.

Mommra mmɛtie, mo a mosuro Onyankopɔn nyinaa;
    momma menka deɛ wayɛ ama me nkyerɛ mo.

Mede mʼano su frɛɛ no;
    na me tɛkrɛma yii no ayɛ.

Sɛ mede bɔne hyɛɛ mʼakomam a,
    anka Awurade antie me.

Nanso, nokorɛm, Onyankopɔn atie me,
    wate me mpaeɛbɔ.

Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn,
    a wampo me mpaeɛbɔ
    na wanyi nʼadɔeɛ amfiri me so.

Onyankopɔn nnom yɛn na ɔnhyira yɛn
    ɔmma nʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,

na ɔmma wɔnhunu nʼakwan wɔ asase so,
    ne ne nkwagyeɛ wɔ amanaman no nyinaa mu.

Ma adasamma nyi wo ayɛ, Ao Onyankopɔn;
    ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo.

Ma amanaman ani nnye na wɔnto ahosɛpɛ dwom,
    ɛfiri sɛ wodi nnipa no so tenenee mu
    na woma asase so amanaman no akwankyerɛ.

Ma adasamma nyi wo ayɛ, Ao Onyankopɔn;
    ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo!

Afei asase no bɛbɔ ne nnɔbaeɛ,
    na Onyankopɔn, yɛn Onyankopɔn ahyira yɛn.

Onyankopɔn bɛhyira yɛn,
    na wɔn a wɔte asase ano nyinaa bɛsuro no.

Ma Onyankopɔn nsɔre, na nʼatamfoɔ mmɔ mpete;
    wɔn a wɔtane noɔ no nnwane mfiri nʼanim.

Sɛdeɛ mframa bɔ wisie gu no,
    saa ara na bɔ wɔn gu;
  sɛdeɛ sradeɛ nane wɔ ogya so no,
    saa ara na amumuyɛfoɔ nyera mfiri Onyankopɔn anim.

To dwom ma Onyankopɔn, to dwom yi ne din ayɛ.
    Ma deɛ ɔnante omununkum soɔ no din so.
  Ne din ne Awurade;
    ma wʼani nnye wɔ nʼanim.

Nwisiaa agya ne deɛ ɔdi akunafoɔ asɛm ma wɔn
    ne Onyankopɔn a ɔte nʼatenaeɛ kronkron hɔ.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛberɛ a wodii wo nkurɔfoɔ anim,
    ɛberɛ a wode wɔn faa ɛserɛ so no,

asase wosoeɛ,
    na ɔsoro tuee osuo guu fam,
  wɔ Onyankopɔn, Sinai Onyankopɔn no,
    Onyankopɔn, Israel Onyankopɔn no anim.

Womaa osuo tɔɔ bebree, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    guu wʼagyapadeɛ a abotoɔ no so ma ɛyɛɛ frɔmm.

Wo nkurɔfoɔ bɔɔ atenaseɛ wɔ so.
    Ao Onyankopɔn, wonam wʼadɔeɛ bebree no mu hwɛɛ ahiafoɔ.

Awurade kaa asɛm no,
    na dodoɔ no ara ne wɔn a wɔpaee mu kaeɛ;

“Ahemfo ne wɔn asraafoɔ dwane ntɛm so;
    na mmaa kyɛ afodeɛ no.

Mpo wɔn a wɔn daberɛ wɔ nnwankuo mu no,
    wɔnya afodeɛ no bi.
    Wɔnya aborɔnoma a wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ ne sika adura wɔn ntaban so.”

Ɛberɛ a Otumfoɔ bɔɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase no so hweteeɛ no,
    na ɛte sɛ sukyerɛmma a agu Salmon so.

Basan mmepɔ gyinagyina hɔ,
  Basan mmepɔ so yɛ mmɔnkyi mmɔnka.

Ao mmepɔ mmɔnkyi mmɔnka, adɛn enti na mode ani bɔne
    hwɛ bepɔ a Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔbɛdi so ɔhene,
    baabi a Awurade ankasa bɛtena afebɔɔ?

Ɛberɛ a woforo kɔɔ soro no,
    wode nnommumfoɔ kaa wo ho;
    wonyaa ayɛyɛdeɛ firii nnipa hɔ,
  firii atuatefoɔ hɔ mpo,
    sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtena hɔ, Ao Awurade Onyankopɔn.

Ayɛyie nka Awurade Onyankopɔn, yɛn Agyenkwa,
    deɛ ɔsoa yɛn nnesoa da biara no.

Yɛn Onyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔgye nkwa;
    na Awurade na ɔgye yɛn firi owuo mu.

Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn bɛyam nʼatamfoɔ ti,
    wɔn a wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne no.

Awurade ka sɛ, “Mede wɔn bɛfiri Basan aba;
    mede wɔn bɛfiri ɛpo bunu mu aba,

na moanante wɔn a wɔkyiri moɔ no mogya mu
    na mo nkraman tɛkrɛma anya wɔn kyɛfa.”

Ao Onyankopɔn, yɛahunu wo santen yuu no,
    me Onyankopɔn ne me Ɔhene santen yuu no a ɔde reba ne kronkronbea hɔ.

Nnwontofoɔ no wɔ animu, ɛnna asankubɔfoɔ no nso di so,
    na mmabaawa a wɔrewoso akasaeɛ nso ka wɔn ho.

Monkamfo Onyankopɔn wɔ asafo kɛseɛ no mu;
    monkamfo Awurade wɔ Israel nipakuo no mu.

Abusuakuo ketewa Benyamin na ɔdi wɔn ɛkan,
    Yuda mmapɔmma kuo kɛseɛ no di so,
    na Sebulon ne Naftali mmapɔmma aba.

Kyerɛ wo tumi, Onyankopɔn;
    da wʼahoɔden adi kyerɛ yɛn, sɛdeɛ woayɛ pɛn no.

Wʼasɔredan a ɛwɔ Yerusalem enti
    ahemfo de ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ wo.

Ka aboa a ɔhyɛ demmire mu no anim,
    ne anantwinini kuo a wɔhyɛ amanaman no anantwie mma mu no.
  Brɛ wɔn ase kɔsi sɛ wɔde dwetɛ mpɔ bɛba.
    Bɔ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ɔko ho no pansam.

Ananmusifoɔ bɛfiri Misraim aba,
    na Kus de ne ho bɛma Onyankopɔn.

Ao ewiase ahennie, monto dwom mma Onyankopɔn,
    monto ayɛyi dwom mma Awurade,

monto mma deɛ ɔte tete soro soro so no,
    na ɔde nne kɛseɛ bobɔ mu no.

Mompae mu nka Onyankopɔn tumi,
    deɛ ne kɛseyɛ hata Israel so no,
    na ne tumi wɔ soro soro no.

Ao Onyankopɔn, gye me nkwa
    na nsuo no abɛdeda me kɔn mu.

Meremem wɔ atɛkyɛ a emu dɔ mu,
    wɔ baabi a me nan nnya siberɛ.
  Maduru subunu mu
    na nsuo abu afa me so.

Mafrɛ mabrɛ sɛ mepɛ mmoa.
    Me mene mu awe.
  Mʼani so ayɛ kusuu,
  na merehwehwɛ me Onyankopɔn.

Wɔn a wɔtane me kwa no dɔɔso
    sene me tiri so nwi;
  wɔn a wɔtane me kwa no dɔɔso,
    wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me no.
  Wɔhyɛ me sɛ mennane
    deɛ menwiaaɛ no mma.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wonim me kwasea a mayɛ;
    mʼafɔdie nhintaa wo.

Mma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no
    anim ngu ase ɛsiane me enti,
    Ao Awurade, Asafo Awurade;
  mma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo no
    anim ngu ase me enti,
    Ao Israel Onyankopɔn.

Wo enti wobu me animtiaa,
    na aniwuo akata mʼanim.

Mete sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ wɔ me nuanom mu,
    mete sɛ ɔmamfrani wɔ me maame mmammarima mu,

na wo fie ho mmɔdemmɔ hyɛ me so,
    wɔn a wɔbɔ wo ahohora no animtiabuo abɛda me so.

Sɛ metwa adwo na medi mmuada a
    wɔbɔ me ahohora;

sɛ mefira ayitoma a
    nnipa de me yɛ aseredeɛ.

Wɔn a wɔtete ɛpono no ano no sere me,
    na akɔwensafoɔ de me din to dwom.

Nanso mɛbɔ wo mpaeɛ, Ao Awurade,
    wɔ wʼadom berɛ mu;
  wɔ wʼadɔeɛ kɛseɛ no enti, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    fa wo nokorɛ nkwagyeɛ no gye me so.

Yi me firi atɛkyɛ no mu,
    mma memmem wɔ mu;
  gye me firi wɔn a wɔtane me no nsam,
    ne nsu bunu mu.

Mma nsuo nnyiri mfa me
    anaa ebunu mmene me
    anaa amena nkata me so.

Ao Awurade, gye me so firi wʼadɔeɛ a ɛyɛ no mu;
    wʼadom enti, dane bɛhwɛ me.

Mfa wʼanim nhinta wo ɔsomfoɔ;
    gye me so ntɛm, na mewɔ ɔhaw mu.

Twi bɛn me na gye me;
    gye me nkwa, mʼatamfoɔ enti.

Wonim sɛdeɛ wɔkasa tia me, gu mʼanim ase na wɔtiatia mʼanim;
    wʼani tua mʼatamfoɔ nyinaa.

Kasatia ahyɛ mʼakoma so
    ama mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnni ɔboafoɔ;
  mepɛɛ awerɛkyekyerɛ nanso mannya bi,
    mepɛɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ, nanso manhunu bi.

Wɔde bɔnwoma guu mʼaduane mu,
    osukɔm dee me no, wɔmaa me nsã nwononwono.

Ma wɔn didipono a ɛsi wɔn anim nyi wɔn sɛ afidie;
    ma ɛnyɛ akatua ne afidie mma wɔn.

Ma wɔn ani so nyɛ wɔn kusuu na wɔanhunu adeɛ,
    na ma wɔn akyi nkuntunu afebɔɔ.

Hwie wʼabufuhyeɛ gu wɔn so;
    na ma wʼabofuo huuhuuhu no mmra wɔn so.

Ma wɔn atenaeɛ nyɛ amamfo;
    mma obiara ntena wɔn ntomadan mu.

Wɔtaa wɔn a wopira wɔn no,
    wɔka wɔn a wopira wɔn no amanehunu ho asɛm.

Fa amumuyɛ mu amumuyɛ ho soboɔ bɔ wɔn;
    mma wɔnnya wo nkwagyeɛ mu kyɛfa.

Pepa wɔn din firi nkwa nwoma no mu,
    mfa wɔn din nka ateneneefoɔ deɛ ho.

Mewɔ ɔyea ne ahohiahia mu;
    Ao Onyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagyeɛ no mmɔ me ho ban.

Mede dwomtoɔ bɛyi Onyankopɔn din ayɛ
    na mede aseda ahyɛ no animuonyam.

Yei bɛsɔ Awurade ani yie asene nantwie,
    asene nantwinini a ɔtua mmɛn na ɔwɔ tɔte.

Mmɔborɔni bɛhunu na nʼani agye,
    mo a mohwehwɛ Onyankopɔn no akoma bɛnya nkwa.

Awurade tie wɔn a adeɛ ahia wɔn,
    na ɔmmu ne nkurɔfoɔ nneduafoɔ animtiaa.

Ma ɔsoro ne asase nkamfo no,
    ɛpo ne deɛ ɛkeka ne ho wɔ mu nyinaa,

Nʼasomfoɔ asefoɔ na wɔbɛfa hɔ,
    na wɔn a wɔdɔ ne din no bɛtena hɔ.

anyɛ saa a wɔbɛtete me mu sɛ gyata
    na wɔatete me mu asinasini a
    obiara rentumi nnye me.

Ao, Awurade me Onyankopɔn, sɛ mayɛ yei
    na sɛ afɔdie aba me so a,

sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia deɛ ɔne me te yie
    anaasɛ mabɔ me ɔtamfoɔ korɔno kwa a,

Sɔre wʼabufuo mu, Ao Awurade!
    Sɔre tia mʼatamfoɔ abufuo.
    Nyane, me Onyankopɔn; hyɛ atɛntenee mmara.

Ma nnipadɔm mmɛtwa wo ho nhyia.
    Firi soro hɔ di wɔn so;

ma Awurade mmu nnipa no atɛn.
  Bu me atɛn, Ao Awurade sɛdeɛ me teneneeyɛ teɛ,
    sɛdeɛ me nokorɛdie teɛ, Ao Ɔsorosoroni.

Ao Onyankopɔn teneneeni,
    wo a wohwehwɛ adwene ne akoma mu,
  fa amumuyɛfoɔ basabasayɛ bra awieeɛ
    na ma ateneneefoɔ nya banbɔ.

Mʼakokyɛm ne Ɔsorosoro Onyankopɔn
    deɛ ɔgye akoma mu teneneeni no.

Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔtemmufoɔ teneneeni,
    Onyame a ɔda nʼabufuo adi da biara.

Wasiesie ne kɔdiawuo akodeɛ;
    ayɛ ne bɛmma a ɛrederɛ no krado.

Deɛ ɔnyinsɛn amumuyɛ
    na basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma no, ɔwo nnaadaa.

Deɛ ɔtu tokuro na ɔyi mu dɔteɛ no
    hwe tokuro a watu no mu.

Ɔhaw a ɔde ba no dane bɔ nʼankasa so;
    ne basabasayɛ bɔ nʼankasa tiri so.

Mede aseda bɛma Awurade
    ne tenenee enti
  na mato ayɛyi dwom ayi Awurade, Ɔsorosoroni no din ayɛ.

Ao Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm gye me nkwa;
    Ao Awurade bra ntɛm bɛboa me.

Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra no
    anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;
  ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me sɛeɛ no nyinaa
    mfa animguaseɛ nsane wɔn akyi.

Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me no
    nsane wɔn akyi ɛsiane wɔn aniwuo enti.

Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaa
    nsɛpɛ wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu;
  ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagyeɛ no nka da biara sɛ,
    “Onyankopɔn yɛ kɛseɛ!”

Ao Awurade, wo mu na me dwane hinta;
    mma mʼanim ngu ase da.

Wo tenenee no enti, yi me na gye me;
    tie me na gye me nkwa.

Yɛ me nkwagyeɛ botan
    faako a mɛtumi akɔ daa;
  hyɛ ma wɔmmɛgye me nkwa,
    na wo ne me botan ne mʼaban.

Ao me Onyankopɔn, gye me firi amumuyɛfoɔ nsam,
    gye me firi nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ne atirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam.

Na woayɛ mʼanidasoɔ, Ao Asafo Awurade,
    mʼahotɔsoɔ firi mʼababunu berɛ mu.

Mayɛ nhwɛsodeɛ ama bebree,
    nanso wo ne me dwanekɔbea denden.

Wo nkamfo ahyɛ mʼanom ma,
    mekamfo wʼanimuonyam da mu nyinaa.

Nto me ntwene ɛberɛ a mabɔ akɔkoraa;
    mʼahoɔden sa me mu a, nnya me.

Ɛfiri sɛ mʼatamfoɔ kasa tia me
    wɔn a wɔtwɛn sɛ wɔbɛkum me no bom pam me tiri so.

Ao Onyankopɔn, mfiri me nkyɛn nkɔ akyiri;
    Ao me Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.

Nanso me deɛ, mɛnya anidasoɔ daa;
    mɛkɔ so makamfo wo.

Mɛka wo tenenee ho asɛm,
    ne wo nkwagyeɛ da mu nyinaa,
    nanso mennim ano.

Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade, mɛba abɛpae mu aka wo nnwuma akɛseɛ no;
    mɛpae mu aka wo nko ara tenenee akyerɛ.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ɛfiri mʼababunu berɛ na wokyerɛkyerɛɛ me,
    na ɛbɛsi ɛnnɛ yi, meka wʼanwanwadeɛ a woayɛ kyerɛ.

Mpo sɛ mebɔ akɔkoraa na mefu dwono a,
    Ao Onyankopɔn, nnya me,
  kɔsi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma,
    ne wo kɛseyɛ akyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wo tenenee duru sorosoro,
    wo a woayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ.
    Ao Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ wo?

Wobɛhyɛ me animuonyam bebree
    na woakyekye me werɛ bio.

Mede sankuo bɛkamfo wo
    Ao me Onyankopɔn, wo tenenee enti
  mɛto wʼayɛyi dwom wɔ sankuten so
    Ao Israel Kronkronni.

Mʼanofafa de anigyeɛ bɛteam
    ɛberɛ a meto dwom kamfo woɔ,
    me a woagye me no.

Me tɛkrɛma bɛka wo tenenee nnwuma
    da mu nyinaa,
  ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔha me no
    kɔ animguaseɛ ne basabasayɛ mu.

Ao Onyankopɔn, fa wʼatɛntenenee ma ɔhene no,
    na fa wo tenenee ma ɔhene babarima.

Ɔde tenenee bɛbu wo nkurɔfoɔ atɛn,
    ɔbɛbu wo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehunu amane no atɛntenenee.

Mmepɔ no de yiedie bɛbrɛ nnipa no,
    nkokoɔ no de tenenee bɛba.

Owia ne ɔsrane da so wɔ hɔ yi
    wɔbɛsuro wo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Ɔbɛyɛ sɛ osuo a ɛtɔ gu asase a wɔadɔ soɔ so,
    te sɛ obosuo a ɛgugu asase so.

Teneneefoɔ bɛnyini frɔmfrɔm wɔ ne berɛ so;
    yiedie bɛbu so kɔsi da a ɔsrane nni hɔ bio.

Ɔbɛdi ɔhene afiri ɛpo akɔsi ɛpo
    afiri Asubɔnten Efrata akɔsi asase ano.

Ɛserɛ so mmusua bɛkoto nʼanim
    na nʼatamfoɔ adi mfuturo.

Tarsis ne mpoano ahemfo a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri
    de apeatoɔ bɛbrɛ no;
  Saba ne Seba ahemfo
    de ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ no.

Ahemfo nyinaa bɛkoto no
    amanaman nyinaa bɛsom no.

Na ɔbɛgye mmɔborɔfoɔ a wɔsu frɛ no,
    ne amanehunufoɔ a wɔnni ɔboafoɔ.

Ɔbɛhunu wɔn a wɔayɛ mmrɛ ne ahiafoɔ mmɔbɔ
    na wagye ahiafoɔ nkwa.

Ɔbɛgye wɔn afiri nhyɛsoɔ ne akakabensɛm mu,
    ɛfiri sɛ wɔn mogya som bo wɔ nʼanim.

Ɔhene nkwa so!
    Ma wɔmfa sikakɔkɔɔ mfiri Seba mmrɛ no.
  Ma nnipa mmɔ mpaeɛ mma no
    na wɔnhyira no da mu nyinaa.

Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa;
    ɛntena hɔ nkyɛre sɛ owia.
    
  Wɔbɛfa ne so ahyira amanaman no,
    na wɔbɛfrɛ no nhyira.

Nhyira nka Awurade Onyankopɔn, Israel Onyankopɔn!
    Ɔno nko ara na ɔyɛ anwanwadeɛ.

Nhyira nka ne din a animuonyam ahyɛ no ma no daa daa.
    Ma nʼanimuonyam nhyɛ ewiase nyinaa ma.
    Amen! Amen!
Yisai ba Dawid mpaeɛbɔ no awieeɛ nie.

Ampa ara Onyankopɔn yɛ ma Israel,
    ɔyɛ ma wɔn a wɔn akoma mu teɛ.

Nanso me deɛ, anka me nan reyɛ awatiri;
    anka merehwere me nnyinasoɔ,

ɛfiri sɛ, mʼani beree ahantanfoɔ
    ɛberɛ a mehunuu amumuyɛfoɔ yiedie no.

Wɔnhunuu ahokyere da;
    na wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne apɔmuden.

Dadwene a ɛtaa ba nnipa soɔ biara nna wɔn so;
    ɔdasani haw biara nna wɔn so.

Enti, ahantan yɛ wɔn kɔnmuadeɛ,
    na wɔde akakabensɛm afira.

Wɔn akoma a apirim no mu na nnebɔne firie;
    na wɔn amumuyɛ adwene nni mma ɔka.

Wɔsere afoforɔ na wɔka wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛnyɛ;
    wɔde nhyɛsoɔ hunahuna afoforɔ wɔ ahomasoɔ mu.

Wɔn ano ka ɔsoro nsɛm,
    na wɔn tɛkrɛma agye asase afa.

Ɛno enti wɔn nkurɔfoɔ kɔ wɔn nkyɛn
    na wonya nsuo bebree nom.

Wɔbisa sɛ, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn ahunu?
    Na Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ nhunumu anaa?”

Sei na amumuyɛfoɔ no teɛ,
    hwee mfa wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ so pɛ ahonyadeɛ.

Ampa ara, mʼakoma a ɛho teɛ no, mannya hwee amfiri mu;
    me nsa a ɛnni fɔ no ayɛ kwa.

Ɛda mu nyinaa mehunu amane;
    anɔpa biara wɔtwe mʼaso.

Sɛ mekaa sɛ, “Mɛkasa saa” a,
    anka medii wo mma no hwammɔ.

Mebɔɔ mmɔden sɛ mɛte yeinom nyinaa ase,
    nanso na ɛhyɛ me so

kɔsii sɛ mekɔɔ Onyankopɔn kronkronbea hɔ;
    ɛhɔ na metee deɛ ɛbɛba wɔn so awieeɛ no ase.

Ampa ara wode wɔn gu baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ toro.
    Wode wɔn hwe fam sɛe wɔn pasaa.

Sɛdeɛ wɔsɛe prɛko pɛ,
    na ehu hwim wɔn kɔ no,

ɛte sɛ daeɛso, ɛberɛ a onipa anyaneɛ,
    Ao Awurade, sɛ wokanyane wo ho a,
    wobɛbu wʼani agu wɔn so sɛ biribi a ɛnni hɔ.

Ɛberɛ a awerɛhoɔ hyɛɛ mʼakoma mu
    na me sunsum dii yea no,

meyɛɛ sɛ obi a ɔnnim hwee na ɔnni adwene;
    meyɛɛ sɛ aboa gyimifoɔ wɔ wʼanim.

Nanso, na mene wowɔ hɔ ɛberɛ biara;
    na wode wo nsa nifa asɔ me mu.

Wode wʼafotuo kyerɛ me ɛkwan;
    na akyire no, wode me bɛkɔ animuonyam mu.

Hwan na mewɔ wɔ soro ka wo ho?
    Na biribiara nni asase so a mepɛ ka wo ho.

Me honam, ne mʼakoma bɛdi me hwammɔ,
    nanso Onyankopɔn ne mʼakoma ahoɔden
    ne me kyɛfa daa nyinaa.

Wɔn a wɔmmɛn wo no bɛyera.
    Wosɛe wɔn a wɔnni wo nokorɛ nyinaa.

Ao Onyankopɔn, adɛn enti na woapo yɛn koraa yi?
    Adɛn enti na wʼabofuo hye wʼadidibea nnwan?

Kae nkurɔfoɔ a wotɔɔ wɔn teteete no,
    abusua a ɛyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ a wogyee wɔn no,
    Bepɔ Sion, baabi a woteɛ hɔ.

Dane wo ho kyerɛ mmubuiɛ a ɛda so wɔ hɔ yi so,
    saa ɔsɛeɛ a ɔtamfoɔ no de abrɛ wo kronkronbea no.

Wʼatamfoɔ bobɔɔ mu wɔ baabi a wohyiaa yɛn no;
    wɔasisi wɔn mfrankaa sɛ agyiraeɛhyɛdeɛ wɔ hɔ.

Wɔyɛɛ wɔn sɛ nnipa a wɔrehwim mmonnua
    de abubu nnua a ayɛ nkyɛkyerɛ.

Wɔde wɔn mmonnua ne nname
    bubuu nnua a wɔasene adi ho adwinneɛ no.

Wɔhyee wo kronkronbea no dwerɛbee;
    wɔguu baabi a wo Din teɛ no ho fi.

Wɔkaa wɔ wɔn akoma mu sɛ, “Yɛbɛtiatia wɔn so ayɛ wɔn pasaa!”
    Wɔhyee baabiara a wɔsom Onyankopɔn wɔ asase no so.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wʼatamfoɔ bɛsere wo akɔsi da bɛn?
    Wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ no bɛgu wo din ho fi daa anaa?

Adɛn enti na woatwe wo nsa, wo nsa nifa no?
    Yi firi wʼatadeɛ mmobɔeɛ no mu na sɛe wɔn.

Nanso, Ao Onyankopɔn, woyɛ me ɔhene firi tete;
    wode nkwagyeɛ ba asase so.

Ɛyɛ wo na wode wo tumi paee ɛpo mu no;
    wopɛkyɛɛ nsuo mu ɔtweaseɛ no ti.

Wopɛkyɛɛ Lewiatan no ti
    na wode no maa ɛserɛ so abɔdeɛ sɛ wɔn aduane.

Wo na womaa nsuwa ne nsutire tueeɛ;
    na womaa nsubɔntene a ɛtene weweeɛ.

Adekyeeɛ wɔ wo na adesaeɛ nso yɛ wo dea;
    wode owia ne ɔsrane sisii hɔ.

Ɛyɛ wo na wototoo asase so ahyeɛ nyinaa;
    wobɔɔ ahuhuro ne awɔ mmerɛ.

Ao Awurade, kae sɛdeɛ ɔtamfoɔ no sere woɔ,
    sɛdeɛ nkwaseafoɔ agu wo din ho fi.

Mfa wʼaborɔnoma nkwa mma nkekaboa;
    mma wo werɛ mfiri wo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehunu amane no nkwa afebɔɔ.

Ma wʼapam no ho nhia wo,
    ɛfiri sɛ akakabensɛm ahyɛ asase no so sum ma.

Mma wɔn a wɔahyɛ wɔn soɔ no anim nngu ase;
    ma ahiafoɔ ne mmɔborɔfoɔ nkamfo wo din.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ma wo ho so na ka wo ara wʼasɛm;
    kae sɛdeɛ nkwaseafoɔ sere wo da mu nyinaa.

Mmu wʼani ngu wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo no nteateam so,
    wʼatamfoɔ gyegyeegye a ɛkɔ soro daa no.

Woka sɛ, “Me na mehyɛɛ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ no;
    ɛyɛ me na mebu atɛntenenee.

Sɛ asase ne ɛso nnipa nyinaa woso a,
    me na mema nʼafadum gyina hɔ pintinn.

Meka kyerɛ ahantanfoɔ sɛ, ‘Monnhoahoa mo ho bio,’
    na meka kyerɛ amumuyɛfoɔ nso sɛ, ‘Mommma mo mmɛn so.

Mommma mo mmɛn so ntia ɔsoro;
    mommfa animtiabuo nkasa.’ ”

Obiara mmfiri apueeɛ anaa atɔeɛ
    anaa ɛserɛ no so a ɔbɛtumi ama obi so.

Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔbu atɛn:
    Ɔbrɛ ɔbaako ase, na ɔma ɔfoforɔ so.

Kuruwa bi hyɛ Awurade nsam
    nsã bi a ɛtwa ahuro a wɔde nnuhwam afra ahyɛ no ma;
  ɔhwie, na asase so amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa
    nom ma ɛka aseɛ puo.

Me deɛ, mɛpae mu aka yei daa daa;
    mɛto ayɛyi dwom ama Yakob Onyankopɔn.

Mɛbubu amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa mmɛn,
    nanso mɛma ateneneefoɔ ahoɔden foforɔ.

Wɔnim Onyankopɔn wɔ Yuda;
    ne din so wɔ Israel.

Ne ntomadan si Salem,
    ne tenaberɛ wɔ Sion.

Ɛhɔ na ɔbubuu mmemma a ɛte ogya,
    ɛkyɛm ne akofena, akodeɛ nyinaa mu.

Wo ho hann no hyerɛn,
    na wo so sene mmepɔ a mmoadoma ahyɛ mu ma no.

Mmarima akokoɔdurufoɔ deda hɔ a wɔagye wɔn ho nneɛma,
    wɔadeda awufoɔ nna;
  na akofoɔ no mu baako mpo
    ntumi mpagya ne nsa.

Ao Yakob Onyankopɔn, wokaa wɔn anim no
    apɔnkɔ no ne nteaseɛnam no adeda dinn.

Wo nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsuro woɔ.
    Sɛ wo bo fu a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina wʼanim?

Wobuu atɛn firii soro,
    asase suroeɛ na ɛyɛɛ dinn,

ɛberɛ a wosɔre buu atɛn, Ao Onyankopɔn,
    de gyee amanehunufoɔ wɔ asase no so.

Ampa ara wʼabufuhyeɛ a ɛtia nnipa no de ayɛyie brɛ wo,
    na wɔn a wɔtumi gyina ano no nya kɔkɔbɔ.

Ɔbrɛ sodifoɔ honhom ase;
    na asase so ahemfo suro no.

Mesu mefrɛɛ Onyankopɔn srɛɛ mmoa;
    mesu mefrɛɛ no sɛ ɔntie me.

Ao Onyankopɔn mekaee wo, na mesii apinie;
    medwendweneeɛ, na me honhom tɔɔ piti.

Woamma mʼani ankum;
    amanehunu dodoɔ enti, mantumi ankasa.

Medwenee nna a atwam no ho,
    teteete mfeɛ no ho;

mekaee me nnwom a na meto no anadwo.
    Mʼakoma dwenee ho na me honhom bisaa sɛ:

“Enti, Awurade bɛpo yɛn daa?
    Ɔrenhunu yɛn mmɔbɔ bio anaa?

Nʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da atu ayera koraa anaa?
    Na ne bɔhyɛ no, amma mu koraa anaa?

Onyankopɔn werɛ afiri sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ anaa?
    Abufuo enti ne yam nhyehye no bio anaa?”

Afei, medwenee sɛ, “Onyankopɔn Ɔsorosoroni,
    deɛ ɛhyɛ me kra so ne sɛ, wommfa wo tete nsa nifa no mmoa yɛn bio.”

Mɛkae nneɛma a Awurade ayɛ;
    aane, mɛkae wʼanwanwadeɛ a woyɛɛ tete no.

Mɛdwene wo nnwuma nyinaa ho
    na masusu wo nneyɛɛ akɛseɛ nyinaa ho.

Ao Onyankopɔn, wʼakwan yɛ kronn.
    Onyame bɛn na ɔso sɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn?

Wone Onyankopɔn a woyɛ anwanwadeɛ;
    wokyerɛ wo tumi wɔ aman mu.

Wode wo tumi nsa no gyee wo nkurɔfoɔ,
    Yakob ne Yosef asefoɔ no.

Wode wo kwan faa ɛpo mu,
    wode faa nsuo kɛseɛ mu,
    nanso wɔanhunu wʼanammɔn.

Wonam Mose ne Aaron so
    dii wo nkurɔfoɔ anim sɛ nnwankuo.

Ao me nkurɔfoɔ, montie me nkyerɛkyerɛ;
    monyɛ aso mma mʼanomu nsɛm.

Mɛkasa wɔ abɛbuo mu,
    mɛka ahintasɛm, teteete nneɛma no,

nneɛma a yɛate na yɛahunu;
    nneɛma a yɛn agyanom aka ho asɛm akyerɛ yɛn.

Ɔyɛɛ ahyɛdeɛ maa Yakob
    na ɔyɛɛ mmara wɔ Israel,
  deɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn nananom
    sɛ wɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma,

sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, nkyirimma bɛsua
    mpo mmɔfra a wɔnnya nwoo wɔn,
    na wɔn nso akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma.

Afei wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Onyankopɔn so,
    na wɔn werɛ remfiri ne nneyɛɛ,
    na wɔbɛdi nʼahyɛdeɛ so.

Wɔrenyɛ sɛ wɔn nananom,
    a na wɔyɛ asoɔdenfoɔ ne atuatefoɔ,
  wɔn a wɔn akoma mu wɔnni Onyankopɔn nokorɛ
    na woyɛ honhom mu atorofoɔ ma noɔ no.

Ɛwom sɛ na Efraim mmarima kurakura agyan,
    nanso ɔko da no, wɔdwaneeɛ;

Wɔanni Onyankopɔn apam no so
    wɔampɛ sɛ wɔdi ne mmara no so.

Wɔn werɛ firii deɛ wayɛ,
    anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ akyerɛ wɔn no.

Ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔn nananom anim
    wɔ Soan mantam a ɛwɔ Misraim asase so.

Ɔkyɛɛ ɛpo mu na ɔde wɔn faa mu.
    Ɔmaa nsuo no gyinaa sɛ afasuo.

Ɔde omununkum dii wɔn anim awia
    na ɔde ogyadum dii wɔn anim anadwo nyinaa.

Ɔpaee ɔbotan mu wɔ ɛserɛ so,
    na ɔmaa wɔn nsuo a ɛdɔɔso sɛ ɛpo;

Ɔmaa asutire firii abotan mu
    na ɔmaa nsuo tenee sɛ nsubɔntene.

Nanso, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa no,
    wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ ɛserɛ no so.

Wɔboapa sɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ;
    wɔbisaa aduane a wɔpɛ.

Wɔkasa tiaa Onyankopɔn sɛ,
    “Onyankopɔn bɛtumi ato ɛpono wɔ ɛserɛ so anaa?

Ɔde adeɛ bɔɔ ɔbotan mu no, nsuo to firi mu baeɛ,
    na nsuwa bebree tenee hɔ.
  Na ɔbɛtumi ama yɛn aduane nso?
    Ɔbɛtumi ama ne nkurɔfoɔ ɛnam anaa?”

ɛfiri sɛ, na wɔnni Onyankopɔn mu gyidie
    anaasɛ ne nkwagyeɛ mu ahotosoɔ.

Nanso, ɔkasa kyerɛɛ ɔsoro ɔhyɛ so;
    na ɔbuee ɔsorosoro apono.

Ɔtɔɔ mana firi soro maa nnipa no sɛ wonni,
    ɔmaa wɔn ɔsoro aduane.

Nnipa dii abɔfoɔ aduane;
    ɔmaa wɔn aduane a wɔbɛtumi adi nyinaa.

Ɔmaa apueeɛ mframa bɔ firii sorosoro,
    na ɔde ne tumi bɔɔ atɔeɛ mframa.

Ɔtoo ɛnam sɛ mfuturo guu wɔn so,
    nnomaa a wɔtu bebree sɛ mpoano anwea.

Ɔma wɔbaa fam kɔɔ wɔn atenaeɛ,
    ne wɔn ntomadan ho nyinaa.

Wɔdidi maa aduane no boroo wɔn so
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔmaa wɔn deɛ wɔhwehwɛ.

Nanso ansa na wɔbɛfiri aduane a wɔhwehwɛeɛ no ho,
    ɛberɛ a ɛhyehyɛ wɔn anomu mpo no,

Yeinom nyinaa akyi, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne;
    nʼanwanwadeɛ akyi no, wɔannye anni.

Enti, ɔtwaa wɔn nna so te sɛ ahuro
    yɛɛ wɔn mfeɛ awieeɛ huhuuhu.

Ɛberɛ biara a Onyankopɔn bɛkum wɔn no, wɔhwehwɛɛ no,
    na wɔpere wɔn ho sane baa ne nkyɛn.

Wɔkaee sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ wɔn botan,
    sɛ Ɔsorosoro Onyankopɔn no yɛ wɔn Gyefoɔ.

Nanso, wɔde wɔn ano bɛdaadaa no,
    na wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma twaa atorɔ kyerɛɛ no;

wɔn akoma anni no nokorɛ,
    na wɔanni nʼapam no so.

Nanso na ɔyɛ ahummɔborɔ;
    ɔde wɔn amumuyɛ kyɛɛ wɔn
    a wansɛe wɔn.
  Mpɛn bebree ɔtwentwɛnee nʼabufuo so
    na wanhwie nʼabufuhyeɛ nyinaa.

Ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ ɔhonam ara kwa,
    mframa bi a ɛbɔ twam na ɛnsane nʼakyi.

Mpɛn ahe na wɔansɔre antia no wɔ ɛserɛ no so hɔ,
    na mpɛn ahe na wɔamma ne werɛ anho wɔ asase wesee no so?

Wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ ɛberɛ biara;
    na wɔyii Israel Ɔkronkronni no abufuo.

Wɔn werɛ firii ne tumi no,
    ɛda a ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn nhyɛsofoɔ nsam no,

ɛda a ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nwanwasoɔ wɔ Misraim no
    ne nʼanwanwadeɛ wɔ Soan mantam mu no.

Ɔmaa wɔn nsubɔntene danee mogya;
    wɔantumi annom wɔn asutene mu nsuo.

Ɔmaa nwansenadɔm baa wɔn so bɛhaa wɔn
    na mponkyerɛne nso bɛsɛee wɔn asase.

Ɔmaa mmɛbɛ bɛdii wɔn mfuo so aduane
    na ɔde wɔn mfudeɛ nso maa ntutummɛ.

Ɔde asukɔtweaa sɛee wɔn bobe
    na ɔde nsukyeneeɛ sɛee wɔn ankye nnua.

Ɔde sukyerɛmma kumm wɔn anantwie
    ɔde anyinam kumm wɔn nyɛmmoa.

Ɔkunkumm Misraimfoɔ mmakan nyinaa,
    Ham ntomadan mu nnipa mu abakan.

Nanso ɔyii ne nkurɔfoɔ firii mu sɛ nnwankuo;
    ɔdii wɔn anim sɛ nnwan wɔ ɛserɛ no so.

Ɔdii wɔn anim dwoodwoo, enti wɔansuro;
    nanso wɔn atamfoɔ deɛ, ɛpo asorɔkye bu faa wɔn so.

Sei na ɔyɛ de wɔn baa nʼasase kronkron no ahyeɛ so,
    bepɔ asase a ɔde ne nsa nifa gyeeɛ no.

Wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔn agyanom, wɔanni nokorɛ na wɔannya gyidie,
    ahotosoɔ nni wɔn mu, na wɔte sɛ agyan a asɛe.

Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea hyɛɛ no abufuo
    na wɔn ahoni maa ne ninkuntwe mu yɛɛ den.

Onyankopɔn tee wɔn nka no, ne bo fuiɛ;
    na ɔpoo Israel korakora.

Ɔgyaa nʼatenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Silo no hɔ
    ntomadan a wasi wɔ nnipa mu no.

Ɔde Apam Adaka a ɛyɛ ne tumi no kɔɔ nnommumfa mu,
    nʼanimuonyam kɔɔ atamfoɔ nsam.

Ɔde ne nkurɔfoɔ maa akofena;
    ne bo fuu nʼagyapadeɛ yie.

Egya hyee wɔn mmeranteɛ kumm wɔn,
    na wɔn mmabaawa annya ayeforɔhyia dwom anto;

Wɔn asɔfoɔ wuwuu akofena ano,
    na wɔn akunafoɔ antumi ansu.

Afei Awurade sɔree sɛdeɛ ɔfiri nna mu no,
    sɛdeɛ ɔbarima a waboro nsã nyane firi nnahɔɔ mu no.

Ɔbobɔɔ nʼatamfoɔ ma wɔdwane kɔɔ wɔn akyi;
    ɔhyɛɛ wɔn aniwuo afebɔɔ.

Afei ɔpoo Yosef ntomadan no,
    na wamfa Efraim abusuakuo no nso;

Na mmom, ɔfaa Yuda abusuakuo no,
    Bepɔ Sion a ɔdɔ noɔ no.

Ɔsii ne kronkronbea te sɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea,
    te sɛ asase a ɛtim hɔ daa.

Ɔyii ne ɔsomfoɔ Dawid;
    ɔfrɛɛ no firii nnwammuo mu

firii nnwan akyiridie, na ɔde no baeɛ
    sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ mma ne nkurɔfoɔ Yakob,
    mma Israel a wɔyɛ nʼagyapadeɛ.

Na Dawid de akoma pa hwɛɛ wɔn so
    na ɔde ne nimdeɛ dii wɔn anim.

Wɔde wʼasomfoɔ afunu ayɛ aduane
    ama ewiem nnomaa,
  na wɔde wʼahotefoɔ ɛnam ama asase so mmoa.

Wɔahwie mogya agu te sɛ nsuo
    wɔ Yerusalem ho nyinaa,
    na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛsie awufoɔ no.

Yɛayɛ animtiabudeɛ ama yɛn mfɛfoɔ,
    fɛdie ne nsopa ama wɔn a atwa yɛn ho ahyia.

Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Wo bo bɛfu afebɔɔ anaa?
    Wo ninkunu bɛdɛre sɛ ogya akɔsi da bɛn?

Hwie wʼabofuo gu amanaman
    a wɔnni woɔ no so,
  ahennie a
    wɔmmɔ wo din no;

ɛfiri sɛ wɔakum Yakob
    na wɔasɛe nʼatenaeɛ.

Ao Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa, boa yɛn,
    wo din no animuonyam nti;
  gye yɛn na fa yɛn bɔne kyɛ yɛn
    wo din enti.

Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ amanaman ka sɛ,
    “Wɔn Onyankopɔn wɔ he?”
  Yɛn anim ha ara, ma wɔnhunu wɔ amanaman mu sɛ
    wotɔ wʼasomfoɔ mogya a wɔahwie agu no so werɛ.

Ao Awurade, ahohora a yɛn mfɛfoɔ asum agu wo soɔ no,
    tua wɔn so ka mprɛnson.

Na yɛn a yɛyɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ, wʼadidibea nnwan no,
    bɛyi wo ayɛ daa nyinaa;
  ɛfiri awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ
    yɛbɛkɔ so aka wʼayɛyie akyerɛ.

Ao Awurade, yɛn Awurade,
    wo din kɛseyɛ ada adi ewiase afanan nyinaa.
    
  Wode wʼanimuonyam
    atimtim ɔsoro nohoa,

Sɛ mehwɛ wo soro,
    wo nsateaa ano adwuma;
  ɔsrane ne nsoromma a
    wode obiara asi nʼafa a,

onipa ne hwan a wokae no,
    na onipa ba nso ne hwan a wʼani ku ne ho?

Wobɔɔ no ma ɔyɛɛ akumaa kakra sene abɔfoɔ
    na wode wʼanimuonyam ne anidie abɔ no abotire.

Woyɛɛ no sodifoɔ maa wo nsa ano adwuma
    wode nneɛma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nan ase:

nnwankuo ne nantwikuo nyinaa
    ne wiram mmoa nso,

ewiem nnomaa
    ne ɛpo mu mpataa,
    deɛ ɛnenam ɛpo mu akwan so nyinaa.

Ao, Awurade, yɛn Awurade,
    wo din yɛ kɛseɛ wɔ asase nyinaa so!

Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade Onyankopɔn,
    wʼabofuo bɛdɛre akɔsi da bɛn
    wʼabofuo a ɛtia wo nkurɔfoɔ mpaeɛbɔ no?

Wode nisuo yɛɛ aduane maa wɔn diiɛ;
    wode nisuo kuruwa ma ma wɔnomeeɛ.

Woama yɛn mfɛfoɔ abu yɛn animtiaa,
    na yɛn atamfoɔ sere yɛn.

Wode bobe firi Misraim baeɛ;
    wopamoo amanaman no na woduaaɛ.

Wosiesiee asase no baabi maa no,
    ɛgyee nhini na ɛtrɛɛ asase no so.

Ne nwunu kataa mmepɔ no so
    ne mman kataa ntweneduro akɛseɛ no so.

Ɛdendanee kɔɔ Ɛpo so,
    na ɛfefɛ kɔduruu Asubɔnten no ho.

Adɛn enti na woabubu nʼafasuo
    ama wɔn a wɔtwam hɔ tete ne bobe aba no?

Kɔkɔte firi wiram bɛsɛe no pasaa
    na mmoadoma a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ so de yɛ wɔn aduane.

Ao Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, sane bra yɛn nkyɛn!
    Firi soro hɔ hwɛ na wobɛhunu!
  Hwɛ saa bobe yi so,

ntini a wo nsa nifa adua no,
    ɔbabarima a woatete no ama wo ho no.

Wɔatwa wo bobe no ato fam, ato mu ogya ama ahye;
    wʼanimka ma wo nkurɔfoɔ ase tɔre.

Fa wo nsa kata ɔbarima a ɔwɔ wo nifa no so,
    onipa ba a woatete no ama wo ho no.

Afei yɛrentwe yɛn ho mfiri wo nkyɛn;
    kanyane yɛn, na yɛbɛbɔ wo din.

Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio,
    na ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so,
    na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

Monto ahurisie dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden;
    mommɔ ose mma Yakob Onyankopɔn no!

Momma nnwom no so na monwoso akasaeɛ.
  Mommɔ sankuo ne bɛnta dɛɛdɛ no.

Monhyɛne mmɛntia ɔsrane foforɔ da no,
    ne ɔsrane korokumatwa mu, yɛn Apontoɔ da no;

Yei yɛ Israelfoɔ ahyɛdeɛ,
    Yakob Onyankopɔn mmara.

Ɔtintimiiɛ sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ maa Yosef
    ɛberɛ a ɔsɔre tiaa Misraim no,
    faako a yɛtee kasa a yɛnte aseɛ no.

Ɔka sɛ, “Meyii adesoa no firii mo mmatire so,
    ne mo nsa firii adwumaden ho.

“Ao me nkurɔfoɔ, montie me kɔkɔbɔ yi,
    Ao Israel, sɛ mobɛtie me a!

Ɛnsɛ sɛ monya anyame foforɔ bi wɔ mo mu;
    ɛnsɛ sɛ mokoto ananafoɔ nyame.

Mene Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn a
    meyii mo firii Misraim asase so no.
    Mommue mo anom tɛtrɛɛ na mɛhyɛ mu ma.

“Nanso me nkurɔfoɔ rentie me;
    Israel remmrɛ ne ho ase mma me.

Enti megyaa wɔn maa wɔn akomaden
    sɛ wɔnyɛ deɛ wɔpɛ biara.

“Sɛ me nkurɔfoɔ tie me,
    na Israel nante mʼakwan so a,

anka mɛdi wɔn atamfoɔ so ama wɔn ntɛm
    na mama me basa so atia wɔn a wɔkyiri wɔn!

Wɔn a wɔtane Awurade no de suro bɛkoto no,
    na wɔn asotwe to rentwa da.

Nanso, wɔde atokoɔ mu atokoɔ papa bɛma mo adi;
    mede ɔbotan mu woɔ bɛma mo amee.”

Onyankopɔn di ɔhene wɔ ɔsoro asafo mu;
    ɔbu atɛn wɔ “anyame” mu.

“Wobɛbɔ wɔn a wɔnteneɛ ho ban
    na woayɛ animhwɛ ama amumuyɛfoɔ akɔsi da bɛn?

Monka mmɔborɔfoɔ ne nwisiaa asɛm mma wɔn;
    mommɔ ahiafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so yiedie ho ban.

Monnye ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani;
    monnye wɔn mfiri amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.

“Mekaa sɛ, ‘Moyɛ “anyame”;
    mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.’

Nanso, mobɛwuwu sɛ nnipa pɛ;
    na moahwe ase sɛ sodifoɔ biara.”

Ao Onyankopɔn, sɔre na bɛbu ewiase atɛn;
    ɛfiri sɛ amanaman nyinaa yɛ wo dea.

Ao Onyankopɔn, ntena hɔ komm;
    mmua wʼano, Ao Onyankopɔn, keka wo ho.

Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wʼatamfoɔ keka wɔn ho fa,
    na wɔn a wɔmpɛ wʼasɛm nso ama wɔn tiri so.

Wɔde anifire repam atia wo nkurɔfoɔ
    wɔrepam atia wɔn a wʼakoma da wɔn so no.

Wɔka sɛ, “Mommra na yɛnsɛe wɔn sɛ ɔman,
    sɛdeɛ wɔrenkae Israel din bio.”

Wɔde adwene korɔ bɔ pɔ;
    na wɔpam tia wo,

Edom ntomadan ne Ismaelfoɔ,
    Moabfoɔ ne Hagarfoɔ,

Gebalfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ,
    Filistifoɔ ne Tirofoɔ.

Asiria mpo akɔka wɔn ho
    de wɔn ahoɔden akɔhyɛ Lot asefoɔ deɛ mu kena.

Yɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Midian
    sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asubɔnten Kison ho no,

wɔn a wɔsɛee wɔ En-Dor
    na wɔdanee nwira no.

Yɛ wɔn atitire sɛ Oreb ne Seeb,
    ne wɔn mmapɔmma nyinaa sɛ Seba ne Salmuna,

a wɔkaa sɛ, “Momma yɛmfa
    Onyankopɔn adidibea nsase no.”

Ao me Onyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ twahoframa mu mfuturo,
    sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ guo.

Sɛdeɛ ogya hye kwaeɛ,
    na ogyaframa sɔ nkokoɔ mu hye no no,

saa ara na fa wʼahum taa wɔn
    na fa wo mframa a ano yɛ den no hunahuna wɔn.

Ma animguaseɛ nka wɔn,
    na ama nnipa apɛ wo din akyiri ɛkwan, Ao Awurade.

Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔn abasa mu ntu;
    ma wɔnwuwu wɔ animguaseɛ mu.

Ma wɔnhunu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no,
    wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa.

Ao Asafo Awurade,
    wʼatenaeɛ hɔ yɛ ahomeka!

Me kra pere, mpo ɛtɔ piti,
    sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Awurade adihɔ;
  mʼakoma ne me honam team
    frɛ Onyankopɔn ɔteasefoɔ.

Mpo akasanoma anya fie,
    na asomfena nso anwono ne pirebuo,
    baabi a ɔbɛhwane ne mma
  wɔ beaeɛ bi a ɛbɛn wʼafɔrebukyia,
    Ao Asafo Awurade, me Ɔhene ne me Onyankopɔn.

Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔte wo fie;
    na wɔkamfo wo din daa.

Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔwɔ wo mu ahoɔden,
    na wɔde wɔn akoma hyɛ akwantuo ase kɔhwehwɛ wo.

Wɔkɔ no ahoɔden so berɛ nyinaa,
    kɔsi sɛ wɔn mu biara bɛpue Onyankopɔn anim wɔ Sion.

Ao Asafo Awurade, Onyankopɔn tie me mpaeɛbɔ;
    Ao Yakob Onyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma me.

Ao Onyankopɔn, hwɛ yɛn akokyɛm;
    fa ahummɔborɔ hwɛ deɛ woasra no ngo no.

Wʼadihɔ hɔ da korɔ tena
    yɛ sene nnafua apem wɔ baabi foforɔ;
  mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn fie
    sene sɛ mɛtena amumuyɛfoɔ ntomadan mu.

Ao Asafo Awurade,
    nhyira nka onipa a ɔde ne ho to wo so.

Ao Awurade wohunuu wʼasase mmɔbɔ;
    wode Yakob ahonyadeɛ sane maa no.

Wode wo nkurɔfoɔ bɔne kyɛɛ wɔn
    na wokataa wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa so.

Wode wʼabofuo too nkyɛn
    na wodane firii wʼabufuhyeɛ ho.

Sane gye yɛn bio, Ao Onyankopɔn, yɛn Gyefoɔ,
    na ma wʼani nnye yɛn ho.

Wo bo bɛfu yɛn akɔsi daa anaa?
    Wʼabofuo bɛtoa so akɔ awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa so anaa?

Worenhyɛ yɛn den bio,
    na ama wo nkurɔfoɔ asɛpɛ wɔn ho wɔ wo mu anaa?

Ao Awurade, kyerɛ yɛn wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no,
    na ma yɛn wo nkwagyeɛ no.

Mɛtie deɛ Awurade Onyankopɔn bɛka.
    Ɔde asomdwoeɛ hyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ, ahotefoɔ no bɔ,
    enti ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsane kɔ agyimisɛm ho.

Ampa ara, ne nkwagyeɛ bɛne wɔn a wɔsuro no,
    na nʼanimuonyam bɛtena yɛn asase so.

Ɔdɔ ne nokorɛdie bɛhyia,
    na tenenee ne asomdwoeɛ bɛfe wɔn ho wɔn ho ano.

Nokorɛdie bɛpue afiri asase no so,
    na tenenee ahwɛ afiri soro.

Awurade bɛma yɛn deɛ ɛyɛ ampa ara
    na yɛn asase bɛma ne nnɔbaeɛ.

Tenenee di nʼanim
    siesie ɛkwan ma nʼanammɔntuo.

Ao Awurade, tie me na gye me so,
    ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni.

Bɔ me nkwa ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ mede me ho ama wo.
    Wone me Onyankopɔn, gye wʼakoa a
    ɔde ne ho to wo so.

Ao Awurade, hunu me mmɔbɔ,
    na mesu frɛ wo daa nyinaa.

Ma wʼakoa ani nnye,
    na wo Awurade, wo nkyɛn
    na mema me kra so ba.

Ao Awurade, woyɛ, na wode bɔne kyɛ,
    wowɔ ɔdɔ mmorosoɔ ma wɔn a wɔsu frɛ wo nyinaa.

Ao Awurade, tie me mpaeɛbɔ;
    tie me mmɔborɔ su.

Mɛfrɛ wo mʼahohia da mu,
    na wobɛgye me so.

Ao Awurade, onyame bi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ wo;
    na wɔn nnwuma biara nto wo deɛ.

Woyɛ kɛseɛ, na woyɛ anwanwa nnwuma;
    wo nko ara ne Onyankopɔn.

Ao Awurade, kyerɛ me wʼakwan,
    na mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu;
  ma memfa mʼakoma nyinaa mma wo
    na masuro wo din.

Mede mʼakoma nyinaa mɛyi wo ayɛ, Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn
    na mahyɛ wo din animuonyam daa nyinaa.

Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔdɔ a wode dɔ me no so;
    woayi me afiri owuo amena mu tɔnn.

Nanso wo, Ao Awurade, woyɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ Onyankopɔn,
    wo bo kyɛre fu, na wʼadɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ dɔɔso.

Ma me wo papayɛ ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ,
    na mʼatamfoɔ nhunu na wɔn anim ngu ase
    na wo Ao Awurade, wo na woaboa me akyekye me werɛ.
Awurade ato ne fapem wɔ bepɔ kronkron no so;

Awurade dɔ Sion apono no
    sene Yakob atenaeɛ nyinaa.

Wɔka wo ho animuonyamsɛm
    Ao Onyankopɔn kuropɔn:

“Mede Rahab ne Babilonia
    bɛka wɔn a wɔyɛ ɔsetie ma me no ho,
  Filistia, Tiro ne Kus nso
    mɛka sɛ, ‘Wɔwoo yeinom wɔ Sion.’ ”

Ampa ara wɔbɛka wɔ Sion ho sɛ,
    “Wɔwoo yei ne ɔno wɔ ne mu,
    na Ɔsorosoroni no ankasa de no bɛtim hɔ.”

Awurade bɛtwerɛ wɔ nnipa dintwerɛ nwoma no mu sɛ,
    “Wɔwoo yei wɔ Sion.”

Na wɔbɛto dwom sɛ,
    “Me nhini nyinaa wɔ wo mu.”

Ao Awurade, me nkwagyeɛ Onyankopɔn
    mesu wɔ wʼanim adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ.

Ma me mpaeɛbɔ nnuru wʼanim;
    brɛ wʼaso ase tie me sufrɛ.

Ɔhaw ahyɛ me kra ma
    na me nkwa rebɛn owuo.

Wɔkan me fra wɔn a wɔrekɔ damena mu;
    mete sɛ obi a ɔnni ahoɔden.

Wɔayi me asi nkyɛn wɔ awufoɔ mu,
    te sɛ atɔfoɔ a wɔdeda ɛda mu,
  wɔn a wonkae wɔn bio,
    na wonhwɛ wɔn bio.

Woato me atwene damena ase tɔnn,
    wɔ esum kabii mu.

Wʼabofuhyeɛ ayɛ duru wɔ me so;
    woama wʼasorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so.

Woyɛ anwanwadeɛ kyerɛ awufoɔ anaa?
    Wɔn a wɔawuwu no sɔre kamfo wo anaa?

Wɔka wʼadɔeɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɛda mu anaa,
    anaasɛ wo nokorɛ ho asɛm wɔ ɔsɛeɛ kurom?

Wɔhunu wʼanwanwadeɛ wɔ beaeɛ a ɛhɔ aduru sum,
    anaa wo tenenee nnwuma wɔ awerɛfirie asase so?

Nanso Ao Awurade, mesu frɛ wo sɛ boa me;
    me mpaeɛbɔ duru wʼanim adekyeeɛ mu

Ao Awurade, adɛn nti na wopo me
    na wode wʼanim hinta me?

Mahunu amane firi me mmɔfraase na mabɛn owuo;
    wʼahunahuna ama mabrɛ na mapa aba.

Wʼabofuhyeɛ abu afa me so;
    wʼahunahuna asɛe me.

Daa nyinaa wɔtwa me ho hyia sɛ nsuyire,
    na wɔabu afa me so koraa.

Woafa mʼayɔnkofoɔ ne mʼadɔfoɔ afiri me nkyɛn kɔ;
    na esum ayɛ mʼadamfo brɛboɔ.

Mɛto Awurade adɔeɛ ho dwom daa daa;
    mede mʼano bɛda wo nokorɛdie adi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Mɛka sɛ wʼadɔeɛ no tim hɔ daa nyinaa,
    na watim wo nokorɛdie wɔ ɔsoro hɔ ankasa.

Wokaa sɛ, “Me ne onipa a mayi no no ayɛ apam;
    maka ntam akyerɛ me ɔsomfoɔ Dawid.

‘Mɛma wʼase atim hɔ daa
    na wʼahennwa nso atim wɔ awoɔ ntoantoasoɔ nyinaa mu.’ ”

Ao Awurade, ɔsorosorofoɔ kamfo wʼanwanwadeɛ,
    na wo nokorɛdie nso, wɔkamfo wɔ ahotefoɔ asafo mu.

Na hwan na ɔne wo Awurade sɛ wɔ ɔsoro hɔ?
    Hwan na ɔte sɛ Awurade wɔ ɔsoro abɔdeɛ mu?

Akronkronfoɔ agyinatufoɔ mu, wosuro Onyankopɔn;
    wɔde suro ma no sene wɔn a wotwa ne ho hyia nyinaa.

Ao Otumfoɔ Awurade Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ?
    Ao Awurade woyɛ kɛseɛ na wo nokorɛdie atwa wo ho ahyia.

Wodi ɛpo a ɛreworo soɔ so;
    nʼasorɔkye bobɔ kɔ ɔsoro a, wobrɛ no ase.

Wodwerɛɛ Rahab sɛ atɔfoɔ no mu baako;
    wode wo basa denden no bɔɔ wʼatamfoɔ pansameeɛ.

Ɔsoro wɔ wo, na asase nso wɔ wo;
    ewiase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, wo na wohyɛɛ aseɛ.

Wobɔɔ atifi ne anafoɔ.
    Tabor ne Hermon de ahosɛpɛ to dwom ma wo din.

Tumi ayɛ wo basa ma;
    wo nsam wɔ ahoɔden, wama wo nsa nifa so.

Wʼahennwa no fapem yɛ tenenee ne atɛntenenee;
    adɔeɛ ne nokorɛdie di wʼanim.

Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔasua sɛdeɛ wɔbɔ wo abɔdin,
    wɔn a wɔnante wʼanim hann no mu, Ao Awurade.

Wɔgye wɔn ani wɔ wo din mu da mu nyinaa;
    wɔdi ahurisie wɔ wo tenenee mu.

Wone wɔn animuonyam ne ahoɔden,
    na wʼadom enti yɛyɛ nkonimdifoɔ.

Ampa ara, yɛn banbɔ firi Awurade hɔ,
    na Israel Kronkronni no ama yɛn Ɔhene.

Ɛda bi wokasaa wɔ anisoadehunu mu,
    kyerɛɛ wʼahotefoɔ sɛ,
  “Madom ɔkofoni bi ahoɔden;
    mapagya aberanteɛ bi afiri nnipa no mu.

Mahunu Dawid, me ɔsomfoɔ;
    mede me ngo kronkron no asra no.

Me nsa bɛwowa no;
    ampa ara mʼabasa bɛhyɛ no den.

Ɔtamfoɔ biara renhyɛ no sɛ ɔntua toɔ;
    omumuyɛfoɔ biara rentumi nhyɛ ne so.

Mɛdwerɛ nʼatamfoɔ wɔ nʼanim
  na mabobɔ nʼahohiahiafoɔ ahwe fam.

Me nokorɛ adɔeɛ bɛka ne ho,
    na me din mu, wɔbɛma nʼabɛn so.

Mɛtrɛ nʼahyeɛ mu akɔsi ɛpo so,
    na ɔde ne nsa nifa bɛto nsubɔntene so.

Ɔbɛfrɛ me aka sɛ, ‘Wone mʼagya,
    me Onyankopɔn, me nkwagyeɛ botan.’

Mɛyɛ no mʼabakan,
    asase so ahene nyinaa no mu ɔkɛseɛ.

Mɛma mʼadɔeɛ a mewɔ ma no no atena hɔ daa,
    na apam a me ne no ayɛ nso bɛtena hɔ daa.

Mɛma nʼase atim afebɔɔ,
    nʼahennwa nso bɛtim hɔ akɔsi sɛ ɔsoro bɛtwam.

“Sɛ ne mmammarima po me mmara
    na sɛ wɔanni mʼahyɛdeɛ so,

sɛ wɔbu mʼahyɛdeɛ so
    na sɛ wɔanni me ɔhyɛ nsɛm so a,

ɛno deɛ, mede abaa bɛtwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho
    na wɔn amumuyɛ nso mede mmaatwa atwe wɔn aso;

Nanso, merennyae mʼadɔeɛ a meyɛ ma noɔ no
    na mɛkɔ so adi no nokorɛ.

Meremmu mʼapam no so
    na merensesa deɛ mede mʼano aka no.

Menam me din kronkron no so aka ntam prɛko,
    na merentwa Dawid atorɔ da.

Meremma nʼase ntɔre da
    na nʼahennwa nso bɛtim wɔ mʼanim te sɛ owia;

ɛbɛtim hɔ daa te sɛ ɔsrane,
    ɔdansefoɔ nokwafoɔ a ɔwɔ ewiem no.”

Nanso woapo no, woapa nʼakyi
    wo bo afu deɛ woasra no ngo no.

Woagu apam a wo ne wo ɔsomfoɔ pameeɛ no
    woagu nʼahenkyɛ ho fi wɔ mfuturo mu.

Woabubu nʼafasuo nyinaa
    ama nʼabandenden adane mmubuiɛ.

Wɔn a wɔtwam wɔ hɔ nyinaa fom no fa;
    na wayɛ aniwudeɛ ama ne mfɛfoɔ.

Woama nʼatamfoɔ nsa nifa so;
    ama wɔn nyinaa di ahurisie.

Woama nʼakofena ayɛ ɔkwa,
    na woannyina nʼakyi wɔ ɔko mu.

Wode nʼanimuonyam aba awieeɛ
    na woato nʼahennwa atwene fam.

Woatwa ne mmeranteberɛ nna so
    na wode animguaseɛ ngugusoɔ akata ne so.

Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Wode wo ho bɛhinta afebɔɔ anaa?
    Wʼabofuhyeɛ bɛkɔ so adɛre akɔsi da bɛn?

Kae sɛdeɛ me nkwa nna twam ntɛm so.
    Ɛfiri sɛ woabɔ yɛn nyinaa sɛ adeɛ a ɛtwa mu ntɛm so!

Hwan na ɔbɛtena ase a ɔrenwu da?
    Anaasɛ hwan na ɔbɛtumi agye ne ho afiri owuo tumi nsam?

Ao Awurade, ɛhe na wo tete adɔeɛ kɛseɛ no wɔ,
    deɛ wofiri wo nokorɛdie mu de kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid no?

Awurade kae sɛdeɛ wɔadi wo ɔsomfoɔ ho fɛ
    ne sɛdeɛ manya akoma ama amanaman no akutiabɔ.

Ao Awurade, akutiabɔ a wʼatamfoɔ de adi fɛw,
    de adi deɛ woasra no ngo no anammɔntuo biara ho fɛw.

Ayɛyie nka Awurade daa!
    Amen, Amen.

Ao Awurade, mefiri mʼakoma nyinaa mu mekamfo wo.
    Mɛka wʼanwanwadeɛ no nyinaa.

Mɛma mʼani agye na madi ahurisie wɔ wo mu.
    Mɛto ayɛyie dwom ama wo din, Ao Ɔsorosoroni.

Mʼatamfoɔ sane wɔn akyi;
    wɔtete hwe, na wɔwuwu wɔ wʼanim.
