Woadi mʼasɛm ama me, na mɛnya mʼahofadie;
    woatena wʼahennwa so, abu atɛntenenee.

Woatwe amanaman no aso, na woasɛe amumuyɛfoɔ.
    Woapepa wɔn din a wɔrenkae wɔn bio.

Awurade di ɔhene daa daa;
    wasi nʼatemmuo ahennwa.

Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn;
    ɔde atɛntenenee bɛdi nnipa no so.

Awurade yɛ dwanekɔbea ma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so,
    ɔyɛ abandenden wɔ ahohia mmrɛ mu.

Wɔn a wɔnim wo din no de wɔn ho bɛto wo so,
    ɛfiri sɛ, wo Awurade, wonnyaa obiara a ɔhwehwɛ wo no mu da.

Monto ayɛyie dwom mma Awurade a ɔte ahennwa so wɔ Sion;
    mompae mu nka deɛ wayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.

Na ɔkae deɛ ɔtɔ mogya so were no;
    ɔmmu nʼani ngu ɔbrɛfoɔ sufrɛ so.

Ao Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ teetee me!
    Hu me mmɔbɔ na yi me firi owuo apono ano,

na matumi apae mu aka wʼayɛyie
    wɔ Ɔbabaa Sion apono ano
    na ɛhɔ, madi ahurisie wɔ wo nkwagyeɛ no mu.

Aman amanmufoɔ atɔ amena a wɔatu no mu;
    afidie a wɔsum hintaaeɛ no ayi wɔn nan.

Awurade atɛntenenee da no adi;
    amumuyɛfoɔ nsa ano adwuma ayi wɔn.

Amumuyɛfoɔ sane kɔ damena mu,
    amanaman a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn nyinaa.

Nanso ɛnyɛ daa na ne werɛ bɛfiri ohiani,
    anaa sɛ mmɔborɔni anidasoɔ bɛyera korakora.

Sɔre! Ao Awurade, mma ɔdasani nni nkonim,
    bu amanaman no atɛn wɔ wʼanim.

Hunahuna wɔn, Ao Awurade;
    na ma wɔnhunu sɛ, wɔyɛ adasamma.

Awurade, wo na woayɛ yɛn tenabea
    awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Ansa na wɔrebɛbɔ mmepɔ
    anaasɛ worebɛda asase ne ewiase adi no,
    na woyɛ Onyankopɔn firi mmerɛsanten kɔsi mmerɛsanten.

Woma adasamma sane dane mfuturo,
    ka sɛ, “Ao adasamma, monsane nkɔ mfuturo mu.”

Mfirinhyia apem yɛ wʼani so sɛ
    da koro a abɛsene seesei,
    anaasɛ anadwo mu dɔnhwereɛ kakraa bi.

Wopra nnipa kɔ, wɔ owuo nna mu;
    wɔte sɛ ɛserɛ a afefɛ anɔpa,

ɛfefɛ yɛ frɔmfrɔm anɔpa deɛ,
    nanso anwummerɛ ɛwo na ɛtwintwam.

Yɛresa wɔ wʼabofuo ano
    na wʼanibereɛ abɔ yɛn hu.

Wode yɛn amumuyɛ asi wʼanim,
    na yɛn kɔkoam bɔne da wʼanim hann no mu.

Yɛn nna nyinaa twam wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu;
    na yɛde awerɛhoɔdie na ɛwie yɛn mfeɛ.

Yɛn nkwa nna si mfeɛ aduɔson,
    anaasɛ aduɔwɔtwe, sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden a;
  na emu ahohoahoadeɛ yɛ ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ,
    na ɛtwam ntɛm ntɛm, na yɛtu kɔ.

Hwan na ɔnim wʼabofuo mu tumi?
    Wʼabofuhyeɛ yɛ kɛseɛ sɛdeɛ wo ho suro teɛ.

Ma yɛnhunu yɛn nna kan sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ,
    na yɛanya nyansa akoma.

Sane bra, Ao Awurade, ɛbɛkɔ so akɔsi da bɛn?
    Hunu wʼasomfoɔ mmɔbɔ.

Ma wʼadɔeɛ a ɛnsa da no mmee yɛn adekyeɛ mu,
    na yɛde anigyeɛ ato dwom adi ahurisie yɛn nna nyinaa mu.

Ma yɛn ani nnye nna bebree sɛ nna dodoɔ a wode yɛn kɔɔ amanehunu mu no,
    sɛ mfirinhyia dodoɔ a yɛhunuu ateeteeɛ no.

Ma wʼasomfoɔ nhunu wo nneyɛɛ
    na wɔn mma nhunu wʼanimuonyam.

Deɛ ɔte Ɔsorosoroni no hintabea
    bɛhome wɔ Otumfoɔ no nwunu mu.

Mɛse Awurade sɛ, “Woyɛ me dwanekɔbea ne mʼabankɛseɛ,
    me Onyankopɔn a mewɔ wo mu ahotosoɔ.”

Ampa ara, ɔbɛgye wo afiri fidisumfoɔ afidie mu
    ne owuyadeɛ mu.

Worensuro anadwo mu ahunahuna,
    anaa bɛmma a ɛtu awia,

anaa owuyadeɛ a ɛba esum mu,
    anaa ɔyaredɔm a ɛsɛe owigyinaeɛ.

Apem bɛtotɔ wo nkyɛn mu,
    na ɔpedu bɛtotɔ wo nifa,
    nanso, wo deɛ, ɛrenka wo.

Wʼani nko ara na wode bɛhwɛ
    na woahunu nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe.

Sɛ wode Ɔsorosoroni no yɛ wo tenabea,
    mpo Awurade a ɔyɛ me dwanekɔbea no a,

ɔhaw biara remma wo so,
    na amanehunu biara remmɛn wo ntomadan.

Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛhyɛ nʼabɔfoɔ a wɔhwɛ wo so no
    abɛbɔ wo ho ban wʼakwan nyinaa mu;

wɔde wɔn nsa bɛpagya wo,
    na wo nan rensunti ɔboɔ.

Wobɛtiatia agyata ne aprammire so,
    wobɛnante gyataburuwa ne ɔtweaseɛ so.

Awurade ka sɛ, “Esiane sɛ ɔdɔ me enti, mɛgye no;
    mɛbɔ ne ho ban, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim me din.

Mɛma nkwa nna a ɛware amee no
    na makyerɛ no me nkwagyeɛ.”

Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔkamfo wo Awurade
    na wɔto dwom de hyɛ wo animuonyam, Ao Ɔsorosoroni,

na wɔpae mu ka wʼadɔeɛ anɔpa
    ne wo nokorɛ anadwo,

wɔ ahoma edu sankuo so
    ne sankuten nnwom mu.

Ao Awurade, wo nneyɛɛ ma mʼani gye;
    mede anigyeɛ bɛto dwom, wo nsa ano nnwuma enti.

Ao Awurade, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ,
    na wo nyansa mu dɔ!

Ogyimifoɔ nnim
    na nkwaseafoɔ nte aseɛ,

amumuyɛfoɔ bɛnyini sɛ ɛserɛ
    na abɔnefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm deɛ,
  nanso wɔbɛsɛe wɔn pasaa.
Na wo Awurade, woyɛ kɛseɛ afebɔɔ.

Woama me ahoɔden te sɛ ɛkoɔ;
    woahwie ngohwam papa agu me so.

Mahunu mʼatamfoɔ nkoguo a wɔadi,
    mate sɛdeɛ mʼatamfoɔ atirimuɔdenfoɔ adwane afiri akono.

Ateneneefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmm te sɛ abedua,
    wɔbɛnyini sɛ Lebanon ntweneduro;

deɛ wɔadua wɔ Awurade fie,
    wɔbɛnyini frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn adihɔ hɔ.

Wɔbɛkɔ so aso aba, onyinkyerɛ mu mpo,
    wɔbɛyɛ frɔmm sɛ ahahammono,

de akyerɛ sɛ, “Awurade yɛ ɔteneneeni;
    ɔyɛ me botan, na atirimuɔdensɛm biara nni ne mu.”

Wʼahennwa tim hɔ firi tete;
    na wowɔ hɔ firi mmerɛsanten.

Woyɛ deɛ ɔwɔ tumi sene nsuo akɛseɛ aprannaa,
    deɛ ɔwɔ tumi sene ɛpo nworosoɔ.
    Awurade a ɔte ɔsoro no yɛ kɛseɛ.

Awurade, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ werɛ,
    Onyankopɔn a wotɔ werɛ, hyerɛn.

Sɔre, Ao wo a woyɛ asase so ɔtemmufoɔ,
    tua ahantanfoɔ ka sɛdeɛ ɛfata wɔn.

Ao Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn,
    amumuyɛfoɔ nnye wɔn ani nkɔsi da bɛn?

Wɔkasa ahantan so;
    ahohoahoa ahyɛ abɔnefoɔ nyinaa ma.

Ao Awurade, wɔdwerɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ;
    wɔhyɛ wʼagyapadeɛ so.

Wɔkunkumm akunafoɔ ne amanfrafoɔ;
    na wɔdi nwisiaa awu.

Wɔka sɛ, “Awurade nhunu,
    Yakob Onyankopɔn ayi nʼani.”

Monhwɛ yie, mo agyimifoɔ a mowɔ nnipa no mu;
    nkwaseafoɔ, da bɛn na mobɛhunu nyansa?

Deɛ ɔbɔɔ aso no, ɔrente asɛm anaa?
    Deɛ ɔyɛɛ ani no, ɔrenhunu adeɛ anaa?

Deɛ ɔtenetene aman so no rentwe aso anaa?
    Deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ onipa no nnim nyansa anaa?

Awurade nim onipa nsusuiɛ;
    ɔnim sɛ ɛnkɔsi hwee.

Ao Awurade, nhyira ne onipa a wotenetene ne so,
    onipa a wokyerɛ no wo mmara no;

Woma wɔn ɔhome firi amanehunu nna mu,
    kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛtu amena ama amumuyɛfoɔ.

Awurade rempo ne nkurɔfoɔ;
    na ɔrennya nʼagyapadeɛ hɔ da.

Atemmuo bɛgyina teneneeyɛ so bio,
    na wɔn a wɔn akoma mu teɛ nyinaa bɛdi so.

Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre atia amumuyɛfoɔ ama me?
    Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre atia abɔnefoɔ ama me?

Sɛ Awurade ammoa me a,
    anka mekɔɔ owuo kommyɛ mu ntɛm so.

Ɛberɛ a mekaa sɛ, “Menan rewatiri” no,
    Ao Awurade, wo dɔ no sɔɔ me mu.

Ɛberɛ a me dadwene dɔɔso no,
    wʼawerɛkyekye maa me kra abotɔyam.

Ɔhene a porɔeɛ ahyɛ no ma no ne wo wɔ ayɔnkofa anaa?
    Wʼani gye ahennie a ɛde amanehunu ba ho anaa?

Awudifoɔ bɔ mu tia ateneneefoɔ
    na wɔn a wɔdi bem no, wɔbu wɔn kumfɔ.

Nanso Awurade yɛ mʼaban;
    na me Onyankopɔn ayɛ ɔbotan a ne mu na menya ahintaeɛ.

Mommra mma yɛnto dwom wɔ anigyeɛ so mma Awurade;
    momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagyeɛ Botan no.

Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra nʼanim,
    na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛ nnwom mma no so.

Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ,
    ɔhenkɛseɛ wɔ anyame nyinaa so.

Ne nsam na asase mu nneɛma nyinaa wɔ,
    na mmepɔ mpampam wɔ no.

Ɛpo wɔ no. Ɔno na ɔbɔeɛ,
    na ne nsa na ɛnwonoo asase kesee no.

Mommra mma yɛnkoto nsom no.
    Momma yɛmmu nkotodwe wɔ Awurade yɛn Yɛfoɔ no anim!

Ɔyɛ yɛn Onyankopɔn;
    yɛyɛ nʼadidibea nnipa,
    ne nnwankuo a ɔhwɛ wɔn so.
    
  Ɛnnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,

mommpirim mo akoma sɛdeɛ moyɛɛ wɔ Meriba no,
    sɛdeɛ moyɛɛ da no wɔ Masa, ɛserɛ no so no,

Ɛhɔ no, mo mpanimfoɔ sɔɔ me hwɛeɛ,
    a na wɔnim deɛ meyɛ maa wɔn.

Me bo fuu saa nnipa no mfeɛ aduanan
    na mekaa sɛ, “Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn akoma amane afiri me ho,
    na wɔanhunu mʼakwan.”

Ɛno enti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuo mu sɛ,
    “Wɔrenhyɛne mʼahomegyeɛ mu da.”

Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade;
    asase nyinaa monto dwom mma Awurade.

Monto dwom mma Awurade, na monkamfo ne din;
    mompae mu nka ne nkwagyeɛ no daa daa.

Monka nʼanimuonyam wɔ amanaman mu,
    monka nʼanwanwadeɛ a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.

Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ na ɔfata ayɛyie;
    ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsuro no sene anyame nyinaa.

Anyame a wɔwɔ aman foforɔ so yɛ ahoni bi kwa,
    nanso Awurade na ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro.

Animuonyam ne kɛseyɛ wɔ nʼanim;
    ahoɔden ne animuonyam wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.

Momfa mma Awurade, Ao amanaman mmusuakuo,
    momfa animuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.

Momfa animuonyam ne din a ɛfata mma Awurade;
    momfa afɔrebɔdeɛ nhyɛne nʼadihɔ hɔ.

Monsɔre Awurade wɔ ne kronkronyɛ fɛfɛ mu;
    asase nyinaa momma mo ho mpopo wɔ nʼanim.

Momma ɔsorosoro ani nnye, na asase nni ahurisie;
    momma ɛpo ne emu nneɛma nyinaa nworo;

momma mfuo ne so nneɛma nyinaa mmɔ ose.
  Nnua a ɛwɔ kwaeɛm de ahosɛpɛ bɛto dwom;

wɔbɛto dwom wɔ Awurade anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba,
    ɔreba abɛbu asase no atɛn.
  Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn
    na woabu nnipa nso atɛn wɔ ne nokorɛ mu.

Awurade di ɔhene, ma asase ani nnye;
    ma nsupɔ ahodoɔ nsɛpɛ wɔn ho.

Omununkum ne esum kabii atwa ne ho ahyia;
    tenenee ne atɛntenenee yɛ nʼahennwa no fapem.

Ogya di nʼanim
    na ɛhye nʼatamfoɔ wɔ afanan nyinaa.

Nʼanyinam hran ewiase;
    asase ahunu, na ne ho popo.

Mmepɔ nane sɛ nku wɔ Awurade anim,
    Awurade a asase nyinaa wɔ no no anim.

Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne tenenee kyerɛ
    na aman nyinaa hunu nʼanimuonyam.

Ahonisomfoɔ nyinaa anim agu ase,
    wɔn a wɔde abosomhuhuo hoahoa wɔn ho no,
    anyame nyinaa monsɔre no.

Sion te, na ne ho sɛpɛ no
    na Yuda nkuraase ani gye
    Ao Awurade, ɛsiane wʼatɛntenenee enti.

Wo, Ao Awurade ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa;
    wɔama wo so pa ara wɔ anyame nyinaa mu.

Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ Awurade no nkyiri bɔne,
    ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ no ho ban
    na ɔgye wɔn firi amumuyɛfoɔ nsam.

Hann to gu teneneefoɔ so
    na anigyeɛ ba wɔn a wɔn akoma mu teɛ so.

Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu, mo teneneefoɔ nyinaa,
    na monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade,
    ɛfiri sɛ wayɛ anwanwadeɛ bebree;
  ne nsa nifa ne ne basa kronkron no
    anya nkwagyeɛ ama no.

Awurade ama wɔahunu ne nkwagyeɛ
    na wada ne tenenee adi akyerɛ amanaman no.

Wakae nʼadɔeɛ
    ne ne nokorɛ a ɔdi akyerɛ Israelfoɔ;
  asase ano nyinaa ahunu
    yɛn Onyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.

Asase nyinaa mommɔ ose mma Awurade,
    momfa nnwontoɔ nni ahurisie;

Momfa sankuo nto dwom mma Awurade,
    sankuo ne nnwontoɔ nnyegyeɛ,

momfa totorobɛnto ne nnwennini mmɛn,
    nteam ahosɛpɛ so wɔ Awurade, yɛn ɔhene no anim.

Ɛpo ne abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa monworo so;
    asase ne wɔn a wɔte soɔ nyinaa.

Momma nsubɔntene mmɔ wɔn nsam,
    mmepɔ nka mmom nto ahurisie dwom;

ma wɔnto dwom wɔ Awurade anim,
    ɛfiri sɛ ɔreba abɛbu ewiase atɛn.
  Ɔde tenenee bɛbu ewiase atɛn
    na ɔde pɛpɛyɛ abu nnipa atɛn.

Awurade di ɔhene,
    momma amanaman no ho mpopo;
  ɔte nʼahennwa so wɔ Kerubim ntam,
    ma asase nwoso.

Awurade a ɔwɔ Sion yɛ kɛseɛ;
    wɔama ne so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.

Ma wɔnkamfo wo din a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwanwa no.
    Ɔyɛ kronkron.

Ɔhene no yɛ kɛseɛ, ɔdɔ atɛntenenee,
    woama pɛpɛyɛ atim;
  wayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ na ɛtene
    wɔ Yakob mu.

Na Mose ne Aaron ka nʼasɔfoɔ no ho,
    na Samuel ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho;
  wɔfrɛɛ Awurade,
    na ɔgyee wɔn so.

Ɔfiri omununkum dum mu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn;
    wɔdii mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔmaa wɔn no so.

Ao Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn,
    wogyee wɔn so;
  woyɛɛ bɔnefakyɛ Onyankopɔn maa Israel,
    nanso wɔtwee wɔn aso wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.

Momma Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn so
    na monsɔre no wɔ ne bepɔ kronkron no so,
    na Awurade yɛn Onyankopɔn yɛ kronkron.
